```{r setup}
# Shared check: files exist, CLIF inputs not newer than the cache, parameters unchanged
cache_ok <- function(cache_file, meta_file, params, label) {
  if (!file.exists(cache_file) || !file.exists(meta_file)) return(FALSE)
  meta <- readRDS(meta_file)
  newer <- list.files(data_dir, full.names = TRUE)
  newer <- newer[file.mtime(newer) > meta$saved_at]
  if (length(newer)) { message(label, " cache is older than: ", paste(basename(newer), collapse = ", "), " -> rebuilding"); return(FALSE) }
  if (!identical(meta$params, params)) { message(label, " parameters changed -> rebuilding"); return(FALSE) }
  TRUE
}

use_baseline_cache <- !force_rebuild && cache_ok(baseline_cache, baseline_meta, cohort_params, "Baseline")
use_epoch_cache    <- use_baseline_cache && !force_rebuild_epoch &&
                      cache_ok(epoch_cache, epoch_meta, epoch_params, "Epoch table") &&
                      readRDS(epoch_meta)$saved_at > readRDS(baseline_meta)$saved_at   # built from the current baseline

message(if (use_epoch_cache)         ">>> USING CACHED epoch_table: Parts 2-8 will be skipped ✅"
        else if (use_baseline_cache) ">>> USING CACHED baseline table: Parts 2-4 skipped, Parts 5-8 will run ✅"
        else                         ">>> ⚠️ Building baseline and epoch table from scratch")

# Load the cached tables now if skipping ahead
restore_tz <- function(dt) {   # parquet stores times in UTC; put them back in the site's time zone
  for (cc in names(dt)[sapply(dt, inherits, "POSIXct")]) set(dt, j = cc, value = lubridate::with_tz(dt[[cc]], time_zone))
  dt
}
if (use_epoch_cache) {
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs <- restore_tz(as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(baseline_cache)))
  epoch_table                     <- restore_tz(as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(epoch_cache)))
  setorder(epoch_table, imv_run_id, epoch)
  message("Loaded epoch_table: ", format(nrow(epoch_table), big.mark = ","), " rows, ",
          uniqueN(epoch_table$imv_run_id), " runs")
}
```

#PART ZERO: Fix Hospitalization
```{r}
# This block adjusts for hospitalizations that are continuous within a health system.
# It looks at patient_id, discharge_dttm, and admission_dttm for hospitalization_ids
# that are close in time, creates new chronological hospitalization_ids, and builds
# a crosswalk (hosp_map) used by read_data() to remap all downstream tables

#Function to Normalize DTTM columns to site time_zone
normalize_dttm <- function(dt, tz = time_zone, verbose = TRUE, end_of_day_cols = "death_dttm") {
  for (var in grep("dttm$", names(dt), value = TRUE)) { #Identify all _dttm columns and then loop through
    col <- dt[[var]] #Pull out the current column to be checked
    eod <- var %in% end_of_day_cols #Check if column is an EOD column -> 23:59 instead of 00:00
    if (inherits(col, "POSIXct")) { #Is the column already a date-time?
      old <- attr(col, "tzone") #The current time zone in the dttm column
      if (is.null(old) || !nzchar(old)) { #If it's blank then use force_tz to stamp the time_zone
        new <- lubridate::force_tz(col, tzone = tz); how <- paste0("blank tzone: stamped with ", tz, " (no clock shift) ✅ ")
      } else if (old == tz) { #If timezone is consistent with yaml then move on
        next
      } else if (old %in% c("UTC", "GMT", "Etc/UTC")) { #If timezone is in UTC then shift to time_zone using with_tz
        new <- lubridate::with_tz(col, tzone = tz);  how <- paste0(old, ": converted to ", tz, " (clock shifted) ✅ ")
      } else { #If more than one timezone is present than warm and leave as is
        warning(var, ": tzone is '", old, "', differs from '", tz, "'. Leaving as-is. ⚠️⚠️⚠️"); next
      }
    } else if (inherits(col, "Date")) { #If dttm column is only date and missing time then stamp as midnight local time if non-EOD and 23:59 if EOD
      new <- lubridate::force_tz(as.POSIXct(col), tzone = tz)
      if (eod) new <- new + lubridate::hours(23) + lubridate::minutes(59)
      how <- paste0("📅 Date -> local ", if (eod) "23:59" else "midnight", " in ", tz)
    } else {
      txt <- if (is.factor(col)) as.character(col) else col #If column is factor convert to text for parsing 
      new <- suppressWarnings(lubridate::ymd_hms(txt, tz = tz, quiet = TRUE)) #Parse directly as local time
      bad <- is.na(new) & !is.na(txt) & nzchar(trimws(txt)) #Find values that failed but weren't blank
      if (any(bad)) { #Retry bad values as date only with midnight time stamp, if unable to parse then use NA
        d <- suppressWarnings(lubridate::ymd(txt[bad], tz = tz, quiet = TRUE))
        if (eod) d <- d + lubridate::hours(23) + lubridate::minutes(59) #Use same date logic as above
        new[bad] <- d
      }
      n_fail <- sum(is.na(new) & !is.na(txt) & nzchar(trimws(txt))) #Number of values that couldn't be parsed
      how <- how <- paste0("parsed from text as ", tz, " time",
              if (n_fail) paste0(" (", n_fail, " unparseable -> NA ⚠️⚠️⚠️)") else "")
    }
    set(dt, j = var, value = new)
    if (verbose) message("  ", var, ": ", how)
  }
  invisible(dt)
}



read_data_start <- function(file_path, select = NULL, tz = time_zone, verbose = TRUE) { #Use path to CLIF table and check every column (NULL); verbose for printed output
  #Determine the file type
  ext <- sub(".*\\.(csv\\.gz|csv|parquet|fst)$", "\\1", tolower(file_path)) #sub() finds the pattern
  #Upload tables using fread, arrow, or fst_read
  dt <- switch(ext, #Use switch instead of if/else since we determined extension above
    "csv" = , "csv.gz" = fread(file_path, select = select, tz = ""),   #tz = "": keep unmarked datetimes as text
    "parquet" = if (is.null(select)) arrow::read_parquet(file_path) #If null is TRUE then read all of the columns using arrow
                else arrow::read_parquet(file_path, col_select = dplyr::all_of(select)), #If null is FALSE then only read the selected columns
    "fst" = fst::read_fst(file_path, columns = select),
    stop("Unsupported file format. Only CSV, Parquet, and FST are supported."))
  setDT(dt) #Convert dt to data.table regardless of file type - faster than as.data.table
  normalize_dttm(dt, tz = tz, verbose = verbose) #Use normalize_dttm function above
  if (verbose) dplyr::glimpse(dt) #Show us the summary
  dt[] #Return the table
}

# Load and clean hospitalization table
link_hours <- 6   # admissions starting < 6 h after the encounter's latest discharge are joined, easier for possible future sensitivity analyses questioning this design choice

#Baseline hospitalization table before linkage
clif_hospitalization_start <- read_data_start(
  paste0(data_dir, "clif_hospitalization", file_type),
  select = c("hospitalization_id", "patient_id", "admission_dttm", "discharge_dttm",
             "age_at_admission", "discharge_category"))

#Lowercase only the text categories (IDs must keep their original form to match other tables)
clif_hospitalization_start[, discharge_category := tolower(discharge_category)]

#Safety check: make sure no duplicate hospitalization_id values and every row has an admission_dttm
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(clif_hospitalization_start$hospitalization_id),
          !anyNA(clif_hospitalization_start$admission_dttm))
#How many hospitalizations are missing a discharge time?
message(sum(is.na(clif_hospitalization_start$discharge_dttm)), " hospitalizations with no discharge time")

#Build Encounter Blocks
setorder(clif_hospitalization_start, patient_id, admission_dttm)

#Work from the inside out to determine the latest discharge_dttm seen in patient's history (block_end)
#For missing discharge_dttm we are using admission_dttm as the discharge_dttm
clif_hospitalization_start[, block_end := cummax(as.numeric(fcoalesce(discharge_dttm, admission_dttm))),
                           by = patient_id] #Using as.numeric to convert to seconds then cummax to get largest value

#Determine when a new block begins
  #If patient's first hospitalization (i.e. they have no previous block_end) the shift is NA
  #If admission begins at least 6 hours (in seconds) after the latest prior discharge then start new block
clif_hospitalization_start[, new_block := is.na(shift(block_end)) |
                             as.numeric(admission_dttm) - shift(block_end) >= link_hours * 3600,
                           by = patient_id]

#For each patient_id count and group the blocks using cumsum
#.GRP gives each group a unique number across the whole table
clif_hospitalization_start[, encounter_block := .GRP, by = .(patient_id, cumsum(new_block))]
clif_hospitalization_start[, c("block_end", "new_block") := NULL] #Drop the helper columns

#Collapse to one row per encounter
clif_hospitalization <- clif_hospitalization_start[, {
  open <- anyNA(discharge_dttm) #Identify open encounters where patient is still admitted to some hospital
  last <- if (open) .N else which.max(discharge_dttm) #If it's an open encounter take that data if not then take max discharge_dttm
  .(hospitalization_id = hospitalization_id[1], #Rows are ordered by admission_dttm [1] = earliest - becomes encounter ID
    age_at_admission   = age_at_admission[1],
    admission_dttm     = admission_dttm[1],
    discharge_dttm     = if (open) discharge_dttm[NA_integer_] else discharge_dttm[last], #Keep missing discharge_dttm as NA
    discharge_category = discharge_category[last]) 
}, by = .(patient_id, encounter_block)] #Join by patient_id and encounter_block
clif_hospitalization[, clif_hospitalizations_joined_id := .I] #Give each encounter a new sequential ID

#Crosswalk from original hospitalization_id to encounter_block
hosp_map <- clif_hospitalization_start[, .(patient_id, encounter_block, old_hosp_id = hospitalization_id)][
  clif_hospitalization[, .(encounter_block,
                           new_hosp_id              = clif_hospitalizations_joined_id,
                           final_admit              = admission_dttm,
                           final_discharge          = discharge_dttm,
                           final_discharge_category = discharge_category)],
  on = "encounter_block"]

#Check to make sure the crosswalk has exactly one row per original hospitalization and every hospitalization_id maps to an encounter block
stopifnot(nrow(hosp_map) == nrow(clif_hospitalization_start), !anyNA(hosp_map$new_hosp_id))
message(nrow(clif_hospitalization_start), " hospitalizations -> ", nrow(clif_hospitalization), " encounters")

#Convert IDs to text and slim down to only the columns needed for remapping
hosp_map <- hosp_map[, .(old_hosp_id              = as.character(old_hosp_id),
                         new_hosp_id              = as.character(new_hosp_id),
                         final_admit, final_discharge, final_discharge_category,
                         first_in_block           = old_hosp_id %in% clif_hospitalization$hospitalization_id)]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(hosp_map$old_hosp_id)) #Each OG ID must appear once
```


# PART ONE: Upload clif tables
```{r}
read_data <- function(file_path, select = NULL, tz = time_zone, verbose = TRUE,
                      hosp_map = if (exists("hosp_map", envir = .GlobalEnv)) get("hosp_map", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  #1) Read - use the same code/logic as in read_data_start above
  ext <- sub(".*\\.(csv\\.gz|csv|parquet|fst)$", "\\1", tolower(file_path))
  dt <- switch(ext,
    "csv" = , "csv.gz" = data.table::fread(file_path, select = select, tz = ""),
    "parquet" = if (is.null(select)) arrow::read_parquet(file_path)
                else arrow::read_parquet(file_path, col_select = tidyselect::all_of(select)),
    "fst" = fst::read_fst(file_path, columns = select),
    stop("Unsupported file format. Only CSV, Parquet, and FST are supported."))
  setDT(dt)
  if (verbose) message("Read ", basename(file_path), ": ", format(nrow(dt), big.mark = ","), " rows") #Read in how many rows are in table

  #2) Normalize time zones first, so remapped and original times are on the same footing
  normalize_dttm(dt, tz = tz, verbose = verbose)

  #3) Remap hospitalization_id to the joined encounter ID
  if (!is.null(hosp_map) && "hospitalization_id" %in% names(dt)) { #Only remap if hosp_map exists and table has hospitalization_id column
    idx <- match(as.character(dt$hospitalization_id), hosp_map$old_hosp_id)   #Map hospitalization_id in the dt to the old_hosp_id by row - creates a vector of row numbers to refer to, gives NA for missing values
    n_orphan <- sum(is.na(idx)) #Count the number of hosp_ids not in the map and report it
    if (n_orphan) {
      if (verbose) message("  dropping ", format(n_orphan, big.mark = ","), " rows whose hospitalization_id is not in hosp_map")
      keep <- !is.na(idx); dt <- dt[keep]; idx <- idx[keep] #Keep the rows that have an idx value
    }
    set(dt, j = "hospitalization_id", value = hosp_map$new_hosp_id[idx]) #Now replace OG hospitalization_id with new encounter ID

    if (all(c("admission_dttm", "discharge_dttm") %in% names(dt))) {    #Only used on hospitalization table itself
      set(dt, j = "admission_dttm", value = hosp_map$final_admit[idx]) #Map the encounter admission_dttm
      set(dt, j = "discharge_dttm", value = hosp_map$final_discharge[idx]) #Map discharge_dttm, keep NA discharge_dttm as is
      if ("discharge_category" %in% names(dt))
        set(dt, j = "discharge_category", value = hosp_map$final_discharge_category[idx])
      set(dt, j = "first_in_block", value = hosp_map$first_in_block[idx]) #TRUE/FALSE if row is earliest encounter - helps make sure that age, admission_category, etc are from first hosp_id
      if (verbose) message("  remapped hospitalization_id, admission, discharge")
    } else if (verbose) message("  remapped hospitalization_id")
  }

  #4) Peek and return
  if (verbose && nrow(dt) > 0) utils::str(head(dt)) #Verbose summary of first rows
  dt[] #Return the final table
}


#Load Raw CLIF Tables
#Hospitalization

adt <- read_data(paste0(data_dir, "clif_adt", file_type), select = c("hospitalization_id", "hospital_id", "hospital_type", "in_dttm", "out_dttm", "location_category", "location_type"))
adt <- adt[hospitalization_id %in% valid_hosp_ids]
setorder(adt, hospitalization_id, in_dttm)

#Vitals
vital_cats <- tolower(trimws(c("height_cm","weight_kg","sbp","dbp","map",
                             "spo2","temp_c","heart_rate","respiratory_rate")))
vitals <- read_data(paste0(data_dir, "clif_vitals", file_type))[vital_category %in% vital_cats]
vitals <- vitals[hospitalization_id %in% valid_hosp_ids]

#RASS/GCS/SBT
sbt_binary_cats <- c("sbt_agitation", "sbt_inadequate_oxygenation", "sbt_intracranial_pressure",
                     "sbt_no_spontaneous_effort", "sbt_vasopressure_use",
                     "sbt_screen_performed", "sbt_screen_pass_fail",
                     "sbt_delivery_performed", "sbt_delivery_pass_fail")
specific_assessment_categories <- c("rass", "gcs_total", sbt_binary_cats)

patient_assessments <- read_data(paste0(data_dir, "clif_patient_assessments", file_type),
                                 select = c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm", "assessment_category",
                                            "numerical_value", "categorical_value"))[
                                   tolower(assessment_category) %in% specific_assessment_categories]
patient_assessments <- patient_assessments[hospitalization_id %in% valid_hosp_ids]
patient_assessments[, assessment_category := tolower(assessment_category)]

################################################################################
#SBT AUDIT AND STANDARDIZATION
#)1 Harmonize the binary SBT items to 1/0
# 1 = yes / pass / performed / reason present; 0 = no / fail / not performed / reason absent
pos_vals <- c("1", "1.0", "yes", "y", "true", "t", "pass", "passed", "positive", "performed", "done", "complete", "completed")
neg_vals <- c("0", "0.0", "no", "n", "false", "f", "fail", "failed", "negative", "not performed", "not done", "not_performed")

sbt <- patient_assessments[assessment_category %in% sbt_binary_cats] #Filter just for sbt values
sbt[, cat_raw := tolower(trimws(as.character(categorical_value)))] #Should already be lower but just in case
sbt[cat_raw == "", cat_raw := NA_character_] #Create cat_raw
sbt[, num_raw := as.character(numerical_value)] #Create num_raw
#fcase to determine which value is being used for documenting SBT settings
sbt[, source := fcase(!is.na(cat_raw) & !is.na(num_raw), "both",
                      !is.na(cat_raw),                   "categorical_value",
                      !is.na(num_raw),                   "numerical_value",
                      default =                          "neither")]
sbt[, raw_value := fcoalesce(cat_raw, num_raw)]           #categorical takes precedence if both
sbt[, binary_value := fcase(raw_value %in% pos_vals, 1L, raw_value %in% neg_vals, 0L, default = NA_integer_)]
#If both columns are filled and disagree, trust neither
sbt[source == "both" & num_raw %in% c(pos_vals, neg_vals) &
      (num_raw %in% pos_vals) != (cat_raw %in% pos_vals), `:=`(binary_value = NA_integer_, source = "both_conflicting")]

#Look for rows where hosp_id, recorded_dttm are same but values are different - don't count these
sbt[, n_vals := uniqueN(binary_value[!is.na(binary_value)]), by = .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, assessment_category)]
#Count the number of conflicts
time_conflicts <- unique(sbt[n_vals > 1L, .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, assessment_category)])[
  , .(same_time_conflicts = .N), by = assessment_category]
sbt[n_vals > 1L, binary_value := NA_integer_] #Make the conflicts NA for audit

#2) Audit: how this site records each item (aggregate counts only; safe to share)
min_cell <- 11 #Don't upload any value in audit less than 11!
#Count values from SBT
fmt <- sbt[, .(records = .N, hospitalizations = uniqueN(hospitalization_id)),
           by = .(assessment_category, source, raw_value, binary_value)]
fmt[records < min_cell, raw_value := "<value with fewer than 11 records>"]   #hides rare / free-text values
fmt <- fmt[, .(records = sum(records), hospitalizations = sum(hospitalizations)),
           by = .(assessment_category, source, raw_value, binary_value)][order(assessment_category, -records)]
fmt[, institution := institution]

#Final audit summary
sbt_summary <- sbt[, .(records = .N, hospitalizations = uniqueN(hospitalization_id),
                       pct_mapped = round(100 * mean(!is.na(binary_value)), 1),

                       last_year  = as.integer(format(max(recorded_dttm, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y"))),
                   by = assessment_category]

                     by = "assessment_category", all.x = TRUE)      #items absent at this site show as NA
sbt_summary[is.na(records), `:=`(records = 0L, hospitalizations = 0L, stored_in = "not present")]
sbt_summary <- merge(sbt_summary, time_conflicts, by = "assessment_category", all.x = TRUE)
sbt_summary[is.na(same_time_conflicts), same_time_conflicts := 0L]
sbt_summary[, institution := institution]
print(sbt_summary)

fwrite(fmt,         file.path(audit_dir, paste0("sbt_assessment_formats_", institution, "_", stamp, ".csv")))

#3) Put the harmonized values back; one row per hospitalization, time and item

#Non-Culture Micro
viral <- as.data.table(read_data(paste0(data_dir, "clif_microbiology_nonculture", file_type)))

for (cc in intersect(c("organism_category", "organism_group", "result_category", "specimen_category", "method_category"), names(viral)))
  set(viral, j = cc, value = tolower(trimws(as.character(viral[[cc]]))))

################################################################################
# NON-CULTURE MICRO AUDIT (aggregate counts only; safe to share)
# Group definitions (checked in this order; first match wins)
grp_sars_category    <- "sars_cov2"                                        # organism_category
grp_influenza_group  <- "influenza"                                        # organism_group
grp_rsv_group        <- "respiratory_syncytial_virus"                      # organism_group
grp_other_groups     <- c("adenovirus", "parainfluenza", "rhinovirus")     # organism_group
grp_other_categories <- c("coronavirus_hku1", "coronavirus_nl63", "coronavirus_oc43",
                          "human_metapneumovirus", "coronavirus_other", "coronavirus_229e")    # organism_category

mask <- function(x) fifelse(x < min_cell, NA_integer_, as.integer(x)) # function for masking small cells
time_col <- intersect(c("collect_dttm", "order_dttm", "result_dttm"), names(viral))[1]   # first available time column

# Expected targets, in the same first-match order the BC feature uses
viral_targets <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(feature = "viral_sars_cov2_active",  level = "organism_category", value = grp_sars_category),
  data.table(feature = "viral_influenza_active",  level = "organism_group",    value = grp_influenza_group),
  data.table(feature = "viral_rsv_active",        level = "organism_group",    value = grp_rsv_group),
  data.table(feature = "viral_other_resp_active", level = "organism_group",    value = grp_other_groups),
  data.table(feature = "viral_other_resp_active", level = "organism_category", value = grp_other_categories)))

# Assign each row to a feature group (first match wins), as the pipeline does
viral[, feature := fcase(
  organism_category %in% grp_sars_category,                                   "viral_sars_cov2_active",
  organism_group    %in% grp_influenza_group,                                 "viral_influenza_active",
  organism_group    %in% grp_rsv_group,                                       "viral_rsv_active",
  organism_group %in% grp_other_groups | organism_category %in% grp_other_categories, "viral_other_resp_active",
  default = NA_character_)]

#)1 Each expected target: present? how often tested? how often positive? which years?
has_result <- "result_category" %in% names(viral)
target_stats <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(viral_targets)), function(i) {
  tg <- viral_targets[i]
  v  <- viral[get(tg$level) %in% tg$value]
  data.table(tg,
             records          = nrow(v),
             hospitalizations = uniqueN(v$hospitalization_id),
             result_values    = if (has_result) paste(sort(unique(na.omit(v$result_category))), collapse = "; ") else "no result_category column",
             first_year       = if (nrow(v) && !is.na(time_col)) as.integer(format(min(v[[time_col]], na.rm = TRUE), "%Y")) else NA_integer_,
             last_year        = if (nrow(v) && !is.na(time_col)) as.integer(format(max(v[[time_col]], na.rm = TRUE), "%Y")) else NA_integer_)
}))
target_stats[, status := fcase(records == 0L,                  "MISSING",
                               hospitalizations < min_cell,    "rare (<11 hospitalizations)",
                               default =                       "present")]
target_stats[, `:=`(records = mask(records), hospitalizations = mask(hospitalizations), institution = institution)]
setcolorder(target_stats, c("feature", "level", "value", "status"))

#)2 How results are recorded (positive vs negative wording)
viral_results <- if (has_result) {
  viral[!is.na(feature), .(records = mask(.N)), by = .(feature, result_category)][
    order(feature, -records)][, institution := institution][]
} else data.table(institution = institution, note = "no result_category column")

#3) Category/group pairs: is organism_group filled consistently with organism_category?
viral_pairs <- viral[!is.na(feature), .(records = mask(.N)), by = .(feature, organism_group, organism_category)][
  order(feature, -records)][, institution := institution][]

#)4 Everything else the site records (not used by the features)
viral_other <- viral[is.na(feature), .(hospitalizations = uniqueN(hospitalization_id)),
                     by = .(organism_group, organism_category)][order(-hospitalizations)]
viral_other[, `:=`(hospitalizations = mask(hospitalizations), institution = institution)]

#)5 One-row summary
viral_summary <- data.table(
  institution             = institution,
  records                 = mask(nrow(viral)),
  hospitalizations        = mask(uniqueN(viral$hospitalization_id)),
  pct_records_mapped      = round(100 * mean(!is.na(viral$feature)), 1),
  pct_organism_cat_missing = round(100 * mean(is.na(viral$organism_category)), 1),
  pct_organism_grp_missing = if ("organism_group" %in% names(viral)) round(100 * mean(is.na(viral$organism_group)), 1) else NA_real_,
  targets_missing         = paste(target_stats[status == "MISSING", value], collapse = "; "),
  time_column_used        = time_col)

print(viral_summary)
print(target_stats)
print(viral_results)
print(viral_pairs)
print(head(viral_other, 20))

fwrite(viral_summary, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("micro_nonculture_summary_", institution, "_", stamp, ".csv")))
fwrite(target_stats,  file.path(audit_dir, paste0("micro_nonculture_targets_", institution, "_", stamp, ".csv")))
fwrite(viral_results, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("micro_nonculture_results_", institution, "_", stamp, ".csv")))
fwrite(viral_pairs,   file.path(audit_dir, paste0("micro_nonculture_pairs_",   institution, "_", stamp, ".csv")))
fwrite(viral_other,   file.path(audit_dir, paste0("micro_nonculture_other_",   institution, "_", stamp, ".csv")))
```

```{r}
################################################################################

################################################################################

trach_window_days <- 182                #within 6 months before admission
trach_devices     <- c("trach collar", "trach_collar") #device_category values

#1) Diagnosis evidence: tracheostomy status/complications (ICD-10 and 9)
trach_dx_ids <- unique(hospital_diagnosis[toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", diagnosis_code)) %like% "^Z930|^J950|^V440",
                                          hospitalization_id])

#2) Time-stamped evidence: tracheostomy flag or trach collar
trach_evidence <- unique(respiratory_support[!is.na(recorded_dttm) &
                                        (tracheostomy %in% 1 | tolower(device_category) %in% trach_devices),
                                       .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm)])
trach_ev_sum <- trach_evidence[, .(n_times = .N, first_trach_dttm = min(recorded_dttm)), by = hospitalization_id] #Calculate how many times each hospitalization_id has trach evidence

#Create a summary of all known trach status data
enc_trach <- hospitalization[, .(hospitalization_id, patient_id, admission_dttm, discharge_dttm)] #copy hospitalization for use in later filtering
enc_trach[trach_ev_sum, on = "hospitalization_id", `:=`(n_times = i.n_times, first_trach_dttm = i.first_trach_dttm)] #merge in trach_ev_sum
enc_trach[, `:=`(n_times = fcoalesce(n_times, 0L), has_dx = hospitalization_id %in% trach_dx_ids)] #TRUE/FALSE if they have an ICD code
enc_trach[, timed_trach := n_times >= min_trach_records | (n_times >= 1 & has_dx)]   #Do we have sufficient time evidence to support there was a trach? Either >1 documented respiratory records or 1 + an ICD code
enc_trach[!(timed_trach), first_trach_dttm := NA] #Set all dttms to NA if timed_trach is FALSE
enc_trach[, trach_any := timed_trach | has_dx] #TRUE/FALSE for trusted trach evidence - either timed_trach or an ICD code

# When the trach is known to exist, for judging LATER encounters:
  # time-stamped -> first record
  # code only -> that encounter's discharge (latest point it for sure existed)
enc_trach[, trach_known_by := first_trach_dttm]
enc_trach[!(timed_trach) & has_dx, trach_known_by := discharge_dttm]

#Define trach times
trach_times <- enc_trach[timed_trach == TRUE, .(hospitalization_id, first_trach_dttm)]

###############################################################################
#First Documented IMV Time Using respiratory_support
#Define the IMV settings columns
imv_setting_cols <- c("mode_category", "fio2_set", "tidal_volume_set", 
                      "resp_rate_set", "peep_set",
                      "pressure_control_set", "pressure_support_set", "flow_rate_set",
                      "inspiratory_time_set", "peak_inspiratory_pressure_set")
gap_end_hours  <- 24     #no IMV evidence for this long ends a run
non_imv_to_end <- 2      #this many consecutive explicit non-IMV rows end a run
min_imv_rows   <- 3      #runs need at least this many IMV rows

#1) Filter only for those with hosp_id in resp_imv
rs_imv <- respiratory_support[hospitalization_id %in% resp_imv$hospitalization_id & !is.na(recorded_dttm),
                              c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm", "device_category", imv_setting_cols), with = FALSE] #drop any rows with missing recorded_dttm
rs_imv[device_category == "", device_category := NA] #Fill in blanks with NA
rs_imv[, n_set := rowSums(!is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = imv_setting_cols] #Count # of imv_settings per row

#2) Order the table chronologically, one row per encounter x timestamp
    #This corrects resp_support tables that may not have columns collapsed to a single dttm
rs_imv <- rs_imv[, .(device_category = if (any(device_category %in% "imv")) "imv" else device_category[!is.na(device_category)][1], #Choose imv if combining rows
             n_set = max(n_set)), #Recount after collapse down
         by = .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm)] 
setorder(rs_imv, hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm) #Set in chronologic order


#3) Calculate the row-level signals
rs_imv[, imv_signal := device_category %in% "imv" & n_set >= 2] #IMV signal = imv + 2 settings
rs_imv[, explicit_non_imv := !is.na(device_category) & device_category != "imv"] #Non-imv signal =/= "imv"
#Rows with no device recorded inherit the previous row's IMV signal using LOCF
rs_imv[, imv_signal_locf := fifelse(is.na(device_category), NA, imv_signal)]
rs_imv[, imv_signal_locf := as.logical(nafill(as.integer(imv_signal_locf), type = "locf")), by = hospitalization_id]
rs_imv[is.na(imv_signal_locf), imv_signal_locf := FALSE]

#4) Identify imv_runs
#Function to find runs
find_imv_runs <- function(t, sig, non) {
  t <- as.numeric(t); n <- length(t)
  begin <- end <- numeric(0); nrows <- integer(0); k <- 0L
  in_run <- FALSE; i <- 1L
  while (i <= n) {
    if (!in_run) {
      if (sig[i]) { in_run <- TRUE; s <- t[i]; last <- t[i]; cnt <- 1L; streak <- 0L }
      i <- i + 1L; next
    }
    gap <- (t[i] - last) / 3600 >= gap_end_hours          # checked BEFORE this row can extend the run
    if (sig[i] && !gap) { last <- t[i]; cnt <- cnt + 1L; streak <- 0L
    } else if (non[i]) streak <- streak + 1L
    if (gap || streak >= non_imv_to_end) {
      k <- k + 1L; begin[k] <- s; end[k] <- last; nrows[k] <- cnt; in_run <- FALSE
      if (gap) next                                          # re-check this row: it may start a new run
    }
    i <- i + 1L
  }
  if (in_run) { k <- k + 1L; begin[k] <- s; end[k] <- last; nrows[k] <- cnt }
  list(begin_imv_resp = begin, end_imv = end, n_imv_rows = nrows)
}
imv_runs <- rs_imv[, find_imv_runs(recorded_dttm, imv_signal_locf, explicit_non_imv), by = hospitalization_id]
imv_runs[, `:=`(begin_imv_resp = .POSIXct(begin_imv_resp, tz = time_zone),
                end_imv        = .POSIXct(end_imv,        tz = time_zone))]

#5) Keep real runs, then compute run-level fields on the runs that remain
#Calculate run times
imv_runs[, imv_duration_hours := as.numeric(difftime(end_imv, begin_imv_resp, units = "hours"))]
#Keep only rows with a duration greater than 0 and 3 or more rows of IMV data
imv_runs <- imv_runs[imv_duration_hours > 0 & n_imv_rows >= min_imv_rows]
setorder(imv_runs, hospitalization_id, begin_imv_resp)
#Create run_id
imv_runs[, run_id := seq_len(.N), by = hospitalization_id]
#Calculate time between runs
imv_runs[, time_to_next_imv_hours := as.numeric(difftime(shift(begin_imv_resp, type = "lead"), end_imv, units = "hours")),
         by = hospitalization_id]
#Define Reintubation
imv_runs[, reintubation := as.integer(.N > 1), by = hospitalization_id]
#Put everything in legible order
setcolorder(imv_runs, c("hospitalization_id", "begin_imv_resp", "end_imv", "time_to_next_imv_hours",
                        "imv_duration_hours", "run_id", "n_imv_rows"))

##################################################################################

#Merge each run's own-encounter trach time (used by Rules 1, 2, 4)
imv_runs_merged <- copy(imv_runs)
imv_runs_merged[trach_times, on = "hospitalization_id", trach_this_admission_dttm := i.first_trach_dttm]

#Add encounter details to every run
imv_runs_merged[hospitalization, on = "hospitalization_id",
                `:=`(patient_id              = i.patient_id,
                     admission_dttm          = i.admission_dttm,
                     discharge_dttm          = i.discharge_dttm,
                     age_at_admission        = i.age_at_admission,
                     admission_type_category = i.admission_type_category,
                     discharge_category      = i.discharge_category)]
stopifnot(imv_runs_merged[is.na(discharge_dttm), .N] == 0) # every episode now has discharge info

#Log of trach info for later use in cleaning analysis
trach_flow <- list() #create an empty list
log_trach <- function(step, dt) trach_flow[[length(trach_flow) + 1L]] <<-
  data.table(step = step, runs = nrow(dt), hospitalizations = uniqueN(dt$hospitalization_id))
log_trach("0 merged", imv_runs_merged) #record the starting point
imv_runs_merged[, end_imv_trach_corrected := end_imv[NA_integer_]]   # empty date-time column; Rule 1 fills it

#Rule 1: trach time falls within the run -> cap end_imv at that trach time
imv_runs_merged[!is.na(trach_this_admission_dttm) &
                  trach_this_admission_dttm >= begin_imv_resp &
                  trach_this_admission_dttm <= end_imv,
                end_imv_trach_corrected := trach_this_admission_dttm]

log_trach("1 run end capped at trach time (no runs removed)", imv_runs_merged) #log it
n_capped <- imv_runs_merged[!is.na(end_imv_trach_corrected), .N]    # report this in the flow / methods

#Rule 2: trach before the run begins -> drop
imv_runs_merged_filt <- imv_runs_merged[is.na(trach_this_admission_dttm) | trach_this_admission_dttm >= begin_imv_resp]
log_trach("2 excl. trach before run start", imv_runs_merged_filt) #Log it

#Rule 3: trach in the 6 months before admission -> drop
prior <- enc_trach[trach_any == TRUE, .(patient_id, prior_id = hospitalization_id, trach_known_by)] #Look at enc_trach for previous trach_dttm values
cur   <- enc_trach[, .(patient_id, hospitalization_id, admission_dttm,
                 win_start = admission_dttm - trach_window_days * 86400)] #For every row in enc_trach calculate when 6-months before admission_dttm is (in seconds)
prior_hits <- prior[cur, on = .(patient_id, trach_known_by >= win_start, trach_known_by < admission_dttm),
                    nomatch = 0L, .(hospitalization_id = i.hospitalization_id, prior_id = x.prior_id)] #Match each encounter with the earlier trach events within the window 
prior_trach_ids <- unique(prior_hits$hospitalization_id) #List of IDs
#Filter out the trachs within 6-months
imv_runs_merged_filt <- imv_runs_merged_filt[!hospitalization_id %in% prior_trach_ids]
log_trach("3 excl. trach within 6 months before admission", imv_runs_merged_filt) #log it

#Rule 4: trach within 72 hours of starting IMV -> drop
imv_runs_merged_filt <- imv_runs_merged_filt[is.na(trach_this_admission_dttm) |
                                               abs(as.numeric(difftime(trach_this_admission_dttm, begin_imv_resp, units = "hours"))) > 72]
log_trach("4 excl. trach within 72 h of IMV start", imv_runs_merged_filt) #log it

#Rule 5: missed tracheostomies -> drop 
  #Post-acute destinations where somebody with a trach may go
post_acute_categories <- c(
  "skilled nursing facility (snf)", "acute inpatient rehab facility", "long term care hospital (ltach)",   # CLIF 2.1
  "snf", "acute_ip_rehab", "ltach"                                                                       # CLIF 3.0
)
#Create list of IDs with ICD code of trach without any documented respiratory trach values
dx_untimed_ids <- enc_trach[has_dx & !timed_trach, hospitalization_id]


imv_runs_merged_filt[, `:=`(
  trach_documented = hospitalization_id %in% trach_times$hospitalization_id,   #time-stamped trach this encounter
  ventilated_at_discharge = fcoalesce(end_imv_trach_corrected, end_imv) >= discharge_dttm - 3600,  #still on the vent within 1 h of discharge
  post_acute_dc = tolower(trimws(discharge_category)) %in% post_acute_categories, #evidence of DC to a trach facility
  trach_code_untimed = hospitalization_id %in% dx_untimed_ids                 #trach ICD code, no time-stamped trach
)]

# 5a: IMV run continues to discharge, the patient goes to a post-acute facility, and no trach is documented at any point in hospitalization
imv_runs_merged_filt[, missed_trach_5a := ventilated_at_discharge %in% TRUE & post_acute_dc & !trach_documented]

# 5b: trach diagnosis in this encounter but no time-stamped documentation -> every run in the encounter
imv_runs_merged_filt[, missed_trach_5b := trach_code_untimed]

runs_excluded_5b <- imv_runs_merged_filt[missed_trach_5b & !missed_trach_5a]    #saved for possible sensitivity analysis

imv_runs_merged_filt <- imv_runs_merged_filt[!(missed_trach_5a)] #Filter out rule 5a
log_trach("5a excl. ventilated at discharge to post-acute facility, no trach documented", imv_runs_merged_filt) #log it

imv_runs_merged_filt <- imv_runs_merged_filt[!(missed_trach_5b)] #Filter out rule 5b
log_trach("5b excl. trach diagnosis without time-stamped documentation", imv_runs_merged_filt) #log it

trach_flow <- rbindlist(trach_flow)
trach_flow[, runs_removed := shift(runs) - runs]
print(trach_flow)
fwrite(trach_flow, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("trach_exclusion_flow_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

#Trach audit data
ever_imv_ids <- unique(resp_imv$hospitalization_id)
cohort_ids   <- unique(imv_runs_merged_filt$hospitalization_id)     # after trach rules 2-5b

enc_trach[, trach_evidence := fcase(
  timed_trach & n_times >= min_trach_records,        "timed: 2+ time-stamped records",
  timed_trach & n_times == 1,                        "timed: 1 record confirmed by code",
  !timed_trach & has_dx,                             "code only, no time-stamped record",
  !timed_trach & n_times == 1,                       "single record, no code (artifact, not a trach)",
  default =                                          "no trach evidence")]

trach_audit <- enc_trach[, .(all_encounters      = .N,
                             ever_ventilated     = sum(hospitalization_id %in% ever_imv_ids),
                             in_cohort_post_rules = sum(hospitalization_id %in% cohort_ids)),
                         by = trach_evidence][order(trach_evidence)]
print(trach_audit)

fwrite(trach_audit, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("trach_evidence_audit_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

#Optional, local only: the encounter IDs for the artifact group, for site-based  spot checks
fwrite(enc_trach[trach_evidence == "single record, no code (artifact, not a trach)", .(hospitalization_id)],
       file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("trach_single_record_ids_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

################################################################################


#Now pull patient demographics data for the selected IMV runs
demo_lookup <- patient_demographics[, .(
  patient_id, sex_category, race_category, ethnicity_category, language_category, death_dttm
)]
#Merge imv_runs and the demographic info
imv_runs_merged_filt <- merge(imv_runs_merged_filt, demo_lookup, by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
#Use time_zone from end_imv for further labeling
tz_label <- attr(imv_runs_merged_filt$end_imv, "tzone")

#Create end_imv_death_corrected
  # Death Rule 1: death_dttm has a real time component and falls within THIS run (begin_imv_resp <= death_dttm < end_imv)
imv_runs_merged_filt[, death_has_time := !is.na(death_dttm) & !format(death_dttm, "%H:%M:%S") %in% c("00:00:00", "23:59:00")]

imv_runs_merged_filt[, death_dttm_candidate := as.POSIXct(NA)] #Create empty column
imv_runs_merged_filt[
  death_has_time & death_dttm >= begin_imv_resp & death_dttm < end_imv,
  death_dttm_candidate := death_dttm
] #Fill in death_dttm_candidate only when death_dttm falls within imv run

  # Death Rule 2: discharge_category is expired/hospice and discharge_dttm falls within THIS run
imv_runs_merged_filt[, discharge_death_candidate := as.POSIXct(NA)] #Create empty column
imv_runs_merged_filt[
  tolower(discharge_category) %in% c("expired", "hospice") &
    discharge_dttm >= begin_imv_resp & discharge_dttm < end_imv,
  discharge_death_candidate := discharge_dttm
] #Fill in death_dttm_candidate only when discharge_dttm falls within imv run

# Take the earliest of the two, if either exists
imv_runs_merged_filt[, end_imv_death_corrected :=
  pmin(death_dttm_candidate, discharge_death_candidate, na.rm = TRUE)
] #Create end_imv_death_corrected
imv_runs_merged_filt[, end_imv_death_corrected :=
  lubridate::with_tz(end_imv_death_corrected, tz_label)
]
#Drop unneeded columns
imv_runs_merged_filt[, c("death_has_time", "death_dttm_candidate", "discharge_death_candidate") := NULL]

#Create end_imv_discharge_corrected (bounded to THIS run as well)
imv_runs_merged_filt[, end_imv_discharge_corrected := as.POSIXct(NA)]
imv_runs_merged_filt[
  !is.na(discharge_dttm) & discharge_dttm >= begin_imv_resp & discharge_dttm < end_imv,
  end_imv_discharge_corrected := discharge_dttm
]
imv_runs_merged_filt[, end_imv_discharge_corrected :=
  lubridate::with_tz(end_imv_discharge_corrected, tz_label)
]

#Determine end_obs based off of earliest timestamp from these columns
imv_runs_merged_filt[, end_obs := pmin(end_imv, end_imv_trach_corrected, end_imv_death_corrected,
                                       end_imv_discharge_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)]
imv_runs_merged_filt[, end_imv_source := fcase(
  end_obs == end_imv,                                                          "resp",
  !is.na(end_imv_trach_corrected)     & end_obs == end_imv_trach_corrected,     "trach",
  !is.na(end_imv_death_corrected)     & end_obs == end_imv_death_corrected,     "death/hospice",
  !is.na(end_imv_discharge_corrected) & end_obs == end_imv_discharge_corrected, "discharge")]
stopifnot(imv_runs_merged_filt[end_obs < begin_imv_resp, .N] == 0)

#Name used by Part Three
#imvs_runs_end_imv_corrected <- imv_runs_merged_filt
}
```
