#Part THREE: Identify time of RSI and Infusions associated with intubation and use this data to correct any begin_imv errors
  # Use evidence of RSI or continuous meds only given while intubated
```{r}
if (!use_baseline_cache) {
#Define baseline variables for establishing earlier intubation times
rsi_window_before <- 5      #paralytic may be charted up to 5 min BEFORE the sedative
rsi_window_after  <- 10     #or up to 10 min after
rsi_episode_gap   <- 60     #sedative pushes > 60 min apart start a new RSI episode
drip_gap_hours    <- 6      #infusion charting gap that ends a drip run
begin_lookback_h  <- 1      #RSI/drip may move a run's start earlier by at most this many hours
rsi_sed_groups    <- c("sedation", "anxiolytic")
rsi_para_groups   <- c("paralytic", "paralytics")
drip_meds         <- c("propofol", "cisatracurium", "vecuronium", "rocuronium")
imv_ids <- unique(imv_runs_merged_filt$hospitalization_id) #List of hosp_ids cleaned thus far

#)1 Identify RSI episodes: a sedative push with a paralytic push within -5/+10 min
#Filter intermittent meds
im_rsi <- intermittent_meds[hospitalization_id %in% imv_ids & med_dose > 0 &
                        med_group %in% c(rsi_sed_groups, rsi_para_groups),
                        .(hospitalization_id, admin_dttm, med_group, med_category)]
#Sedative meds
sed  <- im_rsi[med_group %in% rsi_sed_groups,
           .(hospitalization_id, sed_time = admin_dttm, sed_med = med_category,
             win_lo = admin_dttm - rsi_window_before * 60, win_hi = admin_dttm + rsi_window_after * 60)]
#Paralytic meds
para <- im_rsi[med_group %in% rsi_para_groups, .(hospitalization_id, para_time = admin_dttm, para_med = med_category)]
#Identify RSI pairs - merge sed and para
rsi_pairs <- para[sed, on = .(hospitalization_id, para_time >= win_lo, para_time <= win_hi), nomatch = 0L,
                  .(hospitalization_id, sed_time = i.sed_time, sed_med = i.sed_med,
                    para_time = x.para_time, para_med = x.para_med)]
setorder(rsi_pairs, hospitalization_id, sed_time, para_time)
#Calculate the time between Paralytic and Sedative and define episode
rsi_pairs[, episode := cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(as.numeric(sed_time)) > rsi_episode_gap * 60)), by = hospitalization_id]
#Choose earliest pair per episode
rsi_episodes <- rsi_pairs[rsi_pairs[, .I[1], by = .(hospitalization_id, episode)]$V1]

#2) Use drips to identify earlier intubation time
#Filter continuous meds for drips we want
drips <- meds[hospitalization_id %in% imv_ids & tolower(med_category) %in% drip_meds & med_dose > 0,
              .(hospitalization_id, admin_dttm, med_category)]
setorder(drips, hospitalization_id, admin_dttm)
#Define runs of continuous meds
drips[, new_run := is.na(shift(admin_dttm)) |
                   as.numeric(difftime(admin_dttm, shift(admin_dttm), units = "hours")) > drip_gap_hours,
      by = hospitalization_id]
#Give each run a number
drips[, drip_run := cumsum(new_run), by = hospitalization_id]
#Collapse down to one row per infusion run
drip_runs <- drips[, .(begin_drip = min(admin_dttm), end_drip = max(admin_dttm), n_rows = .N,
                       meds_involved = paste(sort(unique(med_category)), collapse = ", ")),
                   by = .(hospitalization_id, drip_run)]

#3) Earliest valid IMV evidence in the hour 
#Create a version of our part 2 result and calculate the earliest window (win_lo)
runs_win <- imv_runs_merged_filt[, .(hospitalization_id, run_id, begin_imv_resp,
                                            win_lo = begin_imv_resp - begin_lookback_h * 3600)]
#Split sed_time and para_time
rsi_times <- rbind(rsi_episodes[, .(hospitalization_id, t = sed_time)],
                   rsi_episodes[, .(hospitalization_id, t = para_time)])
#Determine earliest time within window for either sedative or paralytic
rsi_fix <- rsi_times[runs_win, on = .(hospitalization_id, t >= win_lo, t < begin_imv_resp), nomatch = 0L,
                     .(hospitalization_id, run_id, t = x.t)][, .(begin_imv_rsi_corrected = min(t)),
                                                             by = .(hospitalization_id, run_id)]
#Determine earliest time within window for drip
drip_fix <- drip_runs[runs_win, on = .(hospitalization_id, begin_drip >= win_lo, begin_drip < begin_imv_resp), nomatch = 0L,
                      .(hospitalization_id, run_id, t = x.begin_drip)][, .(begin_imv_drip_corrected = min(t)),
                                                                       by = .(hospitalization_id, run_id)]

#Form total evidence table
all_evidence <- copy(imv_runs_merged_filt)
#Merge in rsi_fix and drip_fix
all_evidence[rsi_fix,  on = .(hospitalization_id, run_id), begin_imv_rsi_corrected  := i.begin_imv_rsi_corrected]
all_evidence[drip_fix, on = .(hospitalization_id, run_id), begin_imv_drip_corrected := i.begin_imv_drip_corrected]
#Verify columns exist - if it doesnt then create it with every column as NA
if (!"begin_imv_rsi_corrected"  %in% names(all_evidence)) all_evidence[, begin_imv_rsi_corrected  := begin_imv_resp[NA_integer_]]
if (!"begin_imv_drip_corrected" %in% names(all_evidence)) all_evidence[, begin_imv_drip_corrected := begin_imv_resp[NA_integer_]]

#Determine begin_obs by choosing the earliest of the begin_imv columns
all_evidence[, begin_obs := pmin(begin_imv_resp, begin_imv_rsi_corrected, begin_imv_drip_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)]
#Document the source for auditing
all_evidence[, begin_imv_source := fcase(
  !is.na(begin_imv_rsi_corrected)  & begin_obs == begin_imv_rsi_corrected,  "rsi",
  !is.na(begin_imv_drip_corrected) & begin_obs == begin_imv_drip_corrected, "drip",
  default = "resp")]
print(all_evidence[, .N, by = begin_imv_source]) #PEAK

################################################################################
# Form the Baseline Table
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs <- all_evidence[, .(
  hospitalization_id,  run_id, begin_obs,  end_obs,  begin_imv_source,  end_imv_source,
  admission_dttm,  discharge_dttm,  admission_type_category,  discharge_category,
  age_at_admission,  sex_category,  race_category,  ethnicity_category,  language_category,
  death_dttm,  reintubation,  trached = as.integer(trach_documented)
)]
setorder(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs, hospitalization_id, begin_obs, end_obs)

#Define minimum run length
min_run_hours <- 1 #runs shorter than this after merging are dropped and not analyzable
#Calculate ns for auditing
n_start <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)
h_start <- uniqueN(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id)

#Merge overlapping runs (an earlier begin_obs can now reach back into a previous run)
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, prev_max_end := shift(cummax(as.numeric(end_obs))), by = hospitalization_id] #Calculate time of current end_obs in seconds
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, episode := cumsum(is.na(prev_max_end) | as.numeric(begin_obs) >= prev_max_end),
                                by = hospitalization_id] #Create episodes of IMV and see if begin_obs for one row comes after the end_obs of another
#Find the latest end of each episode
ep_end <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .(ep_end_obs = max(end_obs),
                                              ep_end_src = end_imv_source[which.max(end_obs)]), #Document the source
                                          by = .(hospitalization_id, episode)]

#Keep only the first row for an episode to help distinguish start times
first_rows <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .I[1], by = .(hospitalization_id, episode)]$V1
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[first_rows]

#Merge with ep_end to also get the greatest end_obs and then re-label
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[ep_end, on = .(hospitalization_id, episode),
                                `:=`(end_obs = i.ep_end_obs, end_imv_source = i.ep_end_src)]
#Drop unnecessary columns
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, c("episode", "prev_max_end") := NULL]
 # Calculate ns for auditing
n_after_merge <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)
h_after_merge <- uniqueN(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id)


####Filter out runs that are shorter than the min_run_hours
 # Calculate run hours
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, run_hrs := as.numeric(difftime(end_obs, begin_obs, units = "hours"))]
print(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(dur = cut(run_hrs, c(-Inf, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 12, 24, Inf)))][order(dur)]) #Peak
stopifnot(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[is.na(run_hrs), .N] == 0) #If there are any NA run_hrs then stop
 # Filter for min_run_hours
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[run_hrs >= min_run_hours]
setorder(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs, hospitalization_id, begin_obs)
 # n for auditing
n_after_min <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)

####Finalize table
 # Number the run of each encounter for reintubation determination
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, run_id := seq_len(.N), by = hospitalization_id]
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, reintubation := as.integer(.N > 1), by = hospitalization_id]

 # Build a permanent run_id for building hourly table later
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, imv_run_id := sprintf("%s_%.0f", hospitalization_id, as.numeric(begin_obs))]

 # Verify every ID is Unique
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$imv_run_id))

#######Create teh full cohort flowchart with trach exclusions and run cleanup
cleanup_flow <- data.table(
  step             = c("6 start of run cleanup", "7 overlapping runs merged", "8 runs >= 1 h (final cohort)"),
  runs             = c(n_start, n_after_merge, n_after_min),
  hospitalizations = c(h_start, h_after_merge, uniqueN(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id)))
cohort_flow <- rbind(trach_flow[, .(step, runs, hospitalizations)], cleanup_flow)
cohort_flow[, runs_removed := shift(runs) - runs]
print(cohort_flow)

#Save it
fwrite(cohort_flow, file.path(project_data_dir, paste0("cohort_flow_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(cohort_flow, file.path(intermediate_dir, "cohort_flow.csv"))   # stable name, readable on cached runs
}
```


# PART FOUR: Establish other baseline patient characteristics
  # Height [x]
  # Weight [x]
  # Elixhauser [x]
  # Location of intubation [x]
  # Hospital type - academic vs community [x]
  # Are there any other features that we need to consider for patient removal? Leaving people in regardless of missing features or length of IMV as long as it's real. I suppose we can cut people with less than 1 hour of IMV? Can calculate how many of those there are
```{r}
if (!use_baseline_cache) {
################################################################################
# PART FOUR: HEIGHT
################################################################################

#Set baseline tolerance, high and low ambiguous values, review range, etc
tol_cm          <- 7.5      # two hospitalizations "agree" on a height if within this many cm
amb_lo          <- 30       # raw values in [amb_lo, amb_hi) could be inches OR 2-digit feet-inches
amb_hi          <- 85       # shorthand (e.g., 54 = 5'4")
ft_digit_range  <- c(4, 6)  # plausible adult feet digit when reading a 2-digit value as feet+inches
review_range_cm <- 10       # flag patients whose hospitalization heights still differ by more than this
big_gap_cm      <- 20       # patients with a gap larger than this get the typo / unexplained-gap checks
height_upstream_inches <- NA   # NA = detect automatically; TRUE/FALSE to force it for a site

#1) Pull all of the cohort hospitalizations, define cohort admission_dttm and +/-12 month windows
cohort_hosp_ids <- unique(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id)

cohort_hosp <- hospitalization[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hosp_ids,
  .(patient_id,
    cohort_hospitalization_id = hospitalization_id,
    cohort_admission_dttm     = admission_dttm)]
cohort_hosp[, cohort_admission_dttm := as.POSIXct(cohort_admission_dttm, tz = time_zone)]
cohort_hosp[, `12_months_after`  := add_with_rollback(cohort_admission_dttm, months(12))]
cohort_hosp[, `12_months_before` := add_with_rollback(cohort_admission_dttm, months(-12))]
#List of all cohort patient_id values
cohort_patients <- unique(cohort_hosp[, .(patient_id)])

#All hospitalizations for cohort patients that fall within +/-12 months of a cohort admission
all_pat_hosp <- hospitalization[patient_id %in% cohort_hosp$patient_id,
  .(hospitalization_id, patient_id, admission_dttm)]
#Merge all hospitalizations with window values and filter
pat_hosp_window <- merge(all_pat_hosp, cohort_hosp, by = "patient_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
pat_hosp_window <- pat_hosp_window[
  admission_dttm >= `12_months_before` & admission_dttm <= `12_months_after`
]
window_hosp_ids <- unique(pat_hosp_window$hospitalization_id) #hospitalization_ids within window

#2) Pull raw height readings from all hospitalizations within window
height_vitals <- vitals[
  vital_category == "height_cm" & hospitalization_id %in% window_hosp_ids & !is.na(vital_value),
  .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, height_raw = vital_value)
]
height_vitals <- unique(height_vitals)
#Merge to also add in patient_id
height_vitals <- merge(height_vitals, hospitalization[, .(hospitalization_id, patient_id)],
                       by = "hospitalization_id")

#3A) Raw distribution diagnostics - quick visualization while building the code
quantile(height_vitals$height_raw, probs = c(0, .001, .01, .05, .5, .95, .99, .999, 1))
print(height_vitals[height_raw < 100, .N,
  by = .(bucket = cut(height_raw, breaks = c(-Inf, 1, 3, 9, 30, 55, 85, 100)))][order(bucket)])
print(height_vitals[height_raw > 250, .N,
  by = .(bucket = cut(height_raw, breaks = c(250, 300, 500, 1000, 3000, Inf)))][order(bucket)])
print(height_vitals[height_raw > 3 & height_raw < 30, .N, by = .(as_typed = round(height_raw / 2.54, 2))][order(-N)][1:20])

#3B)
#Undo the upstream inches->cm conversion to see what was typed (e.g., 14.22 cm -> 5.6)
height_vitals[, typed_in  := round(height_raw / 2.54, 2)]
height_vitals[, ftin_frac := round((typed_in - floor(typed_in)) * 100)]                   # 5.6 -> 60, 5.11 -> 11, 5.1 -> 10
height_vitals[, ftin_in   := fifelse(ftin_frac %% 10 == 0, ftin_frac / 10, ftin_frac)]    # inches: 60 -> 6, 11 -> 11

#3C)
#Detect whether this site's heights were entered in inches and converted to cm upstream:
  # if so, most plausible readings are whole inches x 2.54 (e.g., 170.18 = 67 in)
plaus     <- height_vitals[height_raw >= 100 & height_raw <= 250, height_raw]
pct_whole <- mean(abs(plaus / 2.54 - round(plaus / 2.54)) < 0.025)      # 0.025 in allows for rounding to 0.1 cm
if (is.na(height_upstream_inches)) height_upstream_inches <- pct_whole > 0.5
message(sprintf("Heights at whole-inch values: %.1f%% -> upstream inches conversion assumed: %s",
                100 * pct_whole, height_upstream_inches))

#4) Classify each reading by what it most plausibly is using fcase
height_vitals[, unit_class := fcase(
  height_raw >= 100  & height_raw <= 250,  "cm", #values in this range are most likely true cm readings
  height_raw >= 1    & height_raw <= 2.5,  "meters", #values in this range may be meters
  !height_upstream_inches & height_raw >= 4 & height_raw < 8, "decimal_feet",     #values in this range may be meters
  height_upstream_inches & height_raw >= 9 & height_raw < 30 &                    #upstream-converted sites only
    floor(typed_in) >= ft_digit_range[1] & floor(typed_in) <= ft_digit_range[2] &
    !ftin_frac %in% c(0, 10) & ftin_in <= 11, "ftin_in_inches_field",
  height_raw >= 1000 & height_raw <= 2500, "decimal_shift", #values here could be transposition e.g. 1750 meant 175.0
  height_raw >= 400  & height_raw <= 711 &
    abs(height_raw - round(height_raw)) < 1e-6 &
    (round(height_raw) %% 100) <= 11,      "feet_inches_3digit", #values here may be feet with inches written out e.g. 510 = 5'10"
  height_raw >= amb_lo & height_raw < amb_hi, "ambiguous", #values here are truly ambiguous - inches vs 2-digit feet-inches
  default = "unusable" #default to using unusable if a value does not fall within one of these ranges
)]

#Define conversion factors for unit_class values defined above and create new column
height_vitals[, height_cm_conv := fcase(
  unit_class == "cm",                   height_raw,
  unit_class == "meters",               height_raw * 100,
  unit_class == "decimal_feet",         height_raw * 30.48,                                    # raw-unit sites only
  unit_class == "ftin_in_inches_field", (floor(typed_in) * 12 + ftin_in) * 2.54,               # upstream-converted sites only
  unit_class == "decimal_shift",        height_raw / 10,
  unit_class == "feet_inches_3digit",   ((floor(height_raw / 100) * 12) + (round(height_raw) %% 100)) * 2.54,
  default = NA_real_
)]
height_vitals[, c("typed_in", "ftin_frac", "ftin_in") := NULL]   # helper columns no longer needed

#Audit of the unit class for later analysis
audit_unit_class <- height_vitals[, .(n_readings = .N, n_patients = uniqueN(patient_id)), by = unit_class][order(-n_readings)]
print(audit_unit_class) #peak

#)5 Choose one value per hospitalization
  # Rule 1: Hospitalizations without any unambiguous/unusable reading use the median of those readings
hosp_trusted <- height_vitals[!unit_class %in% c("ambiguous", "unusable"),
  .(hosp_height_cm = median(height_cm_conv), n_obs = .N),
  by = .(patient_id, hospitalization_id)]

  # Rule 2: Hospitalizations with ONLY ambiguous readings keep the median raw value for now
hosp_ambiguous <- height_vitals[unit_class == "ambiguous" &
                                  !hospitalization_id %in% hosp_trusted$hospitalization_id,
  .(raw_med = median(height_raw), n_obs = .N),
  by = .(patient_id, hospitalization_id)]

#)6 Resolve ambiguous hospitalizations by cross-hospitalization consensus
  # For hosp where all heights are ambiguous create inches candidate values
cand_inches <- hosp_ambiguous[,
  .(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cand_cm = raw_med * 2.54, family = "inches")]

#Now create foot-inch candidate values if values are within range defined above
cand_ftin <- hosp_ambiguous[
  abs(raw_med - round(raw_med)) < 1e-6 & #The median must be a whole number
    floor(round(raw_med) / 10) >= ft_digit_range[1] &
    floor(round(raw_med) / 10) <= ft_digit_range[2],
  .(patient_id, hospitalization_id,
    cand_cm = ((floor(round(raw_med) / 10) * 12) + (round(raw_med) %% 10)) * 2.54,
    family  = "feet_inches")
]
#Patients with at least one ambiguous hospitalization
amb_patients <- unique(hosp_ambiguous$patient_id)
#Merge trusted and ambiguous heights for ambiguous patients 
all_cands <- rbindlist(list(
  hosp_trusted[patient_id %in% amb_patients,
               .(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cand_cm = hosp_height_cm, family = "trusted")],
  cand_inches,
  cand_ftin
))
#Define function to help resolve which heights we should use
resolve_patient <- function(d) {
  vals    <- unique(d$cand_cm) #all of the distinct values for the patient
  support <- vapply(vals, function(v) uniqueN(d$hospitalization_id[abs(d$cand_cm - v) <= tol_cm]), integer(1)) #Count how many candidate values are within our tolerance
  best    <- vals[support == max(support)] #Find the value that has the most support (ties are allowed)
  trusted_vals <- d$cand_cm[d$family == "trusted"] #Now pull the trusted height if it exists
  #Now determine consensus height
  consensus <- if (diff(range(best)) <= tol_cm) { #If the top values are all within the tol_cm - take their median
    median(best)
  } else if (length(trusted_vals) > 0) { #If they have trusted values use whichever is closest to median trusted height
    best[which.min(abs(best - median(trusted_vals)))]
  } else { #Otherwise leave them as NA
    NA_real_ 
  }

  d <- copy(d) #make a private copy so we don't change shared table
  d[, dist := abs(cand_cm - consensus)] #determine distance from candidate and consensus
  setorder(d, hospitalization_id, dist, na.last = TRUE) #Order by distance, if no consensus then NA
  out <- d[, .SD[1], by = hospitalization_id] #Choose first row as it is closest
  out[, chosen_cm := fifelse(family == "trusted" | (!is.na(dist) & dist <= tol_cm), cand_cm, NA_real_)] #If the chosen is trusted or within tol_cm then keep it, otherwise NA
  out[, .(hospitalization_id, chosen_cm, family)] #Return only one row per encounter
}

resolved <- all_cands[, resolve_patient(.SD), by = patient_id] #run the function on the ambiguous values
resolved[, source := fifelse(is.na(chosen_cm), "unresolved", family)] #if still NA then label it as unresolved

hosp_height <- rbindlist(list(
  hosp_trusted[!patient_id %in% amb_patients,
               .(patient_id, hospitalization_id, hosp_height_cm = hosp_height_cm, source = "trusted")],
  resolved[, .(patient_id, hospitalization_id, hosp_height_cm = chosen_cm, source)]
))

print(hosp_height[, .N, by = source])   # audit: how did ambiguous hospitalizations resolve?

#7) Preliminary median of medians (used to find big-gap patients)
 # Function that returns TRUE if a height isn't missing and lies between 100 and 250
height_ok <- function(x) !is.na(x) & x >= 100 & x <= 250

#Create summary for each patient - keep only plausible heights and one row per encounter
patient_height_prelim <- hosp_height[height_ok(hosp_height_cm),
  .(median_height   = median(hosp_height_cm),
    n_hosp          = .N,
    height_range_cm = max(hosp_height_cm) - min(hosp_height_cm)),
  by = patient_id]

print(patient_height_prelim[height_range_cm > big_gap_cm, .N])

#)8 Correct feet-inches typos and neutralize unexplained gaps
# Safety net for sites that convert inches to cm
big_gap_ids <- patient_height_prelim[height_range_cm > big_gap_cm, patient_id] #Identify patients with big gaps in their height data

#Summarize each of these patients - lowest and highest plausible heights, # of encounters, and extremes converted to inches
chk <- hosp_height[patient_id %in% big_gap_ids & height_ok(hosp_height_cm),
  .(lo_cm = min(hosp_height_cm), hi_cm = max(hosp_height_cm), n_hosp = .N),
  by = patient_id]
chk[, lo_in := lo_cm / 2.54]
chk[, hi_in := hi_cm / 2.54]

#Read the low value's digits as feet+inches (54 in -> 5'4" = 64 in); typo if that matches the high value
chk[, lo_as_ftin := floor(round(lo_in) / 10) * 12 + round(lo_in) %% 10] #Convert the low value to feet+inches then convert to inches
chk[, ftin_match := floor(round(lo_in) / 10) >= ft_digit_range[1] &
                    floor(round(lo_in) / 10) <= ft_digit_range[2] &
                    abs(lo_as_ftin - hi_in) <= 1.5] #Check to see if the conversion fixed it

print(chk[, .N, by = .(ftin_match, n_hosp_3plus = n_hosp >= 3)])   #audit: breakdown of big-gap patients

hosp_height[, hosp_height_cm_orig := hosp_height_cm] #Copy the height before any changes were made
hosp_height[, height_adjustment   := NA_character_] #Record the changes made for auditing

  # (a) Confirmed feet-inches typos: test EVERY encounter of a big-gap patient, not just the lowest one
hosp_height[chk[, .(patient_id, hi_in)], on = "patient_id", hi_in := i.hi_in]
hosp_height[, own_in   := round(hosp_height_cm / 2.54)]                       #this encounter's height in whole inches
hosp_height[, own_ftin := floor(own_in / 10) * 12 + own_in %% 10]             #read the encounter's digits as feet+inches
hosp_height[!is.na(hi_in) & !is.na(hosp_height_cm) &
              floor(own_in / 10) >= ft_digit_range[1] & floor(own_in / 10) <= ft_digit_range[2] &
              own_in < hi_in - 3 &                                              #only values clearly below the high value
              abs(own_ftin - hi_in) <= 1.5,
            `:=`(hosp_height_cm = own_ftin * 2.54, height_adjustment = "ftin_typo_corrected")]
hosp_height[, c("hi_in", "own_in", "own_ftin") := NULL]

  # Patients with at least one confirmed typo (used in part b and the audit)
typo_ids <- unique(hosp_height[height_adjustment %in% "ftin_typo_corrected", patient_id])
chk[, ftin_match := patient_id %in% typo_ids]

  # (b) Unexplained big gap with only 2 hospitalizations: the median would just average two
    # conflicting values so we will set to NA and let sex-median imputation handle the patient
unexplained_2_ids <- chk[ftin_match == FALSE & n_hosp == 2, patient_id]
hosp_height[patient_id %in% unexplained_2_ids,
  `:=`(hosp_height_cm = NA_real_, height_adjustment = "unexplained_gap_set_na")] #Document it for later auditing

#)9 Final median of medians
  # Create final summary for each patient - keep only plausible heights and one row per encounter
patient_height <- hosp_height[height_ok(hosp_height_cm),
  .(median_height   = median(hosp_height_cm),
    n_hosp          = .N,
    height_range_cm = max(hosp_height_cm) - min(hosp_height_cm)),
  by = patient_id]

print(patient_height[height_range_cm > big_gap_cm, .N])      #should drop vs. the preliminary count
patient_height[height_range_cm > review_range_cm, .N]        #remaining likely measurement noise

#)10. Patient-level audit table + sex-based median imputation
  # Set flags for number of readings, conversions, etc per patient (from the unit classification)
pt_unit <- height_vitals[, .(
  n_readings    = .N,
    n_converted = sum(unit_class %in% c("meters", "decimal_feet", "decimal_shift",
                                      "feet_inches_3digit", "ftin_in_inches_field")),
  n_ambiguous   = sum(unit_class == "ambiguous"),
  n_unusable    = sum(unit_class == "unusable")
), by = patient_id]

  # Hospitalization-level flags per patient - make TRUE/FALSE statements for each
    # This may be less rows than pt_unit if patients have height_cm values but none are usable
pt_flags <- hosp_height[, .(
  ambiguous_resolved     = any(source %in% c("inches", "feet_inches")),
  ambiguous_unresolved   = any(source == "unresolved"),
  ftin_typo_corrected    = any(height_adjustment %in% "ftin_typo_corrected"),
  unexplained_gap_set_na = any(height_adjustment %in% "unexplained_gap_set_na")
), by = patient_id]

#Create audit table
audit_patient <- merge(cohort_patients, patient_height, by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
audit_patient <- merge(audit_patient,
  patient_height_prelim[, .(patient_id, height_range_cm_prelim = height_range_cm)],
  by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
audit_patient <- merge(audit_patient, patient_demographics[, .(patient_id, sex_category)],
  by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
audit_patient <- merge(audit_patient, pt_unit,  by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
audit_patient <- merge(audit_patient, pt_flags, by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)

# Patients with no height data at all have NA flags: treat as FALSE / 0
for (col in c("ambiguous_resolved", "ambiguous_unresolved", "ftin_typo_corrected", "unexplained_gap_set_na")) {
  set(audit_patient, which(is.na(audit_patient[[col]])), col, FALSE)
}
for (col in c("n_readings", "n_converted", "n_ambiguous", "n_unusable")) {
  set(audit_patient, which(is.na(audit_patient[[col]])), col, 0L)
}

audit_patient[, height_imputed := is.na(median_height)] #Create a column for tracking imputed heights

#Imputation values come from patients with a real (non-imputed) height, one value per patient
  # Determine median height by sex_category
sex_median_height <- audit_patient[height_imputed == FALSE & tolower(sex_category) %in% c("male", "female"),
  .(sex_med = median(median_height)), by = sex_category]
  # Calculate overall median height - used as a backup for people with missing or unknown sex_category
overall_median_height <- audit_patient[height_imputed == FALSE, median(median_height)]

#Join sex medians onto every patient by sex category
audit_patient[sex_median_height, on = "sex_category", sex_med := i.sex_med]

#Record how each height was imputed for auditing
audit_patient[, imputed_with := fcase(
  !height_imputed,     NA_character_,
  !is.na(sex_med),     "sex_median",
  default =            "overall_median"
)]
#Set the final height
audit_patient[, height_cm_final := fcase(
  !height_imputed,     median_height,
  !is.na(sex_med),     sex_med,
  default =            overall_median_height
)]
#Final audit trail for how height was measured - each patient gets one label
audit_patient[, height_status := fcase(
  height_imputed & unexplained_gap_set_na, "imputed_unexplained_gap",
  height_imputed,                          "imputed_no_valid_data",
  ftin_typo_corrected,                     "measured_typo_corrected",
  default =                                "measured"
)]
#Flag for review if heights still differ by more than 10cm after cleaning
audit_patient[, review_flag := !is.na(height_range_cm) & height_range_cm > review_range_cm]
audit_patient[, sex_med := NULL] #Drop sex_med

#)11 Attach height data to baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs
old_cols <- intersect(c("height_cm", "height_imputed", "height_status", "n_height_hosp", "height_range_cm"),
                      names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))
if (length(old_cols)) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, (old_cols) := NULL]

hosp_to_pat <- merge(
  hospitalization[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hosp_ids, .(hospitalization_id, patient_id)],
  audit_patient[, .(patient_id, height_cm = height_cm_final, height_imputed, height_status,
                    n_height_hosp = n_hosp, height_range_cm)],
  by = "patient_id"
)

# Update-join keeps row order; the same height is intentionally repeated across a hospitalization's runs
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[hosp_to_pat, on = "hospitalization_id",
  `:=`(height_cm = i.height_cm, height_imputed = i.height_imputed, height_status = i.height_status,
       n_height_hosp = i.n_height_hosp, height_range_cm = i.height_range_cm)]

baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[is.na(height_cm), .N]   # should be 0

#)12 Create final height audit summary and save it
n_pat  <- nrow(audit_patient)
n_runs <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)

height_audit_summary <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "cohort_patients",                       n = n_pat),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "height_measured",                       n = audit_patient[height_imputed == FALSE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "height_imputed_total",                  n = audit_patient[height_imputed == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "imputed_no_valid_data",                 n = audit_patient[height_status == "imputed_no_valid_data", .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "imputed_unexplained_gap",               n = audit_patient[height_status == "imputed_unexplained_gap", .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "imputed_with_sex_median",               n = audit_patient[imputed_with %in% "sex_median", .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "imputed_with_overall_median",           n = audit_patient[imputed_with %in% "overall_median", .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "any_reading_unit_converted",            n = audit_patient[n_converted > 0, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "ambiguous_reading_resolved",            n = audit_patient[ambiguous_resolved == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "ambiguous_reading_unresolved",          n = audit_patient[ambiguous_unresolved == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "ftin_typo_corrected",                   n = audit_patient[ftin_typo_corrected == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "unexplained_gap_set_na",                n = audit_patient[unexplained_gap_set_na == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = "multi_hospitalization_height",          n = audit_patient[n_hosp > 1, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = paste0("range_gt_", review_range_cm, "cm_final"), n = audit_patient[review_flag == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "patient", metric = paste0("range_gt_", big_gap_cm, "cm_final"),     n = audit_patient[height_range_cm > big_gap_cm, .N]),
  data.table(level = "run",     metric = "imv_runs_total",                        n = n_runs),
  data.table(level = "run",     metric = "imv_runs_height_imputed",               n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[height_imputed == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "run",     metric = "imv_runs_typo_corrected",               n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[height_status == "measured_typo_corrected", .N])
))
height_audit_summary[, denominator := fifelse(level == "patient", n_pat, n_runs)]
height_audit_summary[, pct := round(100 * n / denominator, 2)]
print(height_audit_summary)

# Row-level detail of every height value that was changed (before/after)
height_adjustments_detail <- hosp_height[!is.na(height_adjustment),
  .(patient_id, hospitalization_id, height_adjustment,
    hosp_height_cm_before = hosp_height_cm_orig, hosp_height_cm_after = hosp_height_cm)]

# HEIGHT: keep summary + unit-class counts in audit_dir; row-level files go local
fwrite(height_audit_summary,      file.path(audit_dir,        paste0("height_audit_summary_",      stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(audit_unit_class,          file.path(audit_dir,        paste0("height_audit_unit_class_",   stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(audit_patient,             file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("height_audit_patient_",      stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(height_adjustments_detail, file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("height_adjustments_detail_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(sex_category, height_status)][order(sex_category, height_status)]

################################################################################
# PART FOUR: WEIGHT
################################################################################

# Set the parameters and ranges we allow
wt_lo         <- 35     # plausible low adult weight after conversion (kg)
wt_hi         <- 450    # widened from 300 so real super obese patients are not rejected
wt_tol_ratio  <- 1.35   # a reading "agrees" with the anchor if within this ratio (1.35 = +/-35%)
wt_stale_days <- 30     # flag if the chosen reading is further than this from admission
bmi_lo        <- 12     # BMI plausibility screen low (flag only, never changes a value)
bmi_hi        <- 80     # BMI plausible max
fb_bmi_lo     <- 15     # Low BMI window used by the fallback to accept an interpretation
fb_bmi_hi     <- 60     # Max BMI window

# Candidate interpretations of a recorded "kg" value. The CLIF value may have been converted
# upstream, so each row says what the entered value might really have been:
#   as_recorded     : value is already correct kg
#   lbs_in_kg_field : lbs typed into a field read as kg                    -> kg = x / 2.20462
#   kg_in_lb_field  : kg typed into a lbs field, then divided by 2.2       -> kg = x * 2.20462
#   lbs_in_oz_field : lbs typed into an oz field, then oz->kg (/35.274)     -> kg = x * 16
#   kg_in_oz_field  : kg typed into an oz field, then oz->kg                -> kg = x * 35.274
#   oz_in_kg_field  : ounces never converted                                -> kg = x / 35.274
#   decimal_x10 / decimal_div10 : missing or extra digit
# Grams can be added the same way (e.g., mult = 0.035274 for grams in an oz field).
interp_tbl <- data.table(
  interp = c("as_recorded", "lbs_in_kg_field", "kg_in_lb_field", "lbs_in_oz_field",
             "kg_in_oz_field", "oz_in_kg_field", "decimal_x10", "decimal_div10"),
  mult   = c(1, 1/2.20462, 2.20462, 16, 35.274, 1/35.274, 10, 0.1)
)
interp_tbl[, prior := .I]   # tie-break order only

#)1 Cohort hospitalizations and +/-12 month windows - same as for height
win_pairs <- pat_hosp_window[, .(patient_id, cohort_hospitalization_id, cohort_admission_dttm, hospitalization_id)]

#)2 Pull raw weight readings (no averaging of same-timestamp readings)
wt_raw <- vitals[
  vital_category == "weight_kg" & hospitalization_id %in% win_pairs$hospitalization_id & !is.na(vital_value),
  .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, wt_raw = vital_value)
]
wt_raw <- unique(wt_raw)
wt_raw[, reading_id := .I] #Create a reading_id

#)3 Raw distribution diagnostics - use during building of code for info
quantile(wt_raw$wt_raw, probs = c(0, .001, .01, .05, .5, .95, .99, .999, 1))
weight_audit_raw_buckets <- wt_raw[, .(n_readings = .N),
  by = .(bucket = cut(wt_raw, breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 2, 9, 19, 35, 77, 300, 450, 1000, 10000, Inf)))][order(bucket)]
print(weight_audit_raw_buckets)   # 35-77 = kg only; 77-300 = kg or lbs; 2-19 = oz-conversion errors; 450+ = typos

#Check plausibility
  plaus_w <- wt_raw[wt_raw >= wt_lo & wt_raw <= wt_hi, wt_raw]
  print(c(whole_oz  = mean(abs(plaus_w * 35.274  - round(plaus_w * 35.274))  < 0.05),
          whole_lb  = mean(abs(plaus_w * 2.20462 - round(plaus_w * 2.20462)) < 0.01),
          whole_kg  = mean(abs(plaus_w - round(plaus_w)) < 0.01)))

#)4 Expand each reading into its plausible interpretations using interp_tbl function
wt_cand <- wt_raw[, .(reading_id, hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, wt_raw, k = 1L)][
  interp_tbl[, .(interp, prior, mult, k = 1L)], on = "k", allow.cartesian = TRUE][
  , kg_cand := wt_raw * mult][kg_cand >= wt_lo & kg_cand <= wt_hi][, c("k", "mult") := NULL][]

print(wt_cand[, .N, by = interp][order(-N)])

#)5 Anchor per cohort hospitalization: median of per-hospitalization medians
 # Evidence = readings that are plausible AS RECORDED, so the anchor can't be pulled around by the conversion candidates themselves
  # Merge candidate weights with the hospitalization_id info
anchor_base <- merge(
  wt_cand[interp == "as_recorded", .(hospitalization_id, kg_cand)],
  win_pairs[, .(cohort_hospitalization_id, hospitalization_id)],
  by = "hospitalization_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
# Determine the median of the kg_cand for each hospitalization/cohort_hospitalization combo
hosp_med  <- anchor_base[, .(hosp_med_kg = median(kg_cand)),
                         by = .(cohort_hospitalization_id, hospitalization_id)]
# Develop anchor for each cohort_hospitalization_id using median of individual medians
wt_anchor <- hosp_med[, .(anchor_kg          = median(hosp_med_kg),
                          n_anchor_hosp      = .N, #How many encounters contributed to the median
                          anchor_range_ratio = max(hosp_med_kg) / min(hosp_med_kg)), #Ratio between heaviest and lightest encounter medians
                      by = cohort_hospitalization_id]

#)6 Decide how to interpret every weight reading using anchor and tolerance
# Readings with no interpretation inside tolerance are dropped as unexplained (counted in the audit)
  # Merge wt_cand and win_pairs to pair each candidate weight to every cohort encounter within the window
wt_resolve <- merge(wt_cand,
  win_pairs[, .(patient_id, cohort_hospitalization_id, cohort_admission_dttm, hospitalization_id)],
  by = "hospitalization_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
  # Merge the anchor information - if a cohort has no anchor then it drops out here and is imputed later
wt_resolve <- merge(wt_resolve, wt_anchor[, .(cohort_hospitalization_id, anchor_kg)],
                    by = "cohort_hospitalization_id")
  # Use ratio scale to determine distance between the candidate weight and anchor weight
wt_resolve[, abs_log_ratio := abs(log(kg_cand / anchor_kg))]
  # Filter only for weights within the previously set wt_tol_ratio
wt_resolve <- wt_resolve[abs_log_ratio <= log(wt_tol_ratio)]
setorder(wt_resolve, cohort_hospitalization_id, reading_id, abs_log_ratio, prior)
  # Filter only for unique weights and rename variables
wt_clean <- unique(wt_resolve, by = c("cohort_hospitalization_id", "reading_id"))
setnames(wt_clean, "hospitalization_id", "source_hospitalization_id")

print(wt_clean[, .N, by = interp][order(-N)])                         

#)7 Determine baseline weight defined as cleaned reading closest to cohort admission
  # Calculate absolute time from admission to weight recording
wt_clean[, secs_from_adm := as.numeric(difftime(recorded_dttm, cohort_admission_dttm, units = "secs"))]
wt_clean[, abs_secs := abs(secs_from_adm)]
setorder(wt_clean, cohort_hospitalization_id, abs_secs, recorded_dttm, reading_id)
  # Set up admission weight table
admission_weight <- unique(wt_clean, by = "cohort_hospitalization_id")[, .(
  hospitalization_id   = cohort_hospitalization_id,
  weight_kg_clean      = kg_cand,
  weight_raw           = wt_raw,
  weight_interp        = interp,
  weight_source_hosp   = source_hospitalization_id,
  weight_recorded_dttm = recorded_dttm,
  weight_days_from_adm = secs_from_adm / 86400 #Convert seconds back to days
)]

#)7b Fallback for unanchored cohort hospitalizations: choose interpretation by BMI
# Cohorts with no reading plausible as recorded have no anchor (e.g., kg typed into a lbs field
# and divided by 2.2 gives ~22-35 kg). Use final height to pick the interpretation, accepting
# one ONLY if it is the single interpretation giving a plausible weight AND BMI. Otherwise the
# cohort stays unresolved and is imputed.
n_fallback_rescued <- 0L
if (all(c("height_cm", "height_imputed") %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))) {

  unanch_ids <- setdiff(cohort_hosp$cohort_hospitalization_id, admission_weight$hospitalization_id)

  fb_hgt <- unique(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[
    hospitalization_id %in% unanch_ids & height_imputed == FALSE,
    .(hospitalization_id, height_cm)])

  fb_med <- merge(
    win_pairs[cohort_hospitalization_id %in% fb_hgt$hospitalization_id,
              .(cohort_hospitalization_id, hospitalization_id)],
    wt_raw, by = "hospitalization_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE
  )[, .(raw_med = median(wt_raw)), by = cohort_hospitalization_id]

  if (nrow(fb_med) > 0) {
    fb_med[, k := 1L]
    fb_cand <- merge(fb_med, interp_tbl[, .(interp, mult, k = 1L)], by = "k", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
    fb_cand[, kg_cand := raw_med * mult]
    fb_cand <- merge(fb_cand, fb_hgt, by.x = "cohort_hospitalization_id", by.y = "hospitalization_id")
    fb_cand[, bmi := kg_cand / (height_cm / 100)^2]

    fb_pick <- fb_cand[kg_cand >= wt_lo & kg_cand <= wt_hi & bmi >= fb_bmi_lo & bmi <= fb_bmi_hi
                       ][, if (.N == 1) .SD, by = cohort_hospitalization_id]

    if (nrow(fb_pick) > 0) {
      fb_add <- fb_pick[, .(hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id,
                            weight_kg_clean = kg_cand, weight_raw = raw_med,
                            weight_interp = paste0("bmi_fallback_", interp))]
      admission_weight <- rbind(admission_weight, fb_add, fill = TRUE)
      n_fallback_rescued <- nrow(fb_add)
    }
  }
}
print(n_fallback_rescued)   # how many unanchored cohort hospitalizations were rescued by BMI

#)7c. BMI veto: undo a conversion that makes BMI implausible when the recorded value was fine
if (all(c("height_cm", "height_imputed") %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))) {
  veto_h <- unique(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[height_imputed == FALSE, .(hospitalization_id, height_cm)])
  admission_weight <- merge(admission_weight, veto_h, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  admission_weight[, `:=`(bmi_conv = weight_kg_clean / (height_cm / 100)^2,
                          bmi_orig = weight_raw      / (height_cm / 100)^2)]
  admission_weight[, bmi_veto := weight_interp != "as_recorded" & !is.na(height_cm) &
                     (bmi_conv < fb_bmi_lo | bmi_conv > fb_bmi_hi) &
                     bmi_orig >= fb_bmi_lo & bmi_orig <= fb_bmi_hi &
                     weight_raw >= wt_lo & weight_raw <= wt_hi]
  admission_weight[bmi_veto == TRUE, `:=`(weight_kg_clean = weight_raw, weight_interp = "as_recorded_bmi_veto")]
  admission_weight[, c("height_cm", "bmi_conv", "bmi_orig") := NULL]
  admission_weight[, .N, by = bmi_veto]
}
print(admission_weight[, .N, by = bmi_veto])  
print(admission_weight[, .N, by = weight_interp][order(-N)])         

#)8 Create Cohort-level audit table + flags
audit_weight <- cohort_hosp[, .(patient_id, hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id)]
audit_weight <- merge(audit_weight, patient_demographics[, .(patient_id, sex_category)],
                      by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)
 # Calculate # of raw readings per hospitalization_id 
n_raw <- merge(win_pairs[, .(cohort_hospitalization_id, hospitalization_id)],
               wt_raw[, .(hospitalization_id, reading_id)],
               by = "hospitalization_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)[
  , .(n_raw_readings = .N), by = .(hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id)]
 # Calculate # of clean weight readings per hospitalization_id
n_clean <- wt_clean[, .(n_clean_readings = .N, n_reinterpreted = sum(interp != "as_recorded")),
                    by = .(hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id)]
 # Create anchor table
anchor_tbl <- wt_anchor[, .(hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id,
                            anchor_kg, n_anchor_hosp, anchor_range_ratio)]
 # Combine the five tables into one audit table, one row per cohort encounter
audit_weight <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE),
                       list(audit_weight, n_raw, n_clean, anchor_tbl, admission_weight))
 # Set NA values to 0 in audit_weight
for (col in c("n_raw_readings", "n_clean_readings", "n_reinterpreted")) {
  set(audit_weight, which(is.na(audit_weight[[col]])), col, 0L)
}
print(audit_weight[, lapply(.SD, function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
                   .SDcols = c("n_raw_readings", "n_clean_readings", "n_reinterpreted")])
 # Create TRUE/FALSE flags for weights that required fixing for auditing
audit_weight[, unanchored      := is.na(anchor_kg) & n_raw_readings > 0]
audit_weight[, anchor_conflict := !is.na(anchor_range_ratio) & anchor_range_ratio > wt_tol_ratio^2]
audit_weight[, weight_stale    := !is.na(weight_days_from_adm) & abs(weight_days_from_adm) > wt_stale_days]
audit_weight[, weight_imputed  := is.na(weight_kg_clean)]

#)9 Sex-based median imputation (one value per cohort hospitalization) - same approach as height
sex_median_wt <- audit_weight[weight_imputed == FALSE & tolower(sex_category) %in% c("male", "female"),
  .(sex_med = median(weight_kg_clean)), by = sex_category]
overall_median_wt <- audit_weight[weight_imputed == FALSE, median(weight_kg_clean)]

audit_weight[sex_median_wt, on = "sex_category", sex_med := i.sex_med]
audit_weight[, imputed_with := fcase(
  !weight_imputed,   NA_character_,
  !is.na(sex_med),   "sex_median",
  default =          "overall_median")]
audit_weight[, weight_kg_final := fcase(
  !weight_imputed,   weight_kg_clean,
  !is.na(sex_med),   sex_med,
  default =          overall_median_wt)]
audit_weight[, weight_status := fcase(
  weight_imputed & n_raw_readings == 0,           "imputed_no_readings",
  weight_imputed,                                 "imputed_unresolved",
  weight_interp == "as_recorded_bmi_veto",        "measured_bmi_veto",
  grepl("^bmi_fallback_", weight_interp),         "measured_converted_bmi_fallback",
  weight_interp != "as_recorded",                 "measured_converted",
  default =                                       "measured")]
audit_weight[, sex_med := NULL]

#)10 Attach to baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs
old_cols <- intersect(c("weight_kg", "weight_imputed", "weight_status", "weight_interp",
                        "weight_days_from_adm", "weight_stale", "bmi", "bmi_flag", "bmi_lbs_suspect"),
                      names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))
if (length(old_cols)) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, (old_cols) := NULL]

#Update-join keeps row order; the same weight repeats across a hospitalization's runs by design
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[audit_weight, on = "hospitalization_id",
  `:=`(weight_kg = i.weight_kg_final, weight_imputed = i.weight_imputed,
       weight_status = i.weight_status, weight_interp = i.weight_interp,
       weight_days_from_adm = i.weight_days_from_adm, weight_stale = i.weight_stale)]

baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[is.na(weight_kg), .N]   # should be 0

#BMI screen using the final height: FLAGS ONLY, and only where both values were measured
if ("height_cm" %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)) {
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, bmi := weight_kg / (height_cm / 100)^2]
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, bmi_flag := fcase(
    weight_imputed | height_imputed, NA_character_,
    is.na(bmi),                      NA_character_,
    bmi < bmi_lo,                    "low",
    bmi > bmi_hi,                    "high",
    default =                        "ok")]
}  
print(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = bmi_flag])   # BMI screen

#)11 Audit summary and saved files
n_coh  <- nrow(audit_weight)
n_runs <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)
has_bmi <- "bmi_flag" %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)

weight_audit_summary <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(level = "reading",     metric = "raw_weight_readings",                  n = nrow(wt_raw)),
  data.table(level = "reading",     metric = "readings_no_plausible_interpretation", n = wt_raw[!reading_id %in% wt_cand$reading_id, .N]),
  data.table(level = "reading",     metric = "readings_not_retained_after_anchor",   n = wt_raw[!reading_id %in% wt_clean$reading_id, .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "cohort_hospitalizations",              n = n_coh),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "weight_measured_total",                n = audit_weight[weight_imputed == FALSE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "measured_as_recorded",                 n = audit_weight[weight_status == "measured", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "measured_converted",                   n = audit_weight[weight_status == "measured_converted", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "measured_converted_bmi_fallback",      n = audit_weight[weight_status == "measured_converted_bmi_fallback", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "measured_bmi_veto (conversion undone, recorded value kept)", n = audit_weight[weight_status == "measured_bmi_veto", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "weight_imputed_total",                 n = audit_weight[weight_imputed == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "imputed_no_readings",                  n = audit_weight[weight_status == "imputed_no_readings", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "imputed_unresolved",                   n = audit_weight[weight_status == "imputed_unresolved", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "  of which unanchored (no as-recorded plausible reading)", n = audit_weight[unanchored == TRUE & weight_imputed == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "imputed_with_sex_median",              n = audit_weight[imputed_with %in% "sex_median", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "imputed_with_overall_median",          n = audit_weight[imputed_with %in% "overall_median", .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = "anchor_conflict (hosp medians differ > tol^2)", n = audit_weight[anchor_conflict == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "cohort_hosp", metric = paste0("chosen_reading_gt_", wt_stale_days, "d_from_admission"), n = audit_weight[weight_stale == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "run",         metric = "imv_runs_total",                       n = n_runs),
  data.table(level = "run",         metric = "imv_runs_weight_imputed",              n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[weight_imputed == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(level = "run",         metric = "imv_runs_weight_converted",            n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[grepl("^measured_converted", weight_status), .N]),
  data.table(level = "run",         metric = "imv_runs_bmi_flag_low",                n = if (has_bmi) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[bmi_flag %in% "low", .N] else NA_integer_),
  data.table(level = "run",         metric = "imv_runs_bmi_flag_high",               n = if (has_bmi) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[bmi_flag %in% "high", .N] else NA_integer_)
))
weight_audit_summary[, denominator := fcase(level == "reading", nrow(wt_raw), level == "cohort_hosp", n_coh, default = n_runs)]
weight_audit_summary[, pct := round(100 * n / denominator, 2)]
print(weight_audit_summary)

#Which interpretations were used. NOTE: n_cleaned_readings counts a reading once per cohort hospitalization whose window includes it, so it can exceed the raw reading count.
weight_audit_interp <- merge(
  wt_clean[, .(n_cleaned_readings = .N), by = interp],
  admission_weight[, .(n_chosen_as_baseline = .N), by = .(interp = weight_interp)],
  by = "interp", all = TRUE)
print(weight_audit_interp)

#Before/after for every reinterpreted reading
weight_adjustments_detail <- wt_clean[interp != "as_recorded",
  .(patient_id, cohort_hospitalization_id, source_hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm,
    weight_raw = wt_raw, interp, weight_kg_after = kg_cand, anchor_kg)]

fwrite(weight_audit_summary,      file.path(audit_dir,        paste0("weight_audit_summary_",      stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(weight_audit_interp,       file.path(audit_dir,        paste0("weight_audit_interp_",       stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(weight_audit_raw_buckets,  file.path(audit_dir,        paste0("weight_audit_raw_buckets_",  stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(audit_weight,              file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("weight_audit_cohort_hosp_",  stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(weight_adjustments_detail, file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("weight_adjustments_detail_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

print(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(sex_category, weight_status)][order(sex_category, weight_status)])

################################################################################
# PART FOUR: Elixhauser (van Walraven weights)
################################################################################
# Produces two versions in one run:
#   *_poa : only diagnoses present on admission (plus exempt-type status codes - see below)
#   *_all : every diagnosis on the hospitalization (matches the original project)
################################################################################

#1) Define the Elixhauser parameters for the project
lookback_months <- 0       # 0 = index hospitalization only. >0 also pulls in the same patient's prior
                           # hospitalizations discharged within that many months before admission
# POA-exempt prefixes, one per code system
poa_keep_prefix_icd10 <- "^Z|^Q23"  # exempt-type codes the ETL recorded as POA = 0 (pacemaker, dialysis, transplant, valve replacement, etc.) - they are actually POA should be kept in the POA version
poa_keep_prefix_icd9  <- "^V|^746[3-6]"   # V codes = status codes; 746.3-746.6 = congenital valve anomalies
apply_hierarchy <- TRUE    # solid tumor not counted when metastatic cancer present (also diabetes / hypertension flags)
primary_version <- "poa"   # which version is copied into the column `elixhauser_score` ("poa" or "all") - using poa version as this doesn't count codes from the acute illness itself during the hosp
age_breaks      <- c(-Inf, 40, 55, 65, 75, Inf) #Set up age ranges for imputation later in code
age_labels      <- c("<40", "40-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75+")

poa_col <- intersect(c("poa_present"), names(hospital_diagnosis))[1] #screen if poa_present is in table
if (is.na(poa_col)) stop("No POA column found in hospital_diagnosis. Add poa_present to the select = c(...) in your load statement.")
if (!"diagnosis_code_format" %in% names(hospital_diagnosis)) stop("Add diagnosis_code_format to the select = c(...) in your load statement.") #check that code format is present

#2) Elixhauser Definitions using ICD codes
  # ICD 10

  cpd      = "^I278|^I279|^J40|^J41|^J42|^J43|^J44|^J45|^J46|^J47|^J60|^J61|^J62|^J63|^J64|^J65|^J66|^J67|^J684|^J701|^J703",
  diabunc  = "^E10[019]|^E11[019]|^E12[019]|^E13[019]|^E14[019]",

  pud      = "^K257|^K259|^K267|^K269|^K277|^K279|^K287|^K289",
  aids     = "^B20|^B21|^B22|^B24",
  lymph    = "^C81|^C82|^C83|^C84|^C85|^C88|^C96|^C900|^C902",
  metacanc = "^C77|^C78|^C79|^C80",
  solidtum = "^C0[0-9]|^C1[0-4]|^C15|^C16|^C17|^C18|^C19|^C20|^C21|^C22|^C23|^C24|^C25|^C26|^C30|^C31|^C32|^C33|^C34|^C37|^C38|^C39|^C40|^C41|^C43|^C45|^C46|^C47|^C48|^C49|^C50|^C51|^C52|^C53|^C54|^C55|^C56|^C57|^C58|^C60|^C61|^C62|^C63|^C64|^C65|^C66|^C67|^C68|^C69|^C70|^C71|^C72|^C73|^C74|^C75|^C76|^C97",
  rheumd   = "^L940|^L941|^L943|^M05|^M06|^M08|^M120|^M123|^M30|^M310|^M311|^M312|^M313|^M32|^M33|^M34|^M35|^M45|^M461|^M468|^M469",
  coag     = "^D65|^D66|^D67|^D68|^D691|^D693|^D694|^D695|^D696",
  obes     = "^E66",
  wloss    = "^E40|^E41|^E42|^E43|^E44|^E45|^E46|^R634|^R64",
  fed      = "^E222|^E86|^E87",
  blane    = "^D500",
  dane     = "^D508|^D509|^D51|^D52|^D53",
  alcohol  = "^F10|^E52|^G621|^I426|^K292|^K700|^K703|^K709|^T51|^Z502|^Z714|^Z721",
  drug     = "^F1[1-6]|^F18|^F19|^Z715|^Z722",
  psycho   = "^F20|^F22|^F23|^F24|^F25|^F28|^F29|^F302|^F312|^F315",
  depre    = "^F204|^F313|^F314|^F315|^F32|^F33|^F341|^F412|^F432"
)
  # ICD 9
elix_regex_icd9 <- c(
  chf      = "^39891|^40201|^40211|^40291|^40401|^40403|^40411|^40413|^40491|^40493|^4254|^4255|^4256|^4257|^4258|^4259|^428",
  carit    = "^4260|^42610|^42612|^42613|^4267|^4269|^427[0-4]|^427[6-9]|^7850|^99601|^99604|^V450|^V533",
  valv     = "^0932|^39[4-7]|^424|^746[3-6]|^V422|^V433",
```
