```{r}
  ld       = "^07022|^07023|^07032|^07033|^07044|^07054|^0706|^0709|^4560|^4561|^4562|^570|^5710|^5712|^5713|^571[4-9]|^572[2-8]|^V427",
  pud      = "^5317|^5319|^5327|^5329|^5337|^5339|^5347|^5349",
  aids     = "^04[2-4]",
  lymph    = "^20[0-2]|^2030|^2386",
  metacanc = "^19[6-9]",
  solidtum = "^1[4-6][0-9]|^17[0-2]|^17[4-9]|^18[0-9]|^19[0-5]",
  rheumd   = "^446|^7010|^710[0-4]|^7108|^7109|^7112|^714|^7193|^720|^725|^7285|^72889|^72930",
  coag     = "^286|^2871|^2873|^2874|^2875",
  obes     = "^2780",
  wloss    = "^260|^261|^262|^263|^7832|^7994",
  fed      = "^2536|^276",
  blane    = "^2800",
  dane     = "^280[1-9]|^281",
  alcohol  = "^2652|^291[1-3]|^291[5-9]|^3030|^3039|^3050|^3575|^4255|^5353|^5710|^5711|^5712|^5713|^980|^V113",
  drug     = "^292|^304|^305[2-9]|^V6542",
  psycho   = "^2938|^295|^29604|^29614|^29644|^29654|^297|^298",
  depre    = "^2962|^2963|^2965|^3004|^309|^311"
)

flag_cols <- names(elix_regex_icd10)
stopifnot(identical(flag_cols, names(elix_regex_icd9)))   # both lists must define the same flags

# van Walraven weights (comorbidities with weight 0 are flagged but don't contribute)
elix_wt <- c(chf = 7, carit = 5, valv = -1, pcd = 4, pvd = 2, para = 7, ond = 6, cpd = 3,
             rf = 5, ld = 11, lymph = 9, metacanc = 12, solidtum = 4, coag = 3, obes = -4,
             wloss = 6, fed = 5, blane = -2, dane = -2, drug = -7, depre = -3)
wt_cols <- names(elix_wt)

#3) Which hospitalizations feed each cohort hospitalization
cohort_hosp_ids <- unique(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id) #do not repeat hospitalizations for those with multiple runs of IMV

cohort_hosp <- hospitalization[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hosp_ids,
  .(patient_id, cohort_hospitalization_id = hospitalization_id, cohort_admission_dttm = admission_dttm)]

  # Always use the index hospitalization itself
src_pairs <- cohort_hosp[, .(cohort_hospitalization_id, source_hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id)] #By default w lookback set to 0 these values equal each other

  # Optional for when we use lookback
if (lookback_months > 0) {
  prior <- merge(
    hospitalization[patient_id %in% cohort_hosp$patient_id,
      .(patient_id, source_hospitalization_id = hospitalization_id, source_discharge_dttm = discharge_dttm)],
    cohort_hosp, by = "patient_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE) #merge all hospitalizations to cohort hospitalizations for each patient
  prior[, window_start := add_with_rollback(cohort_admission_dttm, months(-lookback_months))] #calculate start of lookback window
  prior <- prior[source_hospitalization_id != cohort_hospitalization_id &
                   source_discharge_dttm <= cohort_admission_dttm &
                   source_discharge_dttm >= window_start] #Filter only for hospitalizations within lookback
  src_pairs <- rbind(src_pairs, prior[, .(cohort_hospitalization_id, source_hospitalization_id)])
} #stack the prior-stay pairs - cohort can have several source stays

# Age (one value per hospitalization) and sex, used for imputation
age_lookup <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .(age_at_admission = age_at_admission[1]), by = hospitalization_id] #choose the age at admission- 1 per hospitalization

#4) Function that builds the score for one version (poa_only TRUE / FALSE)
run_elix <- function(poa_only) {

  # 4a. Diagnosis rows: filter, clean, dedupe
  dx <- hospital_diagnosis[hospitalization_id %in% src_pairs$source_hospitalization_id] #keep only the diagnosis rows from hospitalizations that feed the cohort
  dx[, code_fmt := fcase(
  grepl("ICD10", toupper(diagnosis_code_format)), "ICD10",
  grepl("ICD9",  toupper(diagnosis_code_format)), "ICD9",
  default = NA_character_)] #Decide on code type based on diagnosis_code_format
  if (dx[is.na(code_fmt), .N] > 0) { #count rows with unrecognized formatting
  warning(dx[is.na(code_fmt), .N], " diagnosis rows had an unrecognized diagnosis_code_format and were dropped")
  dx <- dx[!is.na(code_fmt)] #drop the unrecognized formatting rows
}
  dx <- dx[!is.na(diagnosis_code)] #drop rows with NA diagnosis_codes
  dx[, diagnosis_code := toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", diagnosis_code))] #clean, capitalize codes
  dx <- dx[diagnosis_code != ""] #drop blank codes
  hosp_with_any_dx <- unique(dx$hospitalization_id)   #has ANY diagnosis row, before the POA filter - keeps track of which are completely blank vs have diagnoses but no POAs
  cohort_has_dx    <- unique(src_pairs[source_hospitalization_id %in% hosp_with_any_dx, cohort_hospitalization_id]) #Same deal but within cohort - moot if using no lookback
  n_dx_before <- nrow(dx) #count rows prior to POA filter
    # run the POA only version
  if (poa_only) {
  v  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(dx[[poa_col]]))) #convert poa column to number, ignore NA warnings
  dx <- dx[which(v == 1 |
                 (code_fmt == "ICD10" & grepl(poa_keep_prefix_icd10, diagnosis_code)) |
                 (code_fmt == "ICD9"  & grepl(poa_keep_prefix_icd9,  diagnosis_code)))]
  } #keep the exempt codes defined above 
  
n_dx_after <- nrow(dx) #row count after POA filter
dx <- unique(dx[, .(hospitalization_id, diagnosis_code, code_fmt)]) #keep key columns, remove duplicates

  # 4b. Flag each UNIQUE code once, then aggregate
  code_flags <- unique(dx[, .(diagnosis_code, code_fmt)]) #check each code only once 
  for (nm in flag_cols) { #look to see if code above falls into one of the comorbidities - makes 31 columns of TRUE/FALSE
  set(code_flags, j = nm,
      value = fifelse(code_flags$code_fmt == "ICD10", #try icd10 first then icd9
                      grepl(elix_regex_icd10[[nm]], code_flags$diagnosis_code),
                      grepl(elix_regex_icd9[[nm]],  code_flags$diagnosis_code)))
    }

  hosp_flags <- merge(dx, code_flags, by = c("diagnosis_code", "code_fmt"))[
  , lapply(.SD, any), by = hospitalization_id, .SDcols = flag_cols] #add flags to each row

  cohort_flags <- merge(src_pairs, hosp_flags, #Add flags onto the source-stay mapping then collapse by cohort
                        by.x = "source_hospitalization_id", by.y = "hospitalization_id")[
    , lapply(.SD, any), by = cohort_hospitalization_id, .SDcols = flag_cols]
  setnames(cohort_flags, "cohort_hospitalization_id", "hospitalization_id") #rename cohort back to hosp

  # 4c. Hierarchies and score
  n_solid_removed <- cohort_flags[solidtum & metacanc, .N] #count the number of stays with both solid tumor and metastatic cancer
  if (apply_hierarchy) { #if apply_hierarchy above is TRUE then use these rules
    cohort_flags[, `:=`(solidtum = solidtum & !metacanc,
                        diabunc  = diabunc  & !diabc,
                        hypunc   = hypunc   & !hypc)]
  }
  score_mat <- 1L * as.matrix(cohort_flags[, ..wt_cols]) #pull the 21 weighted columns into a matrix 1/0
  cohort_flags[, elixhauser_score := as.numeric(score_mat %*% elix_wt[colnames(score_mat)])] #van walraven score calculation using the weights defined above

  # 4d. Audit table, one row per cohort hospitalization
  audit <- merge(cohort_hosp[, .(patient_id, hospitalization_id = cohort_hospitalization_id)],
                 cohort_flags, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE) #merge in full cohort
  audit[, index_has_dx := hospitalization_id %in% hosp_with_any_dx] #does cohort stay have dx?
  audit[, dx_source := fcase(
    index_has_dx,                       "index",
    hospitalization_id %in% cohort_has_dx, "prior_hospitalizations_only",
    default =                           "none")] #if cohort stay does not have dx then do prior hosps or none?
  # Has diagnoses but none survived the POA filter = no documented preexisting comorbidity: score 0, not imputed
  audit[is.na(elixhauser_score) & hospitalization_id %in% cohort_has_dx, elixhauser_score := 0]
  for (nm in flag_cols) set(audit, which(is.na(audit[[nm]])), nm, FALSE) #replace NA w FALSE for audit

  # 4e. Imputation for hospitalizations with no diagnosis data
  audit[, elixhauser_imputed := is.na(elixhauser_score)] #which rows need a score imputed?
  audit <- merge(audit, patient_demographics[, .(patient_id, sex_category)], by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE) #merge w patient demo so we have sex
  audit <- merge(audit, age_lookup, by = "hospitalization_id", all.x = TRUE) #merge w age as well
  audit[, age_band := as.character(cut(age_at_admission, age_breaks, right = FALSE, labels = age_labels))] #sort into age groups

  real <- audit[elixhauser_imputed == FALSE] #which stays have real scores - used for medians
  #Tiers of median scores - agexsex median first, then age mmedian, then overall median
  med_age_sex <- real[!is.na(age_band) & !is.na(sex_category),
                      .(m_as = median(elixhauser_score)), by = .(age_band, sex_category)]
  med_age     <- real[!is.na(age_band), .(m_a = median(elixhauser_score)), by = age_band]
  overall_med <- real[, median(elixhauser_score)]

  audit[med_age_sex, on = .(age_band, sex_category), m_as := i.m_as] #write in the values
  audit[med_age,     on = "age_band",                m_a  := i.m_a]
    # which imputation level is each row using?
  audit[, imputed_with := fcase(
    !elixhauser_imputed, NA_character_,
    !is.na(m_as),        "age_sex_median",
    !is.na(m_a),         "age_median",
    default =            "overall_median")]
  audit[, elixhauser_score_final := fcase( #attach the actual scores
    !elixhauser_imputed, elixhauser_score,
    !is.na(m_as),        m_as,
    !is.na(m_a),         m_a,
    default =            overall_med)]
  audit[, c("m_as", "m_a") := NULL]

  list(audit = audit, n_solid_removed = n_solid_removed, n_dx_before = n_dx_before, n_dx_after = n_dx_after)
} #return audit table for summary

#5) Run both the poa and all versions
res_poa <- run_elix(poa_only = TRUE)
res_all <- run_elix(poa_only = FALSE)

# How much did the POA filter remove?
c(dx_rows_all_version = res_all$n_dx_after, dx_rows_poa_version = res_poa$n_dx_after)

#6) Attach to baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs
old_cols <- intersect(c("elixhauser_score", "elixhauser_score_poa", "elixhauser_score_all",
                        "elixhauser_imputed", "elixhauser_imputed_poa", "elixhauser_imputed_all",
                        "elixhauser_dx_source", "elixhauser_dx_source_poa", "elixhauser_dx_source_all"),
                      names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))
if (length(old_cols)) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, (old_cols) := NULL] #clear any old elixhauser data present from previous runs

# Update-joins keep row order; the same score repeats across a hospitalization's runs by design
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[res_poa$audit, on = "hospitalization_id",
  `:=`(elixhauser_score_poa = i.elixhauser_score_final,
       elixhauser_imputed_poa = i.elixhauser_imputed,
       elixhauser_dx_source_poa = i.dx_source)]
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[res_all$audit, on = "hospitalization_id",
  `:=`(elixhauser_score_all = i.elixhauser_score_final,
       elixhauser_imputed_all = i.elixhauser_imputed,
       elixhauser_dx_source_all = i.dx_source)]

# Convenience columns that point at whichever version you declared primary
if (primary_version == "poa") {
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, `:=`(elixhauser_score = elixhauser_score_poa,
                                         elixhauser_imputed = elixhauser_imputed_poa,
                                         elixhauser_dx_source = elixhauser_dx_source_poa)]
} else {
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, `:=`(elixhauser_score = elixhauser_score_all,
                                         elixhauser_imputed = elixhauser_imputed_all,
                                         elixhauser_dx_source = elixhauser_dx_source_all)]
}

baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[is.na(elixhauser_score_poa) | is.na(elixhauser_score_all), .N]   # should be 0

#7) Audit summary
n_coh  <- nrow(res_all$audit) #number of cohort hospitalizations
n_runs <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs) #number of runs

mk_summary <- function(res, label, imputed_col) { #build summary table
  a <- res$audit #audit table shortcut
  data.table(
    version = label,
    level   = c(rep("cohort_hosp", 8), "run", "run"),
    metric  = c("cohort_hospitalizations", "dx_from_index_hospitalization", "dx_from_prior_hospitalizations_only",
                "no_dx_data (imputed)", "imputed_with_age_sex_median", "imputed_with_age_median",
                "imputed_with_overall_median", "solid_tumor_removed_by_metastatic_hierarchy",
                "imv_runs_total", "imv_runs_score_imputed"),
    n       = c(nrow(a), a[dx_source == "index", .N], a[dx_source == "prior_hospitalizations_only", .N],
                a[elixhauser_imputed == TRUE, .N], a[imputed_with %in% "age_sex_median", .N],
                a[imputed_with %in% "age_median", .N], a[imputed_with %in% "overall_median", .N],
                res$n_solid_removed,
                n_runs, baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[get(imputed_col) == TRUE, .N])
  )
}
#combine the 2 versions and add percentages
elix_audit_summary <- rbind(mk_summary(res_poa, "poa", "elixhauser_imputed_poa"),
                            mk_summary(res_all, "all", "elixhauser_imputed_all"))
elix_audit_summary[, denominator := fifelse(level == "cohort_hosp", n_coh, n_runs)]
elix_audit_summary[, pct := round(100 * n / denominator, 2)]
print(elix_audit_summary)

# Prevalence of each comorbidity (hospitalizations with diagnosis data), both versions side by side
prev_fun <- function(res) { #function for prevalence
  a <- res$audit[index_has_dx == TRUE] #keep only stays with their own diagnosis data
  data.table(comorbidity = flag_cols, pct = as.numeric(sapply(flag_cols, function(nm) round(100 * mean(a[[nm]]), 2)))) #calculate percent of hospitalizations with each comorbidity TRUE
}
# Run the function on each version and rename pct to either pct_all or pct_poa for audit
elix_prevalence <- merge(prev_fun(res_all)[, .(comorbidity, pct_all = pct)],
                         prev_fun(res_poa)[, .(comorbidity, pct_poa = pct)], by = "comorbidity")
elix_prevalence[, drop_pct_points := round(pct_all - pct_poa, 2)] #how much did POA remove?
elix_prevalence <- elix_prevalence[order(-drop_pct_points)] #sort by the drop percent
elix_prevalence    # in-stay conditions (fed, coag, carit, wloss) should drop most; chronic ones barely move

# Score distributions and agreement - look at quantiles
rbind(all = quantile(res_all$audit$elixhauser_score_final, c(0, .05, .25, .5, .75, .95, 1)),
      poa = quantile(res_poa$audit$elixhauser_score_final, c(0, .05, .25, .5, .75, .95, 1)))
cor(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$elixhauser_score_all,
    baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$elixhauser_score_poa) #look at Pearson correlation between the 2 versions

# Coding-lag check: does missing index diagnosis data cluster at recent discharge dates?
elix_nodx_by_year <- merge(res_all$audit[, .(hospitalization_id, index_has_dx)],
                           hospitalization[, .(hospitalization_id, discharge_dttm)], by = "hospitalization_id")[
  , .(n_hosp = .N, pct_no_index_dx = round(100 * mean(!index_has_dx), 2)),
  by = .(discharge_year = year(discharge_dttm))][order(discharge_year)]
elix_nodx_by_year

#8) Save audit files
fwrite(elix_audit_summary, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("elix_audit_summary_",      stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(elix_prevalence,    file.path(audit_dir, paste0("elix_audit_prevalence_",   stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(elix_nodx_by_year,  file.path(audit_dir, paste0("elix_audit_nodx_by_year_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(res_poa$audit,      file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("elix_audit_cohort_hosp_poa_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(res_all$audit,      file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0("elix_audit_cohort_hosp_all_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

print(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(elixhauser_dx_source_poa, elixhauser_imputed_poa)])

################################################################################
# PART FOUR: Location of Intubation
################################################################################
# First define our parameters
match_time_col     <- "begin_obs"  # timestamp matched to ADT
max_gap_mins       <- 60           # begin time in a gap between ADT rows: accept the NEAREST row if within this many minutes
arrive_mins        <- 30           # runs starting within this many minutes of arrival may have been intubated before arrival
reassign_from      <- c("procedural", "ed")   # prior locations the intubation is reassigned to (ward arrivals stay ambiguous)
min_prior_row_mins <- 0            # require the prior ADT row to have lasted at least this long (0 = no restriction)

if (!match_time_col %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))
  stop(match_time_col, " is not a column of baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs")

#begin_imv_source describes begin_obs only, so it is only used in the rule when matching on begin_obs
use_src <- (match_time_col == "begin_obs")

#)0 ADT prep (all comparisons in numeric seconds, so timezone labels can't interfere)
if (!"hospital_type" %in% names(adt)) {
  warning("hospital_type is not in adt - add it to the select = c(...) above. Setting to NA.")
  adt[, hospital_type := NA_character_]
} 
#Create ADT table only with populated rows and convert times to seconds for calc
adt_iv <- adt[!is.na(in_dttm), .(
  hospitalization_id, hospital_id, hospital_type,
  location_category = tolower(trimws(location_category)),
  in_s  = as.numeric(in_dttm),
  out_s = as.numeric(out_dttm)
)]
setorder(adt_iv, hospitalization_id, in_s)

n_adt_rows <- nrow(adt_iv) #number of rows in the table
n_out_na   <- adt_iv[is.na(out_s), .N] #number of rows with NA values for out_dttm in s
n_inverted <- adt_iv[!is.na(out_s) & out_s < in_s, .N] #how many rows have an out_dttm before in_dttm
adt_iv <- adt_iv[is.na(out_s) | out_s >= in_s]  #drop rows whose out_dttm precedes in_dttm

# A missing out_dttm is treated as "open until the next ADT row starts" (indefinitely if it is the last row)
adt_iv[, next_in_s := shift(in_s, type = "lead"), by = hospitalization_id] #use in_s from next row to determine time of subsequent location
adt_iv[is.na(out_s), out_s := fifelse(!is.na(next_in_s), next_in_s, Inf)] #if missing an end time - use next_in_s to fill in the missing time unless it's the last row then it's inifinity

# Information about the PRECEDING ADT row (used to infer where a patient who arrived intubated was intubated)
    # if first row then that row gest NA for all three of these
adt_iv[, `:=`(prior_location_category = shift(location_category), #where was previous location_category
              prior_hospital_id       = shift(hospital_id), #where was previous hospital_id
              prior_row_mins          = (shift(out_s) - shift(in_s)) / 60), by = hospitalization_id] #how long were they in the previous row

#)1 Match each IMV run to the ADT row containing the match time
# Intervals are half-open [in, out): a time exactly at a transfer belongs to the NEW location.
runs_key <- data.table(
  run_row            = seq_len(nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)), #what row is the run in the table - used to match the location later to the right run
  hospitalization_id = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id,
  begin_s            = as.numeric(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[[match_time_col]]) #time to match on in seconds so it can be directly measured against in_s and out_s
)
# Merge run_keys and adt table, drop those without start times, use cartesian to create all possible candidate rows
cand <- merge(
  runs_key[!is.na(begin_s)],
  adt_iv[, .(hospitalization_id, hospital_id, hospital_type, location_category,
             prior_location_category, prior_hospital_id, prior_row_mins, in_s, out_s)],
  by = "hospitalization_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)

cand[, inside := begin_s >= in_s & begin_s < out_s] #Is the start time inside of this candidate?
# Signed gap in seconds: 0 if inside; negative if the time is BEFORE the row starts; positive if AFTER it ends
cand[, gap_signed_s := fcase(inside,          0,
                             begin_s < in_s,  -(in_s - begin_s),
                             default =        begin_s - out_s)]
cand[, gap_abs_s := abs(gap_signed_s)] #How far is the candidate from the intubation time?
cand[, n_overlap := sum(inside), by = run_row]   # >1 means overlapping ADT rows contain the time

# Best row per run: containing row first (most recently started if several overlap), otherwise nearest
setorder(cand, run_row, gap_abs_s, -in_s) #put them in order of gap time
best <- cand[, .SD[1], by = run_row] #choose the row with the lowest gap

best[, location_match_type := fcase( #describe the way the decision was made based on the gap
  inside,                           "within_interval",
  gap_abs_s <= max_gap_mins * 60,   "nearest_within_tolerance",
  default =                         "unmatched")]
best[location_match_type == "unmatched",
     c("location_category", "hospital_id", "hospital_type", "prior_location_category",
       "prior_hospital_id", "prior_row_mins") := NA] #If nothing matches with the candidates then leave it NA
best[, mins_since_arrival := fifelse(inside, (begin_s - in_s) / 60, NA_real_)] #If within an interval - how long within that interval did the intubation take place?

#)2 Attach to baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs
old_cols <- intersect(c("location_of_intubation", "hospital_id", "hospital_type", "location_match_type",
                        "location_gap_mins", "location_n_overlap", "location_mins_since_arrival",
                        "prior_location_category", "prior_hospital_id", "prior_location_row_mins",
                        "arrived_intubated_likely", "location_of_intubation_adj", "location_confidence",
                        "intubation_site", "intubated_in_procedural", "intubation_site_uncertain"),
                      names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))
if (length(old_cols)) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, (old_cols) := NULL] #Remove any columns from previous run

baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, run_row := .I] #Row number same as above for matching
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[best, on = "run_row", `:=`(
  location_of_intubation      = i.location_category,
  hospital_id                 = i.hospital_id,
  hospital_type               = i.hospital_type,
  location_match_type         = i.location_match_type,
  location_gap_mins           = i.gap_signed_s / 60,
  location_n_overlap          = i.n_overlap,
  location_mins_since_arrival = i.mins_since_arrival,
  prior_location_category     = i.prior_location_category,
  prior_hospital_id           = i.prior_hospital_id,
  prior_location_row_mins     = i.prior_row_mins
)] #Join over the new columns to the old baseline data table
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[is.na(location_match_type), location_match_type := "no_adt_rows_or_missing_begin_obs"] #If there isn't a match type - use this
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, run_row := NULL] #Drop run_row

#) 3 Adjusted location: likely arrived already intubated
# begin_obs is the earliest documented evidence of IMV. A patient intubated in the OR/ED and then moved
# has their first vent charting minutes after arriving in the next location, so the matched location
# (usually ICU) is where intubation was DOCUMENTED, not where it happened. If the run begins shortly
# after arrival from a procedural area or the ED, label the PRIOR location instead.
  # Define arrived_intubated_likely based on 30 minute arrive_mins
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, arrived_intubated_likely := fcoalesce(
  location_match_type == "within_interval" & #Must have an interval
  location_mins_since_arrival <= arrive_mins & #Must be within 30*** mins
  prior_location_category %in% reassign_from & #Must have been in OR or ED
  prior_location_category != location_of_intubation &
  (is.na(prior_hospital_id) | is.na(hospital_id) | prior_hospital_id == hospital_id) &   #no cross-hospital reassignment
  (is.na(prior_location_row_mins) | prior_location_row_mins >= min_prior_row_mins) &
  (!use_src | begin_imv_source %in% c("resp", "drip")),                                  #RSI source = charted intubation
  FALSE)]
# If flagged then use the previous location as the site of intubation
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, location_of_intubation_adj := fifelse(
  arrived_intubated_likely, prior_location_category, location_of_intubation)]
# Label the confidence of this data for auditing purposes
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, location_confidence := fcase(
  location_match_type %in% c("unmatched", "no_adt_rows_or_missing_begin_obs"),     "unmatched",
  location_match_type == "nearest_within_tolerance",                               "nearest_row_not_contained",
  arrived_intubated_likely,                                                        "inferred_from_prior_location",
  location_mins_since_arrival <= arrive_mins & !is.na(prior_location_category) &
    prior_location_category != location_of_intubation,                             "ambiguous_recent_arrival",
  location_mins_since_arrival <= arrive_mins & is.na(prior_location_category),     "ambiguous_first_adt_row",
  default =                                                                        "direct")]

#)4 Model-ready baseline features
# Collapsed site (rare categories folded together) and a binary OR/procedural flag built on the ADJUSTED location
# "procedural" is a CLIF location_category and includes OR, cath lab, IR, endoscopy, etc.
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, intubation_site := fcase(
  is.na(location_of_intubation_adj),                         "unknown",
  location_of_intubation_adj == "procedural",                "or_procedural",
  location_of_intubation_adj == "icu",                       "icu",
  location_of_intubation_adj == "ed",                        "ed",
  location_of_intubation_adj %in% c("ward", "stepdown"),     "ward",
  default =                                                  "other")]
# Keep a documented in OR variable for later
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, intubated_in_procedural := as.integer(intubation_site == "or_procedural")]

# Track uncertainty for sensitivity analyses later on, 1=weakly supported
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, intubation_site_uncertain := as.integer(location_confidence %in%
  c("unmatched", "nearest_row_not_contained", "ambiguous_recent_arrival", "ambiguous_first_adt_row"))]

#5) Audits and saved files
n_runs <- nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)

loc_audit_summary <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(metric = "adt_rows",                                         n = n_adt_rows),
  data.table(metric = "adt_rows_missing_out_dttm (open until next row)",  n = n_out_na),
  data.table(metric = "adt_rows_out_before_in (dropped)",                 n = n_inverted),
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .(n = .N), by = .(metric = paste0("runs_match_", location_match_type))],
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .(n = .N), by = .(metric = paste0("runs_confidence_", location_confidence))],
  data.table(metric = "runs_with_overlapping_adt_rows",                   n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[location_n_overlap > 1, .N]),
  data.table(metric = "runs_reassigned_to_prior_location",                n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[arrived_intubated_likely == TRUE, .N]),
  data.table(metric = "runs_intubated_in_procedural (adjusted)",          n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[intubated_in_procedural == 1L, .N]),
  data.table(metric = "runs_site_uncertain",                              n = baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[intubation_site_uncertain == 1L, .N])
), use.names = TRUE)
loc_audit_summary[grepl("^runs_", metric), pct := round(100 * n / n_runs, 2)]
loc_audit_summary

# Documented vs adjusted location
loc_adjustment_crosstab <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(location_of_intubation, location_of_intubation_adj)][order(-N)]
loc_adjustment_crosstab
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = intubation_site][order(-N)]

# Hospitals
loc_by_hospital <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(hospital_id, hospital_type)][order(-N)]
loc_by_hospital

#Additional analyses for possible site-based issues - not saved in audit
# Non-contained matches: how far off were they (negative = match time before the row started)?
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[location_match_type %in% c("nearest_within_tolerance", "unmatched"),
  quantile(location_gap_mins, c(0, .05, .25, .5, .75, .95, 1), na.rm = TRUE)]

# Is the arrival pile-up real? Minutes from arrival to run start, for ICU matches arriving from a procedural area
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[location_match_type == "within_interval" & location_of_intubation == "icu" &
                                  prior_location_category == "procedural",
  .N, by = .(mins_bin = cut(location_mins_since_arrival, c(-Inf, 5, 10, 30, 60, 180, 720, Inf)))][order(mins_bin)]

# Do reassigned runs rest on very short prior rows (transit rather than a real stay)?
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[arrived_intubated_likely == TRUE,
  .(n = .N, prior_row_lt_5min = round(100 * mean(prior_location_row_mins < 5, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_prior_row_mins = median(prior_location_row_mins, na.rm = TRUE))]

# Does location_type distinguish OR from other procedural rooms at your site? (see note below)
adt[tolower(location_category) == "procedural", .N, by = location_type][order(-N)]

dir.create(audit_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
fwrite(loc_audit_summary,      file.path(audit_dir, paste0("location_audit_summary_",    stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(loc_adjustment_crosstab, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("location_audit_adjustment_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(loc_by_hospital,        file.path(audit_dir, paste0("location_audit_by_hospital_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .N, by = .(location_match_type, location_confidence, intubation_site)][
  order(location_match_type, -N)]

#Save the baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs and the cache in case having to re-run later
arrow::write_parquet(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs, baseline_cache)
saveRDS(list(saved_at = Sys.time(),
             n_rows   = nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs),
             params   = cohort_params),
        baseline_meta)

}
```
 

# PART FIVE: Formatting variables
  # Convert meds for future SOFA score calculation
  # Process RASS score values
```{r}
if (!use_epoch_cache) {
if (use_baseline_cache) {
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs <- as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(baseline_cache))
  # Reset timezone labels (the instants are unchanged; this only fixes how they display)
  dttm_cols <- names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)[sapply(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs, inherits, "POSIXct")]
  for (cc in dttm_cols) set(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs, j = cc,
                            value = lubridate::with_tz(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[[cc]], time_zone))
  stopifnot(nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs) == readRDS(baseline_meta)$n_rows)
}
 
################################################################################
# STANDARDIZE CONTINUOUS MEDICATION UNITS
# Adds med_dose_std / med_dose_unit_std to `meds`; med_dose itself is NOT modified.
# Requires: meds, baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs with weight_kg (run the WEIGHT block first)
################################################################################

#1) Define target unit per drug (SOFA uses mcg/kg/min for norepinephrine, epinephrine, dopamine, dobutamine)
  # Including pressors, sedation, opioids, etc for standardization across CLIF sites
med_target_units <- data.table(
  med_category = c("norepinephrine", "epinephrine", "phenylephrine", "dopamine", "dobutamine", "vasopressin",
                   "propofol", "dexmedetomidine", "midazolam", "ketamine", "fentanyl", "hydromorphone",
                   "cisatracurium", "vecuronium", "rocuronium", "epoprostenol_iv", "epoprostenol_inhaled", 
                   "treprostinil_iv", "alprostadil_iv", "nitric_oxide_inhaled"),
  unit_std     = c("mcg/kg/min", "mcg/kg/min", "mcg/kg/min", "mcg/kg/min", "mcg/kg/min", "units/min",
                   "mcg/kg/min", "mcg/kg/hr", "mg/hr", "mg/kg/hr", "mcg/hr", "mg/hr",
                   "mcg/kg/min", "mcg/kg/min", "mcg/kg/min", "ng/kg/min", "mcg/kg/min", 
                   "ng/kg/min", "mcg/hr", "ppm"))

#Unit grammar: teach the code how to read different units
amt_scale    <- c(g = 1e6, mg = 1e3, mcg = 1, ng = 1e-3,                       # mass, in mcg
                  units = 1, unit = 1, u = 1, milliunits = 1e-3)               # activity, in units
amt_dim      <- c(g = "mass", mg = "mass", mcg = "mass", ng = "mass",          # what type of unit
                  units = "units", unit = "units", u = "units", milliunits = "units")
time_per_min <- c(min = 1, hr = 1/60, h = 1/60)                                # rate expressed per minute

unit_syn <- c(nanogram = "ng", nanograms = "ng", microgram = "mcg", micrograms = "mcg", ug = "mcg",
              milligram = "mg", milligrams = "mg", gram = "g", grams = "g",
              hour = "hr", hours = "hr", minute = "min", minutes = "min") #convert alternative wordings
 # parse out if kg are in the units or not for use in conversions
parse_unit <- function(u) {
  rbindlist(lapply(strsplit(ifelse(is.na(u), "", tolower(trimws(u))), "/", fixed = TRUE), function(x) {
    if (length(x) == 0) x <- ""
    x <- unname(ifelse(x %in% names(unit_syn), unit_syn[x], x))   # "nanogram" -> "ng", etc.
    t <- setdiff(x[-1], "kg")
    data.table(amt = x[1], per_kg = "kg" %in% x[-1], time = if (length(t) == 1) t else NA_character_)
  }))
}

#2) Conversion factor for every (drug, charted unit) pair
pairs <- unique(meds[tolower(med_category) %in% med_target_units$med_category,
                     .(med_category = tolower(med_category), unit_from = med_dose_unit)])
pairs <- merge(pairs, med_target_units, by = "med_category") #merge w target
pf <- parse_unit(pairs$unit_from); setnames(pf, paste0(names(pf), "_from")) #parse from
pt <- parse_unit(pairs$unit_std);  setnames(pt, paste0(names(pt), "_to")) #parse to
pairs <- cbind(pairs, pf, pt) #all data necessary for conversions

# Convertible = a rate (has a time unit) in the same dimension (mass vs units) as the target
# Amounts (mg, mcg), volumes (ml/hr) and mismatched dimensions are NOT convertible and are dropped
pairs[, convertible := fcoalesce(amt_from %in% names(amt_scale) & time_from %in% names(time_per_min) &
                                   amt_dim[amt_from] == amt_dim[amt_to], FALSE)] #see if amt and time values match the allowed rules
pairs[convertible == TRUE, conv_factor := (amt_scale[amt_from] / amt_scale[amt_to]) *
                                          (time_per_min[time_from] / time_per_min[time_to])]
pairs[, conv_kg := fcase(per_kg_from & !per_kg_to, "multiply",
                         !per_kg_from & per_kg_to, "divide",
                         default = "none")] #determine weight corrections
pairs[!is.na(unit_from) & unit_from == unit_std, `:=`(convertible = TRUE, conv_factor = 1, conv_kg = "none")] #if charted units match the string then pass through

#3) Apply to meds
wt <- unique(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[!is.na(weight_kg), .(hospitalization_id, weight_kg)], by = "hospitalization_id") #pull 1 weight per hospitalization 

meds[, med_key := tolower(med_category)] #create key for joining
meds[pairs, on = .(med_key = med_category, med_dose_unit = unit_from),
     `:=`(conv_factor = i.conv_factor, conv_kg = i.conv_kg, convertible = i.convertible, unit_std = i.unit_std)] #Every med row where drug and charted unit match a row in pairs receives the conversion info
meds[wt, on = "hospitalization_id", wt_kg := i.weight_kg] #add weight to meds

meds[, med_dose_std := fcase(
  !is.na(med_dose) & as.numeric(med_dose) == 0,       0,       # test conditions in order and use first true
  convertible %in% TRUE & conv_kg == "none",          as.numeric(med_dose) * conv_factor,
  convertible %in% TRUE & conv_kg == "multiply",      as.numeric(med_dose) * conv_factor * wt_kg,
  convertible %in% TRUE & conv_kg == "divide",        as.numeric(med_dose) * conv_factor / wt_kg,
  default = NA_real_)]
meds[, med_dose_unit_std := unit_std]

#)4 Audits
std_hids <- unique(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$hospitalization_id) #standard hospital IDs
  # Reports # of rows, # w non-missing standardized dose, # of doses = 0
audit_med_conversion <- meds[med_key %in% med_target_units$med_category & hospitalization_id %in% std_hids,
  .(n = .N, n_kept = sum(!is.na(med_dose_std)), n_zero_stops = sum(med_dose_std == 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(med = med_key, unit_from = med_dose_unit, unit_std = med_dose_unit_std)][order(med, -n)]
print(audit_med_conversion)

# Distribution of running doses in standard units 
audit_med_dose_dist <- meds[hospitalization_id %in% std_hids & med_dose_std > 0,
  as.list(round(quantile(med_dose_std, c(.01, .25, .5, .75, .99, 1)), 3)),
  by = .(med = med_key, unit = med_dose_unit_std)][order(med)]
print(audit_med_dose_dist)

meds[, c("med_key", "conv_factor", "conv_kg", "convertible", "unit_std", "wt_kg") := NULL] #drop unneeded columns
  # save files
fwrite(audit_med_conversion, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("med_unit_conversion_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(audit_med_dose_dist,  file.path(audit_dir, paste0("med_dose_std_distribution_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

}
```


# PART SIX: Build the hourly table
  # Create hour-based epoch table for each hospitalization_id
  # Identify values of key labs, vital signs, vent settings, meds
```{r}
if (!use_epoch_cache) {
###############################################################################
# HOURLY EPOCH TABLE: one row per IMV run x epoch
# Epoch 0 = [begin_obs, begin_obs + 1h); negative epochs = pre-intubation lookback
###############################################################################

# First Define Parameters for our hourly table
epoch_hours    <- 1                   # epoch length - can change on future iterations
lookback_hours <- 24                  # pre-intubation epochs to include (negative epoch numbers); 0 = none
max_hours      <- Inf                 # cap on epochs after begin_obs - will use all epochs until extubated, death, starting paralytics; Inf = through end_obs
lab_time_col   <- "lab_result_dttm"   # when a lab became AVAILABLE ("recorded_dttm" = collection time)
add_obs_flags  <- TRUE                # <feature>_obs = 1 if actually measured in that epoch
add_time_since <- TRUE                # <feature>_hrs_since_obs = how old the carried value is
if (!exists("audit_dir")) audit_dir <- getwd()
epoch_s <- epoch_hours * 3600 #add seconds to help convert epoch_hours - helps place certain variables into correct epoch - helps with placement of antibiotic and viral data into proper epochs in next part as well. Everything is converted to seconds for formation of table then transformed back later.

#)0. Stable run key - use combination of hospitalization_id and numeric value of begin_obs
# (also added to the baseline table so run-level features can be joined later)
baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, imv_run_id := sprintf("%s_%.0f", hospitalization_id, as.numeric(begin_obs))] #create imv_run_id
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$imv_run_id)) #make sure only one run per ID

tz_out <- attr(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs$begin_obs, "tzone")
if (is.null(tz_out) || !nzchar(tz_out)) tz_out <- time_zone #establish time_zone for transformation back to legible times later in script

runs <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[!is.na(begin_obs) & !is.na(end_obs),
  .(imv_run_id, hospitalization_id, begin_s = as.numeric(begin_obs), end_s = as.numeric(end_obs))] #simplify table and add in begin and end in seconds
runs[, end_s := pmin(end_s, begin_s + max_hours * 3600)] #optional for if we decide to cap the runs at a shorter time span in the future 
runs[, n_epochs := pmax(1L, as.integer(ceiling((end_s - begin_s) / epoch_s)))] #create n_epochs in order to define shape of each run (number of epochs, handling of partial eopchs) - builds the baseline for filling in all future data  
lookback_epochs <- as.integer(ceiling(lookback_hours / epoch_hours)) #convert the lookback_hours into epochs - useful if we change epoch size to less than or greater than 1 hour
cohort_hids <- unique(runs$hospitalization_id) #hospitalization_ids from our cohort

#)1. Epoch grid
grid <- runs[, .(epoch = seq.int(-lookback_epochs, n_epochs - 1L)),
             by = .(imv_run_id, hospitalization_id, begin_s, end_s, n_epochs)] #build skeleton grid of the epoch table - 1 row per epoch
grid[, epoch_start_dttm := as.POSIXct(begin_s + epoch * epoch_s, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = tz_out)] #add readable clock time for when each epoch starts
grid[, last_epoch_partial := epoch == n_epochs - 1L & (begin_s + n_epochs * epoch_s) > end_s] #add flag for if a final epoch doesn't last the full hour

#)2. Feature registry: ONE ROW PER FEATURE
# source: which loader; key: category value or column name in that source; agg: how to summarize within an epoch
# (mean, min, max, last, first, sum, count, any); lo/hi: plausibility bounds (values outside are dropped);
# locf_hours: how long a value may be carried forward; persist_hours: an event stays "on" this long;
# na_to_zero: missing means "not happening" (meds, events) rather than "unknown"
spec <- function(source, key, feature = key, agg = "mean", lo = -Inf, hi = Inf,
                 locf_hours = 0, persist_hours = 0, na_to_zero = FALSE)
  data.table(source, key, feature, agg, lo, hi, locf_hours, persist_hours, na_to_zero) #helper function to build one row for each feature - builds baseline numbers in before building feature_spec below
# setting maximum locf_hours for each feature so as to not bias grid

cont_meds <- c("norepinephrine", "epinephrine", "vasopressin", "phenylephrine", "dopamine", "dobutamine",
               "propofol", "midazolam", "dexmedetomidine", "ketamine", "fentanyl", "hydromorphone",
               "cisatracurium", "vecuronium", "rocuronium", "epoprostenol_iv", "epoprostenol_inhaled", 
               "treprostinil_iv", "alprostadil_iv", "nitric_oxide_inhaled")
bolus_meds <- c("rocuronium", "vecuronium", "cisatracurium", "succinylcholine")

feature_spec <- rbindlist(list(
  # Vitals (MAP is gap-filled from SBP/DBP at timestamps with no charted MAP)
  spec("vitals", "map",              "map_mean",  "mean", 20, 200, locf_hours = 4),

  # Labs (timed by lab_time_col)
  spec("labs", "ph_arterial",     "ph_art",      "last", 6.5,  8.0, locf_hours = 12),
  spec("labs", "po2_arterial",    "pao2",        "last", 20,   700, locf_hours = 12),
  spec("labs", "pco2_arterial",   "paco2",       "last", 10,   200, locf_hours = 12),
  spec("labs", "ph_venous",       "ph_ven",      "last", 6.5, 8.0, locf_hours = 12),
  spec("labs", "pco2_venous",     "pco2_ven",    "last", 10,  200, locf_hours = 12),
  spec("labs", "lactate",         "lactate",     "last", 0,    30,  locf_hours = 24),
  spec("labs", "bicarbonate",     "bicarbonate", "last", 2,    60,  locf_hours = 24),
  spec("labs", "creatinine",      "creatinine",  "last", 0.1,  25,  locf_hours = 48),
  spec("labs", "bilirubin_total", "bilirubin",   "last", 0,    80,  locf_hours = 48),
  spec("labs", "platelet_count",  "platelets",   "last", 1,  2000,  locf_hours = 48),
  # Assessments
  spec("assess", "rass",      "rass",      "last", -5,  4, locf_hours = 12),
  spec("assess", "gcs_total", "gcs_total", "last",  3, 15, locf_hours = 12),
  # Respiratory support (fio2_combined is derived in the loader; columns missing from your table come out empty)
  spec("resp", "fio2_combined",                 "fio2",    "last", 0.21, 1,    locf_hours = 12),
  spec("resp", "peep_set",                      "peep",    "last", 0,    30,   locf_hours = 12),
  spec("resp", "peep_obs",                      "peep_measured", "last", 0,   30,   locf_hours = 12), 
  spec("resp", "tidal_volume_set",              "vt_set",  "last", 100,  1200, locf_hours = 12),
  spec("resp", "resp_rate_set",                 "rr_set",  "last", 0,    60,   locf_hours = 12),
  #spec("resp", "pressure_support_set",          "ps_set",  "last", 0,    40,   locf_hours = 12),
  #spec("resp", "pressure_control_set",          "pc_set",  "last", 0,    60,   locf_hours = 12),
  spec("resp", "peak_inspiratory_pressure_set", "pip_set", "last", 0,    80,   locf_hours = 12),
  spec("resp", "plateau_pressure_obs",          "pplat",   "last", 0,    80,   locf_hours = 12),
  # Position: prone = 1, not prone = 0; missing = not prone (proning is reliably documented)
  spec("position", "prone", "prone", "last", 0, 1, locf_hours = 16, na_to_zero = TRUE),
  # Continuous infusions: rate at the end of the epoch, carried while running, 0 when not running
  rbindlist(lapply(cont_meds, function(m)
    spec("meds_cont", m, paste0(m, "_rate"), "last", 0, Inf, locf_hours = 6, na_to_zero = TRUE))), #build out based on list above instead of coding individual feature - na_to_zero turns missing data to 0
  # Intermittent doses: any dose > 0 in the epoch
  rbindlist(lapply(bolus_meds, function(m)
    spec("meds_int", m, paste0(m, "_bolus"), "any", 0, Inf, na_to_zero = TRUE)))
))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(feature_spec$feature)) #make sure no 2 features have the same name
generated <- c(paste0(feature_spec$feature, "_obs"), paste0(feature_spec$feature, "_hrs_since_obs")) #create _obs binary columns and _hrs_since_obs columns
stopifnot(!any(feature_spec$feature %in% generated)) #double check the _obs columns do not repeat 

# ---- Upper bounds for continuous meds, in STANDARDIZED units (see med_dose_std_distribution audit) ----
# Readings above these are treated as charting errors and dropped; the previous rate carries forward.
med_hi <- c(norepinephrine       = 3,      # mcg/kg/min
            epinephrine          = 2,      # mcg/kg/min
            phenylephrine        = 15,     # mcg/kg/min
            vasopressin          = 0.2,    # units/min
            dopamine             = 50,     # mcg/kg/min
            dobutamine           = 40,     # mcg/kg/min
            propofol             = 200,    # mcg/kg/min
            dexmedetomidine      = 3,      # mcg/kg/hr
            midazolam            = 200,    # mg/hr
            ketamine             = 15,     # mg/kg/hr
            fentanyl             = 1000,   # mcg/hr
            hydromorphone        = 30,     # mg/hr
            cisatracurium        = 20,     # mcg/kg/min
            vecuronium           = 5,      # mcg/kg/min
            rocuronium           = 30,     # mcg/kg/min
            epoprostenol_iv      = 200,    # ng/kg/min
            epoprostenol_inhaled = 0.2,    # mcg/kg/min
            treprostinil_iv      = 300,    # ng/kg/min
            alprostadil_iv       = Inf,    # mcg/hr - set after checking the distribution
            nitric_oxide_inhaled = 80)     # ppm
feature_spec[source == "meds_cont", hi := fcoalesce(unname(med_hi[key]), Inf)]

# Categorical features: last value in the epoch, carried forward; one-hot encode at final model prep
cat_spec <- data.table(src_col = c("device_category", "mode_category"),
                       feature = c("device", "vent_mode"),
                       locf_hours = 12) #registry for the text-based features - can't use mean, min, max for these
setnames(cat_spec, "src_col", "key") #rename to "key" so works with rest of pipeline

#)3. Source loaders: each returns (hospitalization_id, event_time, key, value)
if (!lab_time_col %in% names(labs_time_dependent)) stop(lab_time_col, " is not a column of labs_time_dependent") #make sure lab_time_col we chose above exists in our lab table 

# RASS: numeric value if present; otherwise parse categorical text 
#   bare number:     "0", "-3", "+4"
#   parenthesized:   "(0) - alert and calm", "(-3) - moderate sedation", "(+4) - combative" 
parse_rass <- function(num, cat) {
  cat <- trimws(as.character(cat))
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(num))

  bare <- is.na(out) & grepl("^\\+?(-?5|-?4|-?3|-?2|-?1|0|1|2|3|4)$", cat)
  out[bare] <- as.numeric(sub("^\\+", "", cat[bare]))

  paren <- is.na(out) & grepl("^\\(\\+?-?[0-5]\\)", cat)
  out[paren] <- as.numeric(sub("^\\(\\+?(-?[0-5])\\).*$", "\\1", cat[paren]))

  out
}

#function to build standardized shape for each feature
load_source <- function(source, keys) {
  switch(source,
    vitals = {
      v <- vitals[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hids & vital_category %in% c(keys, "sbp", "dbp"),
                  .(hospitalization_id, event_time = recorded_dttm, key = vital_category, value = as.numeric(vital_value))]
      if ("map" %in% keys) {
        bp <- dcast(v[key %in% c("sbp", "dbp", "map")], hospitalization_id + event_time ~ key,
                    value.var = "value", fun.aggregate = mean, fill = NA) #if we are using map then this will fire and split them into their own columns
        for (cc in c("sbp", "dbp", "map")) if (!cc %in% names(bp)) bp[, (cc) := NA_real_]
        v <- rbind(v, bp[is.na(map) & !is.na(sbp) & !is.na(dbp),
                         .(hospitalization_id, event_time, key = "map", value = (sbp + 2 * dbp) / 3)])
      } #for rows with missing maps add in map based off sbp/dbp, charted map never overwritten
      v[key %in% keys] #drop the sbp and dbp and go back to just key values
    },
    labs = labs_time_dependent[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hids & lab_category %in% keys,
      .(hospitalization_id, event_time = get(lab_time_col), key = lab_category, value = as.numeric(lab_value_numeric))], #simplify labs to just those identified above and the categories in keys. use lab_time_col as defined above
    assess = {
      a <- patient_assessments[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hids & assessment_category %in% keys,
             .(hospitalization_id, event_time = recorded_dttm, key = assessment_category,
               num = numerical_value, cat = categorical_value)]
      a[, value := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(num))]
      a[key == "rass", value := parse_rass(num, cat)] #use the parse_rass function from above to convert any categorical values of rass
      a[, .(hospitalization_id, event_time, key, value)]
    },
    resp = {
      rs  <- respiratory_support[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hids] #filter respiratory just for our cohort
      out <- list() #create blank list
      num_cols <- intersect(setdiff(keys, "fio2_combined"), names(rs)) #Remove fio2_combined from the keys because it isn't in respiratory_support
      if (length(num_cols)) {
        m <- rs[, c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm", num_cols), with = FALSE] #reduced columns table
        m[, (num_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))), .SDcols = num_cols] #make sure all num_cols are actually numbers
        out$num <- melt(m, id.vars = c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm"), variable.name = "key",
                        value.name = "value", variable.factor = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) #turn each feature column into their own rows
      }
      # rule for creating fio2_combined
      if ("fio2_combined" %in% keys) {
        f <- rs[, .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, device_category,
                    fio2 = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fio2_set)),
                    lpm  = if ("lpm_set" %in% names(rs)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(lpm_set)) else NA_real_)] #filter resp_support
        f[!is.na(fio2) & fio2 > 1, fio2 := fio2 / 100]            # per-row scaling (21-100 -> 0.21-1)
        f[, value := fcase(
          !is.na(fio2),                                                 fio2,
          device_category == "room air",                                0.21,
          device_category == "nasal cannula" & lpm > 0 & lpm <= 6,      0.21 + 0.04 * lpm,
          device_category == "face mask" & lpm >= 6 & lpm <= 10,        0.35 + 0.06 * (lpm - 6),
          device_category == "face mask" & lpm > 10,                    0.90,
          default = NA_real_)]
        out$fio2 <- f[!is.na(value), .(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, key = "fio2_combined", value)] #change name of fio2 to fio2_combined
      }
      r <- rbindlist(out, use.names = TRUE)
      setnames(r, "recorded_dttm", "event_time")
      r #combine and return 
    },
    meds_cont = meds[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hids & tolower(med_category) %in% keys, #narrow table to necessary columns
      .(hospitalization_id, event_time = admin_dttm, key = tolower(med_category), value = med_dose_std)], #define event_time
    meds_int = intermittent_meds[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hids & tolower(med_category) %in% keys, #narrow table to necessary columns
      .(hospitalization_id, event_time = admin_dttm, key = tolower(med_category), value = as.numeric(med_dose))],
    position = position[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hids & !is.na(position_category),
      .(hospitalization_id, event_time = recorded_dttm, key = "prone",
        value = as.numeric(position_category == "prone"))],
    stop("Unknown source: ", source)) #define event_time
}
#Loader function for categorical variables from respiratory_support table - mirrors the one above but only for categorical variables
load_cat <- function(keys) {
  cols <- intersect(keys, names(respiratory_support))
  rs <- respiratory_support[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hids, c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm", cols), with = FALSE]
  rs[, (cols) := lapply(.SD, as.character), .SDcols = cols]
  r <- melt(rs, id.vars = c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm"), variable.name = "key",
            value.name = "value", variable.factor = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  r[, value := tolower(trimws(value))]
  r <- r[value != ""]
  setnames(r, "recorded_dttm", "event_time")
  r
}

#)4. Load, attach feature definitions, apply bounds
long <- rbindlist(lapply(unique(feature_spec$source), function(s)
  load_source(s, unique(feature_spec[source == s, key]))[, source := s]), use.names = TRUE) #for each source, use load_source function above and loop through each source category according to function
long <- long[!is.na(event_time) & !is.na(value)] #remove any rows where event_time or value are missing

long <- merge(long, feature_spec, by = c("source", "key"), allow.cartesian = TRUE)   #combine long and the feature_spec defined above one row per reading x feature
audit_raw <- long[, .(n_raw_rows = .N, n_out_of_bounds = sum(value < lo | value > hi)), by = feature] #audit of frequency of each feature and how many are removed for high or low values outside of bounds
long <- long[value >= lo & value <= hi] #keep only the features inside of those bounds
long[, event_s := as.numeric(event_time)] #convert time to seconds

#)5. Assign readings to runs and epochs (handles several runs per hospitalization
max_persist_s <- max(c(0, feature_spec$persist_hours)) * 3600 #Define how far back to look at events based on feature_spec converted to secs
win <- runs[, .(imv_run_id, hospitalization_id, begin_s,
                lo_s = begin_s - lookback_epochs * epoch_s - max_persist_s, hi_s = end_s)] #make table with one row per run and define start and stop windows

inw <- long[win, .(imv_run_id, feature, agg, persist_hours, value, event_s = x.event_s, begin_s = i.begin_s),
            on = .(hospitalization_id, event_s >= lo_s, event_s < hi_s), nomatch = 0L, allow.cartesian = TRUE] #non-equi join long and win 
inw[, epoch := as.integer(floor((event_s - begin_s) / epoch_s))] #use time from begin_s in seconds to determine which epoch the event happened and store as an integer

# Persisting events cover every epoch from their time until persist_hours later
# persist_hours is a marker for any feature that may last only for a set period of time that extends beyond multiple epochs
# not currently using persist_hours but left in modeling in case we need to use later
if (any(inw$persist_hours > 0)) { #code for how to interpret persist_hours
  p <- inw[persist_hours > 0]
  p[, e_end := as.integer(floor((event_s + persist_hours * 3600 - begin_s) / epoch_s))]
  p[, r := .I]
  p <- p[, .(epoch = seq.int(epoch, e_end)), by = .(r, imv_run_id, feature, agg, value, event_s)][, r := NULL]
  inw <- rbindlist(list(inw[persist_hours == 0, .(imv_run_id, feature, agg, value, event_s, epoch)], p), use.names = TRUE)
} else {
  inw <- inw[, .(imv_run_id, feature, agg, value, event_s, epoch)] #if persist_hours isn't there then keep the same columns
}
inw <- inw[epoch >= -lookback_epochs] #drop data from before the lookback window

#)6. Aggregate within epochs, reshape once
# Set up function for how to handle multiple readings in one epoch
  # d is table where readings all use the same aggregation
  # how is the name of the aggregation
agg_fun <- function(d, how) {
  b <- c("imv_run_id", "epoch", "feature") #define grouping columns once - each  row is one run, epoch, and feature
  switch(how,                              #define how each grouping column handles values
    mean  = d[, .(value = mean(value)), by = b],
    min   = d[, .(value = min(value)),  by = b],
    max   = d[, .(value = max(value)),  by = b],
    sum   = d[, .(value = sum(value)),  by = b],
    count = d[, .(value = as.numeric(.N)), by = b],
    any   = d[, .(value = as.numeric(any(value > 0))), by = b],
    last  = d[order(event_s), .(value = value[.N]), by = b],
    first = d[order(event_s), .(value = value[1L]), by = b],
    stop("Unknown agg: ", how))
} #define the way "how" matches each line 
binned <- rbindlist(lapply(unique(inw$agg), function(h) agg_fun(inw[agg == h], h))) #still long format, one row per run, epoch, and feature
wide   <- dcast(binned, imv_run_id + epoch ~ feature, value.var = "value") #pivot to wide table

epochs <- merge(grid, wide, by = c("imv_run_id", "epoch"), all.x = TRUE) #merge the pre-formed grid and the wide table containing all of the features
for (f in setdiff(feature_spec$feature, names(epochs))) epochs[, (f) := NA_real_] #Fill in missing numeric column values with NA
   
# Categorical features (same window / epoch logic, last value per epoch)
cat_long <- merge(load_cat(cat_spec$key), cat_spec[, .(key, feature)], by = "key") #load raw categorical values
cat_long[, event_s := as.numeric(event_time)] #convert timestamp to numeric seconds
cat_in <- cat_long[win, .(imv_run_id, feature, value, event_s = x.event_s, begin_s = i.begin_s),
                   on = .(hospitalization_id, event_s >= lo_s, event_s < hi_s), nomatch = 0L, allow.cartesian = TRUE] #non-equi join - for each run window find the cat records that fall within lo_s and hi_s 
cat_in[, epoch := as.integer(floor((event_s - begin_s) / epoch_s))] #assign each cat record to an epoch based on sec
cat_b <- cat_in[epoch >= -lookback_epochs][order(event_s), .(value = value[.N]), by = .(imv_run_id, epoch, feature)] # only keep records within the lookback period
epochs <- merge(epochs, dcast(cat_b, imv_run_id + epoch ~ feature, value.var = "value"),
                by = c("imv_run_id", "epoch"), all.x = TRUE) #pivot the categorical values then merge them into epochs
for (f in setdiff(cat_spec$feature, names(epochs))) epochs[, (f) := NA_character_] #add all-NA values to for any categorical feature with no data

setorder(epochs, imv_run_id, epoch) #sort everything according to epoch per run_id for LOCF

#)7. Observation flags, limited carry-forward, zero-fill
# Vectorized LOCF: never crosses runs, never older than limit_epochs; works for numeric and character
locf_limited <- function(dt, col, limit_epochs, add_since) {
  v <- dt[[col]] #pull out a column
  i <- nafill(fifelse(!is.na(v), seq_along(v), NA_integer_), type = "locf") #find most recent non-NA obs before epoch
  s <- dt$epoch - dt$epoch[i] #how many epochs have passed since that observation
  keep <- !is.na(i) & dt$imv_run_id[i] == dt$imv_run_id & !is.na(s) & s <= limit_epochs #keep values that are non-NA, belong to the same run_id, have a known gap and gap is shorter than locf_hours for a feature
  keep[is.na(keep)] <- FALSE #turn leftover NAs to FALSE for safety
  out <- v[i]; out[!keep] <- NA #Fill in rows based on i
  set(dt, j = col, value = out) #overwrite the column in place to restart loop
  if (add_since) { s[!keep] <- NA; set(dt, j = paste0(col, "_hrs_since_obs"), value = as.numeric(s) * epoch_hours) }
} #last line adds in hours since obs optional decided above

for (k in seq_len(nrow(feature_spec))) {
  f <- feature_spec$feature[k]; zero <- feature_spec$na_to_zero[k] #use feature_spec defined at top of block
  lim <- as.integer(floor(feature_spec$locf_hours[k] / epoch_hours)) #round the locf_hours into whole epochs
  if (add_obs_flags && !zero) set(epochs, j = paste0(f, "_obs"), value = as.integer(!is.na(epochs[[f]]))) #add obs flag if epoch had real measurement
  if (lim > 0) locf_limited(epochs, f, lim, add_since = add_time_since && !zero) #add time since feature
  if (zero) set(epochs, i = which(is.na(epochs[[f]])), j = f, value = 0) #any remaining NA is changed to 0 for numeric features
}
for (k in seq_len(nrow(cat_spec))) {
  locf_limited(epochs, cat_spec$feature[k], as.integer(floor(cat_spec$locf_hours[k] / epoch_hours)), add_since = FALSE) #same as previous loop but for categorical values, no lim >0 guard 
}

epoch_table <- epochs #create epoch_table
rm(long, inw, binned, wide, cat_long, cat_in, cat_b); gc() #remove tables from memory

#)8. Audits
post <- epoch_table[epoch >= 0]   # coverage is reported over the IMV epochs only
#create audit table 
audit_coverage <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(feature_spec)), function(k) {
  f <- feature_spec$feature[k]
  data.table(feature = f,
             pct_epochs_measured   = if (paste0(f, "_obs") %in% names(post)) round(100 * mean(post[[paste0(f, "_obs")]]), 1) else NA_real_,
             pct_epochs_nonmissing = round(100 * mean(!is.na(post[[f]])), 1),
             pct_epochs_nonzero    = if (feature_spec$na_to_zero[k]) round(100 * mean(post[[f]] > 0), 1) else NA_real_)
}))
#Inner merge - creates one row per feature 
audit_features <- merge(feature_spec[, .(feature, source, key, agg, locf_hours, persist_hours, na_to_zero)],
                        merge(audit_raw, audit_coverage, by = "feature", all = TRUE), by = "feature", all.x = TRUE)
print(audit_features)

# Infusion units: decide on conversions before trusting dose columns
audit_med_units <- meds[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hids & tolower(med_category) %in% cont_meds,
                        .N, by = .(med_category = tolower(med_category), med_dose_unit)][order(med_category, -N)]
print(audit_med_units)

c(runs = uniqueN(epoch_table$imv_run_id), epochs = nrow(epoch_table),
  imv_epochs = nrow(post), cols = ncol(epoch_table))

fwrite(audit_features,  file.path(audit_dir, paste0("epoch_audit_features_",  stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(audit_med_units, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("epoch_audit_med_units_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
}
```

```{r} 
abx_tbl <- data.table(
  med_category = c("meropenem", "amikacin", "linezolid", "trimethoprim_sulfamethoxazole",

)

#1) Load antibiotic administrations
```
