```{r} 
# Spelling check: any of your drug names that never appear will silently produce all-zero columns
abx_tbl[, found_in_data := med_category %in% unique(abx_raw$med_category)]
abx_tbl[found_in_data == FALSE, med_category] #which drug that we want is not actually in the list of med_categories?
unique(abx_raw$med_category)[grepl("mero|amik|linez|trimeth|sulfa|avib|vanc|tolo|piper|cefep|ceftri|azith|levo|cefaz",
                                   unique(abx_raw$med_category))] #check if anything is missing from list above w grepl

abx_raw <- abx_raw[med_category %in% abx_tbl$med_category] #filter for only abx we want
print(abx_raw[, .N, by = .(med_category, med_route_category)][order(med_category, -N)])   #check route names

abx <- abx_raw[!is.na(admin_dttm) & suppressWarnings(as.numeric(med_dose)) > 0, #make sure med_dose is real and above 0
               .(hospitalization_id, t = as.numeric(admin_dttm), #use numeric time for matching to epochs
                 med_category = fifelse(med_category == "vancomycin" & med_route_category %in% nonsystemic_routes,
                                        "vancomycin_enteral", med_category))] #create category for non-systemic vanco
abx <- unique(abx) #remove any duplicates
abx <- merge(abx, abx_tbl[, .(med_category, default_interval_hrs, max_interval_hrs)], by = "med_category") #merge w abx table

#)2 Collapse near-duplicate doses, build courses, compute coverage intervals
setorder(abx, hospitalization_id, med_category, t) #put all meds in order of time of admin
abx[, gap_prev_h := (t - shift(t)) / 3600, by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category)] #calc time since previous admin in hours
abx <- abx[is.na(gap_prev_h) | gap_prev_h >= min_dose_gap_hrs] #drop duplicates within 1 hour - only use first time

abx[, gap_prev_h := (t - shift(t)) / 3600, by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category)] #re-calculate without dups
abx[, gap_next_h := (shift(t, type = "lead") - t) / 3600, by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category)] #hours until next dose
abx[, course := cumsum(is.na(gap_prev_h) | gap_prev_h > max_interval_hrs), by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category)] #create id for each run of abx

#Observed dosing interval for each course (median within-course gap); single-dose courses use the default
abx[, course_interval_h := {
  g <- gap_next_h[!is.na(gap_next_h) & gap_next_h <= max_interval_hrs]
  if (length(g)) median(g) else default_interval_hrs[1]
}, by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category, course)]

#Coverage: until the next dose if still in the same course, otherwise one course interval
abx[, cover_end := fifelse(!is.na(gap_next_h) & gap_next_h <= max_interval_hrs,
                           t + gap_next_h * 3600,
                           t + course_interval_h * 3600)] #measure in seconds for consistency
#TMP-SMX: a course dosed every >= 20 h (daily or thrice weekly) is prophylaxis; q6-12h is treatment
abx[med_category == "trimethoprim_sulfamethoxazole" & course_interval_h >= 20,
    med_category := "trimethoprim_sulfamethoxazole_prophylaxis"]
abx[grepl("trimethoprim", med_category), .(courses = uniqueN(paste(hospitalization_id, course))), by = med_category]

#)3 Map coverage intervals onto each run's epochs
abx_runs <- unique(epoch_table[, .(imv_run_id, hospitalization_id, begin_s, n_epochs)]) #create runs table from epoch table
abx_runs[, `:=`(lo_s = begin_s - lookback_epochs * epoch_s, hi_s = begin_s + n_epochs * epoch_s)] #create lo_s which creates start of window and hi_s which ends the window

ov <- abx[abx_runs, .(imv_run_id, med_category, t = x.t, cover_end = x.cover_end,
                      begin_s = i.begin_s, n_epochs = i.n_epochs),
          on = .(hospitalization_id, cover_end > lo_s, t < hi_s), nomatch = 0L, allow.cartesian = TRUE] #non-equi join - finds every dose in same hospitalization whose coverage overlaps the run's window
ov[, e0 := pmax(as.integer(floor((t - begin_s) / epoch_s)), -lookback_epochs)] #determine first active epoch (t=admin_dttm)
ov[, e1 := pmin(as.integer(ceiling((cover_end - begin_s) / epoch_s)) - 1L, n_epochs - 1L)] #determine last active epoch
ov <- ov[e1 >= e0] #remove empty intervals - doesn't change rows in penn data
ov[, r := .I] #number the rows

act <- ov[, .(epoch = seq.int(e0, e1)), by = .(r, imv_run_id, med_category)][, r := NULL] #expand each interval to one row per active epoch
act <- unique(act) #remove overlaps
act[, `:=`(feat = paste0("abx_", med_category), active = 1L)] #name the feature column
abx_wide <- dcast(act, imv_run_id + epoch ~ feat, value.var = "active", fill = 0L) #cast wide so one column per antibiotic

#)4. Attach to epoch_table
old <- grep("^abx_|^nat_score$", names(epoch_table), value = TRUE) #find old columns if they exist in epoch table already
if (length(old)) epoch_table[, (old) := NULL] #remove those columns so the new ones can be added after

abx_cols <- setdiff(names(abx_wide), c("imv_run_id", "epoch")) #list of the abx features
epoch_table[abx_wide, on = .(imv_run_id, epoch), (abx_cols) := mget(paste0("i.", abx_cols))] #join by run_id/epoch

all_abx_cols <- paste0("abx_", union(abx_tbl$med_category, unique(abx$med_category)))         #every drug gets a column, even if never given
for (cc in setdiff(all_abx_cols, names(epoch_table))) epoch_table[, (cc) := 0L]               #every drug in the list plus any drug in the data that isn't on it
for (cc in all_abx_cols) set(epoch_table, i = which(is.na(epoch_table[[cc]])), j = cc, value = 0L) 

treat_cols <- setdiff(all_abx_cols, grep("_prophylaxis$", all_abx_cols, value = TRUE)) #all abx except prophy
epoch_table[, abx_n_active := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = treat_cols] #calculate abx active per epoch

# Spectrum score = sum of weights of active drugs (only once nat_weight is filled in)
  # not using this functionality at this time - calculating NAT in next section instead
if (any(!is.na(abx_tbl$nat_weight))) {
  w <- abx_tbl[!is.na(nat_weight)]
  epoch_table[, nat_score := as.numeric(as.matrix(.SD) %*% w$nat_weight),
              .SDcols = paste0("abx_", w$med_category)]
}

#)5 Audit
  # list of all abx courses
abx_courses <- abx[, .(n_doses = .N, interval_h = course_interval_h[1]), by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category, course)]
  # audit table
audit_abx <- abx_courses[, .(n_courses = .N, total_doses = sum(n_doses), #total courses
                             pct_single_dose = round(100 * mean(n_doses == 1), 1), #percent single dose courses
                             median_interval_h = median(interval_h), #median interval
                             p90_interval_h = quantile(interval_h, 0.9)), by = med_category] #90th percentile interval
 # add in data for percent of epochs active with each of these antibiotics
audit_abx <- merge(audit_abx,
  data.table(med_category = sub("^abx_", "", all_abx_cols),
             pct_imv_epochs_active = sapply(all_abx_cols, function(cc) round(100 * mean(epoch_table[epoch >= 0][[cc]]), 2))),
  by = "med_category", all = TRUE)
print(audit_abx)
print(epoch_table[epoch >= 0, .N, by = abx_n_active][order(abx_n_active)])
 # save the abx audit files
fwrite(audit_abx, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("abx_coverage_audit_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

################################################################################
# SYSTEMIC CORTICOSTEROIDS: per-drug active flags + hydrocortisone-equivalent dose per epoch
################################################################################

# ---- Drug table: check spellings against your data -------------------------------------
# default_interval_hrs: interval used for single-dose courses and the last dose of a course
# max_interval_hrs:     a longer gap than this starts a new course
# hc_equiv:             mg hydrocortisone per mg of drug (approximate glucocorticoid potency:
#                       hydrocortisone 20 = prednisone 5 = prednisolone 5 = methylprednisolone 4 = dexamethasone 0.75)
  # create steroid table with one row per steroid and data about each steroid
ster_tbl <- data.table(
  med_category         = c("dexamethasone", "hydrocortisone", "methylprednisolone", "prednisone", "prednisolone"),
  default_interval_hrs = c(24,  6, 24, 24, 24),
  max_interval_hrs     = c(36, 16, 36, 36, 36),
  hc_equiv             = c(26.67, 1, 5, 4, 4)
)
ster_min_dose_gap_hrs   <- 1 #doses of same steroid within 1 hour are treated as duplicates
ster_nonsystemic_routes <- c("inhaled", "inhalation", "topical", "ophthalmic", "otic", "nasal", "intranasal",
                             "rectal", "intra-articular", "intraarticular", "intralesional", "intrapleural")  #this is a rough list based off routes seen in Penn data - most of these should not be in CLIF tables yet
ster_flag_cols <- paste0("steroid_", ster_tbl$med_category) #flags to make columns later in epoch table

#)1 Spelling check, then load doses
all_int_cats <- unique(tolower(intermittent_meds$med_category))
ster_tbl[, found_in_data := med_category %in% all_int_cats]                  # verify that steroids we want are in intermittent meds
ster_tbl[found_in_data == FALSE, med_category]                               # names that never appear
all_int_cats[grepl("dexa|cort|pred|solone", all_int_cats)]                    # grepl for any missing ones
 # upload raw steroid data
st_raw <- intermittent_meds[hospitalization_id %in% cohort_hids & tolower(med_category) %in% ster_tbl$med_category,
  .(hospitalization_id, admin_dttm,
    med_category = tolower(med_category),
    med_dose     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(med_dose)),
    unit         = tolower(trimws(med_dose_unit)),
    route        = tolower(trimws(med_route_category)))]

st_route_tbl <- st_raw[, .N, by = .(med_category, route)][order(med_category, -N)]   # check route names
st_unit_tbl  <- st_raw[, .N, by = .(med_category, unit)][order(med_category, -N)]    # check units
print(st_route_tbl)
print(st_unit_tbl)

st <- st_raw[!is.na(admin_dttm) & !is.na(med_dose) & med_dose > 0 & !(route %in% ster_nonsystemic_routes)] #keep only doses with times and real doses
 # convert every dose to mg
st[, dose_mg := fcase(unit == "mg",  med_dose,
                      unit == "g",   med_dose * 1000,
                      unit == "mcg", med_dose / 1000,
                      default = NA_real_)]
n_ster_bad_unit <- st[is.na(dose_mg), .N]     #count and drop rows with unusable units (mg/kg)
print(n_ster_bad_unit)
st <- st[!is.na(dose_mg), .(hospitalization_id, med_category, t = as.numeric(admin_dttm), dose_mg)] #reduce down table
st <- merge(st, ster_tbl[, .(med_category, default_interval_hrs, max_interval_hrs, hc_equiv)], by = "med_category") #merge w data from steroid table

#)2 Collapse near-duplicates (keep the larger dose), build courses and coverage 
setorder(st, hospitalization_id, med_category, t) #put table in order of time of admin
st[, gap_prev_h := (t - shift(t)) / 3600, by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category)] #calc time since previous admin in hours
st[, cluster := cumsum(is.na(gap_prev_h) | gap_prev_h >= ster_min_dose_gap_hrs), by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category)] #group near duplicates
st <- st[, .(t = t[1], dose_mg = max(dose_mg),
             default_interval_hrs = default_interval_hrs[1], max_interval_hrs = max_interval_hrs[1],
             hc_equiv = hc_equiv[1]),
         by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category, cluster)][, cluster := NULL] #collapse clusters, use largest charted dose, drop cluster column

st[, gap_prev_h := (t - shift(t)) / 3600, by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category)] #recompute the gaps
st[, gap_next_h := (shift(t, type = "lead") - t) / 3600, by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category)] #time until the next dose given
st[, course := cumsum(is.na(gap_prev_h) | gap_prev_h > max_interval_hrs), by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category)] #calc courses - new course starts at first dose or after gap longer than max_interval_hrs
st[, course_interval_h := {
  g <- gap_next_h[!is.na(gap_next_h) & gap_next_h <= max_interval_hrs]
  if (length(g)) median(g) else default_interval_hrs[1]
}, by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category, course)] #calculate median gaps
st[, cover_end := fifelse(!is.na(gap_next_h) & gap_next_h <= max_interval_hrs,
                          t + gap_next_h * 3600,
                          t + course_interval_h * 3600)] #calculate how long each dose covers in seconds

#Each dose spread evenly over its coverage: mg hydrocortisone-equivalent per second
st[, hc_rate_s := dose_mg * hc_equiv / (cover_end - t)] 

#)3. Map coverage onto each run's epochs, with the exact overlap per epoch
st_runs <- unique(epoch_table[, .(imv_run_id, hospitalization_id, begin_s, n_epochs)]) #calculate from epoch table
st_runs[, `:=`(lo_s = begin_s - lookback_epochs * epoch_s, hi_s = begin_s + n_epochs * epoch_s)] #create lo_s which creates start of window and hi_s which ends the window

st_ov <- st[st_runs, .(imv_run_id, med_category, t = x.t, cover_end = x.cover_end, hc_rate_s = x.hc_rate_s,
                       begin_s = i.begin_s, n_epochs = i.n_epochs),
            on = .(hospitalization_id, cover_end > lo_s, t < hi_s), nomatch = 0L, allow.cartesian = TRUE] #non-equi join - finds every dose in same hospitalization whose coverage overlaps the run's window
st_ov[, e0 := pmax(as.integer(floor((t - begin_s) / epoch_s)), -lookback_epochs)] #determine first active epoch (t=admin_dttm)
st_ov[, e1 := pmin(as.integer(ceiling((cover_end - begin_s) / epoch_s)) - 1L, n_epochs - 1L)] #determine last active epoch
st_ov <- st_ov[e1 >= e0] #remove empty intervals - doesn't change rows in penn data
st_ov[, r := .I] #numer the rows

st_act <- st_ov[, .(epoch = seq.int(e0, e1)), by = .(r, imv_run_id, med_category, t, cover_end, hc_rate_s, begin_s)] #expand each interval to one row per active epoch
st_act[, `:=`(ep_start = begin_s + epoch * epoch_s, ep_end = begin_s + (epoch + 1L) * epoch_s)] #epoch start times in seconds
st_act[, overlap_s := pmax(0, pmin(cover_end, ep_end) - pmax(t, ep_start))] #look at overlap in seconds
st_act <- st_act[overlap_s > 0] #remove rows where overlap is 0
st_act[, hc_mg := hc_rate_s * overlap_s] #total amount of drug in each epoch

#)4 Per-epoch features
st_dose <- st_act[, .(steroid_hc_eq_mg_day = sum(hc_mg) * 86400 / epoch_s), by = .(imv_run_id, epoch)] #total steroid per day

st_flags <- unique(st_act[, .(imv_run_id, epoch, feat = paste0("steroid_", med_category))]) #keep only unique runs
st_flags[, active := 1L] #set to 1 on every row
st_wide <- dcast(st_flags, imv_run_id + epoch ~ feat, value.var = "active", fill = 0L) #cast the table to wide
st_wide <- merge(st_wide, st_dose, by = c("imv_run_id", "epoch"), all = TRUE) #merge with st dose table from above

#)5 Attach to epoch_table
old <- grep("^steroid_", names(epoch_table), value = TRUE) #Find old values from previous run
if (length(old)) epoch_table[, (old) := NULL] #Remove those old columns

st_cols <- setdiff(names(st_wide), c("imv_run_id", "epoch")) #list of the steroid features
epoch_table[st_wide, on = .(imv_run_id, epoch), (st_cols) := mget(paste0("i.", st_cols))] #join by run_id/epoch

for (cc in setdiff(ster_flag_cols, names(epoch_table))) epoch_table[, (cc) := 0L] #create missing per-drug columns
for (cc in ster_flag_cols) set(epoch_table, i = which(is.na(epoch_table[[cc]])), j = cc, value = 0L) #fill with NAs
if (!"steroid_hc_eq_mg_day" %in% names(epoch_table)) epoch_table[, steroid_hc_eq_mg_day := 0]
set(epoch_table, i = which(is.na(epoch_table$steroid_hc_eq_mg_day)), j = "steroid_hc_eq_mg_day", value = 0) #hours w no steroid exposure get a 0
epoch_table[, steroid_any_active := as.integer(rowSums(.SD) > 0), .SDcols = ster_flag_cols] #on any steroid flag

#6) Audits
 # list of all steroid courses
st_courses <- st[, .(n_doses = .N, interval_h = course_interval_h[1]), by = .(hospitalization_id, med_category, course)]
  # audit table
audit_ster <- st_courses[, .(n_courses = .N, total_doses = sum(n_doses), #total number of courses
                             pct_single_dose   = round(100 * mean(n_doses == 1), 1), #percent single dose
                             median_interval_h = median(interval_h), #median interval
                             p90_interval_h    = quantile(interval_h, 0.9)), by = med_category] #90th percentile
st_post <- epoch_table[epoch >= 0] #filter only to epochs before 0
audit_ster <- merge(audit_ster,
  data.table(med_category = ster_tbl$med_category,
             pct_imv_epochs_active = sapply(ster_flag_cols, function(cc) round(100 * mean(st_post[[cc]]), 2))),
  by = "med_category", all = TRUE)
print(audit_ster)
c(dropped_unconvertible_units = n_ster_bad_unit,
  pct_imv_epochs_any_steroid  = round(100 * mean(st_post$steroid_any_active), 2))

 # Hydrocortisone-equivalent dose among hours on steroids (mg/day)
round(quantile(st_post[steroid_hc_eq_mg_day > 0, steroid_hc_eq_mg_day], c(.1, .25, .5, .75, .9, .99)), 1)
 # save the files
fwrite(audit_ster,   file.path(audit_dir, paste0("steroid_audit_",       stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(st_unit_tbl,  file.path(audit_dir, paste0("steroid_units_",       stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(st_route_tbl, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("steroid_routes_",      stamp, institution, ".csv")))


################################################################################
# RESPIRATORY VIRAL TESTS
# Per-epoch "active" flags + run-level flags. Searches ALL of a patient's encounters.
################################################################################

#)0 Column names in the viral table
viral_col <- c(hospitalization_id = "hospitalization_id",
               patient_id         = NA,                     # set if viral has its own patient_id column
               collect_dttm       = "collect_dttm",
               result_dttm        = "result_dttm",          # NA if there is no result time (falls back to collection)
               organism           = "organism_category",
               organism_group     = "organism_group",
               result             = "result_category")
missing_cols <- setdiff(na.omit(viral_col), names(viral))
if (length(missing_cols)) stop("Not in viral: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))

# Set up Parameters
lookback_days <- 14         # count positive tests collected up to this many days before begin_obs
post_imv_days <- 2          # descriptive run-level flag also counts tests collected shortly AFTER intubation
active_from   <- "result"   # "result" = active once resulted (model-safe); "collect" = from specimen time

# Group definitions (checked in this order; first match wins)
grp_sars_category    <- "sars_cov2"                                        # organism_category
grp_influenza_group  <- "influenza"                                        # organism_group
grp_rsv_group        <- "respiratory_syncytial_virus"                      # organism_group
grp_other_groups     <- c("adenovirus", "parainfluenza", "rhinovirus")     # organism_group
grp_other_categories <- c("coronavirus_hku1", "coronavirus_nl63", "coronavirus_oc43",
                          "human_metapneumovirus", "coronavirus_other", "coronavirus_229e")    # organism_category

# active_days: how long after COLLECTION a positive counts as active
  ## need to fill these days in with more evidence in future iterations ##
virus_groups <- data.table(
  group       = c("sars_cov2", "influenza", "rsv", "other_resp"),
  active_days = c(21, 14, 14, 14))

#)1 Standardize the viral table
v <- data.table( #create viral table for standardization in case of issues with mapping
  hospitalization_id = viral[[viral_col[["hospitalization_id"]]]],
  collect_s   = as.numeric(viral[[viral_col[["collect_dttm"]]]]),
  result_s    = if (is.na(viral_col[["result_dttm"]])) NA_real_ else as.numeric(viral[[viral_col[["result_dttm"]]]]),
  organism    = tolower(trimws(as.character(viral[[viral_col[["organism"]]]]))),
  org_group   = tolower(trimws(as.character(viral[[viral_col[["organism_group"]]]]))),
  result      = tolower(trimws(as.character(viral[[viral_col[["result"]]]])))
)

n_viral_rows <- nrow(v)
if (!is.na(viral_col[["patient_id"]])) { #attach patient_id
  v[, patient_id := viral[[viral_col[["patient_id"]]]]]
} else {
  v <- merge(v, hospitalization[, .(hospitalization_id, patient_id)], by = "hospitalization_id")   # all encounters
}
n_unmapped <- n_viral_rows - nrow(v) #how many rows were not mapped
print(n_unmapped)

# Positivity: exact standardized value
v[, positive := result == "detected"]

# Groups for features in table
v[, group := fcase(
  organism  == grp_sars_category,                                          "sars_cov2",
  org_group == grp_influenza_group,                                        "influenza",
  org_group == grp_rsv_group,                                              "rsv",
  org_group %in% grp_other_groups | organism %in% grp_other_categories,    "other_resp",
  default = NA_character_)]

# CHECK THESE before trusting anything downstream - works well at Penn - leaving in for troubleshooting at other sites
viral_result_map   <- v[, .N, by = .(organism_is_sars = organism == grp_sars_category, result, positive)][order(-N)]
viral_organism_map <- v[, .N, by = .(organism, org_group, group)][order(group, -N)]
print(viral_result_map)
print(viral_organism_map)

#)2 Positive tests -> active windows
pos <- v[positive == TRUE & !is.na(group) & !is.na(collect_s)] #filter only for positive tests with known times
pos[is.na(result_s), result_s := collect_s] #if there is no result time then use the collection time
pos <- merge(pos, virus_groups[, .(group, active_days)], by = "group") #merge the positive results with the baseline data 
pos[, start_s := if (active_from == "result") pmax(result_s, collect_s) else collect_s] #determine start of active window
pos[, end_s   := collect_s + active_days * 86400] #determine end of active window
pos <- unique(pos[end_s > start_s, .(patient_id, group, collect_s, result_s, start_s, end_s)]) #drop empty windows and duplicates

#)3 Runs with patient_id and their windows
vruns <- unique(epoch_table[, .(imv_run_id, hospitalization_id, begin_s, n_epochs)]) #create viral runs
vruns <- merge(vruns, hospitalization[, .(hospitalization_id, patient_id)], by = "hospitalization_id") #add in patient_id
vruns[, `:=`(lo_s          = begin_s - lookback_epochs * epoch_s, #start time
             hi_s          = begin_s + n_epochs * epoch_s, #end time
             min_collect_s = begin_s - lookback_days * 86400)] #earliest test we will consider

#)4 Per-epoch active flags
vov <- pos[vruns, .(imv_run_id, group, start_s = x.start_s, end_s = x.end_s,
                    begin_s = i.begin_s, n_epochs = i.n_epochs),
           on = .(patient_id, end_s > lo_s, start_s < hi_s, collect_s >= min_collect_s),
           nomatch = 0L, allow.cartesian = TRUE] #non-equi join between positive tests and runs at patient_id level
vov[, e0 := as.integer(pmax(floor((start_s - begin_s) / epoch_s), -lookback_epochs))] #first epoch the window covers
vov[, e1 := as.integer(pmin(ceiling((end_s - begin_s) / epoch_s) - 1, n_epochs - 1))] #last window the epoch covers
vov <- vov[e1 >= e0] #drop empty intervals - clean at Penn, removes nothing
vov[, r := .I] #add a row id
vact <- vov[, .(epoch = seq.int(e0, e1)), by = .(r, imv_run_id, group)] #one row per active epoch
vact <- unique(vact[, .(imv_run_id, group, epoch)]) #collapse overlaps
vact[, `:=`(feat = paste0("viral_", group, "_active"), active = 1L)] #name the features

old <- grep("^viral_.*_active$", names(epoch_table), value = TRUE) #identify old versions of the viral columns
if (length(old)) epoch_table[, (old) := NULL] #remove those old versions

if (nrow(vact)) { #skip if no positive tests in table for site
  # fun.aggregate = max guarantees 0/1 flags even if duplicate rows ever slip through
  vwide <- dcast(vact, imv_run_id + epoch ~ feat, value.var = "active", fun.aggregate = max, fill = 0L) #make viral wide
  vcols <- setdiff(names(vwide), c("imv_run_id", "epoch")) #list of the virus columns which will be copied onto epoch table below
  epoch_table[vwide, on = .(imv_run_id, epoch), (vcols) := mget(paste0("i.", vcols))]
}
viral_epoch_cols <- paste0("viral_", virus_groups$group, "_active") #full expected set, one per group
for (cc in setdiff(viral_epoch_cols, names(epoch_table))) epoch_table[, (cc) := 0L] #create any missing columns and fill with 0
for (cc in viral_epoch_cols) set(epoch_table, i = which(is.na(epoch_table[[cc]])), j = cc, value = 0L) #fill gaps with 0
epoch_table[, viral_any_active := as.integer(rowSums(.SD) > 0), .SDcols = viral_epoch_cols] #add in the four flags

#)5 Run-level flags on baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs
# _pre_imv      : positive collected within [begin - lookback_days, begin + post_imv_days]  (DESCRIPTIVE)
# _known_at_imv : the same, AND resulted by begin_obs                                       (MODEL-SAFE)
pre <- pos[vruns, .(imv_run_id, group, collect_s = x.collect_s, result_s = x.result_s, begin_s = i.begin_s),
           on = .(patient_id, collect_s >= min_collect_s), nomatch = 0L, allow.cartesian = TRUE] #non-equi join - for each run every positive test from the same patient collected on or after minimum
pre <- pre[collect_s <= begin_s + post_imv_days * 86400] #filter out any tests from after the post_imv_days 
  # may need to consider this design element and change post_imv_days in future iterations - sensitivity analyses?
run_flags <- pre[, .(pre_imv = 1L, known_at_imv = as.integer(any(result_s <= begin_s))), by = .(imv_run_id, group)] #one row per run and virus group

old <- grep("^viral_.*_(pre_imv|known_at_imv)$", names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs), value = TRUE) #find the old columns from previous runs
if (length(old)) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, (old) := NULL] #remove the old columns 

for (what in c("pre_imv", "known_at_imv")) { #run twice - once with pre_imv and then known_at_imv
  rf <- copy(run_flags)[, feat := paste0("viral_", group, "_", what)] #copy of the run flags created above
  if (nrow(rf)) { #skip if no positive tests
    w  <- dcast(rf, imv_run_id ~ feat, value.var = what, fun.aggregate = max, fill = 0L) #make one row per run and one column per virus group filled with flag
    wc <- setdiff(names(w), "imv_run_id")
    baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[w, on = "imv_run_id", (wc) := mget(paste0("i.", wc))] #join onto the baseline runs table
  }
  cols <- paste0("viral_", virus_groups$group, "_", what) #create any virus column that doesn't exist yet as 0
  for (cc in setdiff(cols, names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs))) baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, (cc) := 0L] #turn NAs to 0
  for (cc in cols) set(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs, i = which(is.na(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[[cc]])), j = cc, value = 0L) #fill in gaps=0
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, (paste0("viral_any_", what)) := as.integer(rowSums(.SD) > 0), .SDcols = cols] #add columns for pre-imv viral data
}

#)6 Audits
 # create audit table
audit_viral <- merge(
  pos[, .(n_positive_tests = .N, n_patients = uniqueN(patient_id)), by = group],
  data.table(group = virus_groups$group,
             pct_runs_pre_imv      = sapply(virus_groups$group, function(g) round(100 * mean(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[[paste0("viral_", g, "_pre_imv")]]), 2)), #percent of runs with pre-imv+ values
             pct_runs_known_at_imv = sapply(virus_groups$group, function(g) round(100 * mean(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[[paste0("viral_", g, "_known_at_imv")]]), 2)), #percent of runs with data known at start
             pct_imv_epochs_active = sapply(viral_epoch_cols, function(cc) round(100 * mean(epoch_table[epoch >= 0][[cc]]), 2))),
  by = "group", all = TRUE) #percent of epochs with an active infection - covid dominates this at Penn ~5% of epochs
print(audit_viral)
c(viral_rows = n_viral_rows, rows_without_patient_id = n_unmapped)

# Flags must be 0/1 only
sapply(viral_epoch_cols, function(cc) paste(sort(unique(epoch_table[[cc]])), collapse = ",")) #verify everything is 0 or 1
 # write the audit tables
fwrite(audit_viral,        file.path(audit_dir, paste0("viral_audit_",         stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(viral_organism_map, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("viral_organism_map_",  stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(viral_result_map,   file.path(audit_dir, paste0("viral_result_map_",    stamp, institution, ".csv")))

################################################################################
# LOCATION + HOSPITAL PER EPOCH (ADT)
# location: ICU type when in an ICU, otherwise location_category
# hospital: hospital_id / hospital_type, which can change with inter-hospital transfers
################################################################################

loc_locf_hours <- 2   #carry the last location/hospital across small ADT gaps (hours); longer gaps stay NA

#)1 ADT intervals with the combined location label and the hospital
el <- adt[hospitalization_id %in% unique(epoch_table$hospitalization_id) & !is.na(in_dttm), #filter only for our cohort
          .(hospitalization_id,
            loc_category  = tolower(trimws(location_category)),
            loc_type      = tolower(trimws(location_type)),
            hospital_id,                                                   
            hospital_type = tolower(trimws(hospital_type)),                
            in_s  = as.numeric(in_dttm), #use numeric for future calculations
            out_s = as.numeric(out_dttm))]
el[loc_type == "", loc_type := NA_character_] #if empty then leave NA
el[hospital_type == "", hospital_type := NA_character_]   #if empty then leave NA
el[, location := fifelse(!is.na(loc_type), loc_type, loc_category)] #how we define location - type vs category

setorder(el, hospitalization_id, in_s) #set in chronologic order
el <- el[is.na(out_s) | out_s >= in_s] #drop impossible rows - does nothing at Penn but leave in for safety
el[, next_in_s := shift(in_s, type = "lead"), by = hospitalization_id] #replace a missing end with the next time's start
el[is.na(out_s), out_s := fifelse(!is.na(next_in_s), next_in_s, Inf)]
el <- el[out_s > in_s] #drop zero lenth stays

#)2 Spread each interval over the run epochs it overlaps
el_runs <- unique(epoch_table[, .(imv_run_id, hospitalization_id, begin_s, n_epochs)]) #one row per run
el_runs[, `:=`(lo_s = begin_s - lookback_epochs * epoch_s, hi_s = begin_s + n_epochs * epoch_s)] #define start (lo_s) and stop (hi_s) times

el_ov <- el[el_runs, .(imv_run_id, location, loc_category, hospital_id, hospital_type,
                       in_s = x.in_s, out_s = x.out_s, begin_s = i.begin_s, n_epochs = i.n_epochs),
            on = .(hospitalization_id, out_s > lo_s, in_s < hi_s), nomatch = 0L, allow.cartesian = TRUE] #non-equi join, every ADT stay in the same hospitalization that overlaps the run's window
el_ov[, e0 := as.integer(pmax(floor((in_s - begin_s) / epoch_s), -lookback_epochs))] #first epoch it was active
el_ov[, e1 := as.integer(pmin(ceiling((out_s - begin_s) / epoch_s) - 1, n_epochs - 1))] #last epoch it was active
el_ov <- el_ov[e1 >= e0] #drop stays that don't cover any epoch
el_ov[, r := .I] #give row IDs
el_ep <- el_ov[, .(epoch = seq.int(e0, e1)),
               by = .(r, imv_run_id, location, loc_category, hospital_id, hospital_type, in_s)]   #expand to one row per epoch

#)3 One value per epoch: where the patient is at the END of the hour
setorder(el_ep, imv_run_id, epoch, -in_s) #set the table in reverse chronologic order (prioritize most recent) within each run and epoch
el_change <- el_ep[, .(epoch_location_changed = as.integer(uniqueN(location) > 1), #if patients was in more than 1 location during epoch
                       epoch_hospital_changed = as.integer(uniqueN(hospital_id) > 1)),  #if in more than one hospital in same epoch
                   by = .(imv_run_id, epoch)]
el_last <- unique(el_ep, by = c("imv_run_id", "epoch"))[ #Keep the first row for reach and hour - prioritize most recent (last) within epoch
             , .(imv_run_id, epoch,
                 epoch_location          = location,
                 epoch_location_category = loc_category,
                 epoch_hospital_id       = hospital_id,                    
                 epoch_hospital_type     = hospital_type)]                 
el_last <- merge(el_last, el_change, by = c("imv_run_id", "epoch")) #add in the flags from above 

#)4 Attach, fill short gaps, add an ICU flag
old <- grep("^epoch_location|^epoch_in_icu$|^epoch_hospital", names(epoch_table), value = TRUE)   #Find old location related columns from previous runs
if (length(old)) epoch_table[, (old) := NULL] #remove the old columns
 # update join that copies the six columns from el_last onto epoch_table
epoch_table[el_last, on = .(imv_run_id, epoch),
            `:=`(epoch_location          = i.epoch_location,
                 epoch_location_category = i.epoch_location_category,
                 epoch_location_changed  = i.epoch_location_changed,
                 epoch_hospital_id       = i.epoch_hospital_id,         
                 epoch_hospital_type     = i.epoch_hospital_type,       
                 epoch_hospital_changed  = i.epoch_hospital_changed)]

setorder(epoch_table, imv_run_id, epoch) #put everything in order of epoch
loc_lim <- as.integer(floor(loc_locf_hours / epoch_hours)) #convert the locf_hours into epochs
for (cc in c("epoch_location", "epoch_location_category", "epoch_hospital_id", "epoch_hospital_type")) {
  locf_limited(epoch_table, cc, loc_lim, add_since = FALSE) #LOCF but only for limit to cover small gaps in ADT table
}
epoch_table[is.na(epoch_location_changed), epoch_location_changed := 0L] #Set change flags to 0 when NA
epoch_table[is.na(epoch_hospital_changed), epoch_hospital_changed := 0L]  #Set change flags to 0 when NA                                
epoch_table[, epoch_in_icu := fifelse(is.na(epoch_location_category), NA_integer_,
                                      as.integer(epoch_location_category == "icu"))] #flag for if epoch was in the ICU

#)5 Audits
el_post <- epoch_table[epoch >= 0] #Only look at IMV hours
loc_epoch_dist <- el_post[, .N, by = epoch_location][, pct := round(100 * N / sum(N), 2)][order(-N)] #percent of IMV hours spent in each location
print(loc_epoch_dist)
hosp_epoch_dist <- el_post[, .N, by = .(epoch_hospital_id, epoch_hospital_type)][, pct := round(100 * N / sum(N), 2)][order(-N)]  #percent of IMV hours spent in each hospital
print(hosp_epoch_dist)

c(pct_imv_epochs_missing_location = round(100 * mean(is.na(el_post$epoch_location)), 2), #percent missing location
  pct_imv_epochs_missing_hospital = round(100 * mean(is.na(el_post$epoch_hospital_id)), 2),   #percent missing hospital
  pct_imv_epochs_with_transfer    = round(100 * mean(el_post$epoch_location_changed == 1L), 2), #percent of epochs with internal transfer
  pct_imv_epochs_hospital_change  = round(100 * mean(el_post$epoch_hospital_changed == 1L), 2), #percent of epochs with hospital transfer
  pct_imv_epochs_in_icu           = round(100 * mean(el_post$epoch_in_icu == 1L, na.rm = TRUE), 2)) #percent of epochs in the ICU

# How many runs span more than one hospital (lookback included)?
runs_multi_hosp <- epoch_table[!is.na(epoch_hospital_id), .(n_hospitals = uniqueN(epoch_hospital_id)), by = imv_run_id] #how many runs involve more than one hospital?
print(runs_multi_hosp[, .N, by = n_hospitals][order(n_hospitals)])

# Consistency check: location in the first IMV hour vs. the run-level location_of_intubation
loc_chk <- merge(epoch_table[epoch == 0, .(imv_run_id, epoch_location_category)],
                 baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .(imv_run_id, location_of_intubation)], by = "imv_run_id")
print(loc_chk[, .N, by = .(location_of_intubation, epoch_location_category)][order(-N)][1:15])
 # save the audit files
fwrite(loc_epoch_dist,  file.path(audit_dir, paste0("epoch_location_distribution_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(hosp_epoch_dist, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("epoch_hospital_distribution_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))
}
```
     
# PART EIGHT: Add in baseline characteristics and Calculate scores per row
  # Add in baseline scores
  # Calculate ideal body weight
  # Calculate Vt cc/kg of IBW
  # Calcualte P/F & S/F Ratios - only using SpO2 when it's 97% or lower https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36049490/
  # NAT Score https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39314979/
  # SOFA Score
  # Number of vasopressors
```{r}
if (!use_epoch_cache) {
################################################################################
# DERIVED FEATURES (row-wise on every epoch)
# Run LAST: needs epoch_table with the abx_, location, viral, steroid columns, and the baseline table.
################################################################################

# Define the Parameters needed for part 8!
pf_locf_hours     <- 12     # carry a P/F ratio forward this long after the ABG it came from
sf_locf_hours     <- 4      # carry an S/F ratio forward this long after the SpO2 it came from
sf_spo2_max       <- 97     # S/F only computed when SpO2 <= this (unreliable on the flat part of the curve)
pbw_min_kg        <- 30     # predicted body weight below this is treated as implausible (height error)
sofa_sf_fallback  <- TRUE   # respiratory SOFA uses S/F (converted to P/F) when no P/F is available
vaso_drugs        <- c("norepinephrine", "epinephrine", "phenylephrine", "vasopressin", "dopamine")

# NAT score structure: standard empiric SCAP regimen = 0; narrower/no antibiotics negative; broad positive.
# >>> VERIFY these point values against the scoring table in the NAT paper before using the score <<< ###
nat_pts <- c(no_abx = -2, narrow = -1, standard = 0, anti_mrsa = 1, antipseudomonal = 1)
nat_class <- data.table(
  med_category = c("vancomycin", "linezolid",
                   "cefepime", "piperacillin_tazobactam", "meropenem", "ceftazidime_avibactam",
                   "ceftolozane_tazobactam", "amikacin",
                   "ceftriaxone", "azithromycin", "levofloxacin",
                   "cefazolin", "trimethoprim_sulfamethoxazole"),
  nat_class    = c("anti_mrsa", "anti_mrsa",
                   rep("antipseudomonal", 6),
                   rep("standard", 3),
                   rep("narrow", 2)))
# Not scored: vancomycin_enteral (not systemic) and the *_prophylaxis columns

#)0 Check the columns part eight depends on
needed <- c("pao2", "pao2_obs", "fio2", "spo2_min", "spo2_min_obs", "vt_set", "device", "map_min",
            "platelets", "bilirubin", "creatinine", "gcs_total",
            "norepinephrine_rate", "epinephrine_rate", "dopamine_rate", "dobutamine_rate", "pplat", "peep_measured", "peep")
miss <- setdiff(needed, names(epoch_table))
if (length(miss)) stop("Missing from epoch_table: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", ")) #if they are missing from epoch table then this breaks

derived_cols <- c("age_at_admission", "sex_category", "language_category", "elixhauser_score", "height_cm", "bmi",
                  "intubation_site", "intubated_in_procedural", "intubation_site_uncertain",
                  "admission_type_category", "transfer_in",
                  "ibw_kg", "vt_ml_per_kg_ibw", "pf_ratio", "sf_ratio", "resp_support",
                  "sofa_resp", "sofa_coag", "sofa_liver", "sofa_cardio", "sofa_cns", "sofa_renal",
                  "sofa_total", "sofa_n_missing", "nat_score", "n_vasopressors",
                  "lang_cat_simplified", "driving_pressure", "driving_pressure_src", "low_tidal_volume",
                  "pulm_vasodilator_inhaled", "pulm_vasodilator_iv")
old <- intersect(derived_cols, names(epoch_table)) #define older columns from previous runs
if (length(old)) epoch_table[, (old) := NULL] #delete the old columns if present
setorder(epoch_table, imv_run_id, epoch) #set everything in order of epochs

#)1 Run-level features from the baseline table
base_wanted <- c("age_at_admission", "sex_category", "language_category", "elixhauser_score",
                 "height_cm", "bmi", "intubation_site", "intubated_in_procedural",
                 "intubation_site_uncertain", "admission_type_category") #the baseline characteristics we want
base_cols <- intersect(base_wanted, names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)) #keep the ones present in baseline data
setdiff(base_wanted, base_cols)   # should be empty if all baseline data is present
epoch_table[baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs, on = "imv_run_id",
            (base_cols) := mget(paste0("i.", base_cols))] #update join copying baseline to all epochs

 # 1b. Admitted as a transfer from an outside hospital
transfer_vals <- c("osh") #was the patient transfered into hospital
epoch_table[, transfer_in := as.integer(admission_type_category %in% transfer_vals)] #create transfer in flag

#)2 Ideal (predicted) body weight and tidal volume per kg
# ARDSnet predicted body weight: male 50 + 0.91*(height_cm - 152.4); female 45.5 + 0.91*(height_cm - 152.4)
epoch_table[, ibw_kg := fcase(sex_category == "male",   50   + 0.91 * (height_cm - 152.4),
                              sex_category == "female", 45.5 + 0.91 * (height_cm - 152.4),
                              default = NA_real_)] #Calculate ardsnet IBW
epoch_table[ibw_kg < pbw_min_kg, ibw_kg := NA_real_] #make those under threshold NA
epoch_table[, vt_ml_per_kg_ibw := vt_set / ibw_kg] #calc cc/kg tidal volume

#)3 P/F and S/F
# P/F only where an ABG was actually resulted this epoch (so PaO2 and FiO2 come from the same hour),
# then carried forward. S/F only where SpO2 was measured AND <= sf_spo2_max.
epoch_table[, pf_ratio := fifelse(pao2_obs == 1L & !is.na(fio2) & fio2 > 0, pao2 / fio2, NA_real_)] #calculate p/f under conditions
epoch_table[, sf_ratio := fifelse(spo2_min_obs == 1L & spo2_min <= sf_spo2_max & !is.na(fio2) & fio2 > 0,
                                  spo2_min / fio2, NA_real_)] #calculate s/f under conditions
locf_limited(epoch_table, "pf_ratio", as.integer(floor(pf_locf_hours / epoch_hours)), add_since = FALSE) #use the locf_limited function from part six to carry values forward per rules
locf_limited(epoch_table, "sf_ratio", as.integer(floor(sf_locf_hours / epoch_hours)), add_since = FALSE)

#)4 SOFA (hourly, from the carried-forward values in each epoch)
# Respiratory support for the 3-4 point respiratory levels: on IMV (any epoch >= 0) or charted NIV/CPAP
epoch_table[, resp_support := as.integer(epoch >= 0 | device %in% c("imv", "nippv", "cpap"))] #pre-imv scores you max score

pf_for_sofa <- epoch_table$pf_ratio #start from the real p/f
if (sofa_sf_fallback) { #use estimate p/f from s/f when p/f not availaable
  # Rice et al. linear relationship: S/F = 64 + 0.84 * P/F  ->  P/F ~= (S/F - 64) / 0.84
  use_sf <- is.na(pf_for_sofa) & !is.na(epoch_table$sf_ratio)
  pf_for_sofa[use_sf] <- (epoch_table$sf_ratio[use_sf] - 64) / 0.84
}
epoch_table[, sofa_resp := fcase( #calculate respiratory SOFA - for all SOFA - missing = NA
  is.na(pf_for_sofa),                           NA_integer_,
  pf_for_sofa < 100 & resp_support == 1L,       4L,
  pf_for_sofa < 200 & resp_support == 1L,       3L,
  pf_for_sofa < 300,                            2L,
  pf_for_sofa < 400,                            1L,
  default =                                     0L)]

epoch_table[, sofa_coag := fcase(is.na(platelets), NA_integer_, #calculate coag SOFA
  platelets < 20, 4L, platelets < 50, 3L, platelets < 100, 2L, platelets < 150, 1L, default = 0L)]

epoch_table[, sofa_liver := fcase(is.na(bilirubin), NA_integer_, #calculate liver SOFA
  bilirubin >= 12, 4L, bilirubin >= 6, 3L, bilirubin >= 2, 2L, bilirubin >= 1.2, 1L, default = 0L)]

epoch_table[, sofa_renal := fcase(is.na(creatinine), NA_integer_,         #creatinine only (no urine output)
  creatinine >= 5, 4L, creatinine >= 3.5, 3L, creatinine >= 2, 2L, creatinine >= 1.2, 1L, default = 0L)]

epoch_table[, sofa_cns := fcase(is.na(gcs_total), NA_integer_, #calculate neuro SOFA
  gcs_total < 6, 4L, gcs_total <= 9, 3L, gcs_total <= 12, 2L, gcs_total <= 14, 1L, default = 0L)]

# Cardiovascular: doses are standardized (mcg/kg/min) - infusion columns are 0 when not running
  # check in order - starting with most severe and work down
epoch_table[, sofa_cardio := fcase(
  dopamine_rate > 15 | epinephrine_rate > 0.1 | norepinephrine_rate > 0.1,   4L,
  dopamine_rate > 5  | epinephrine_rate > 0   | norepinephrine_rate > 0,     3L,
  dopamine_rate > 0  | dobutamine_rate > 0,                                  2L,
  !is.na(map_min) & map_min < 70,                                            1L,
  !is.na(map_min),                                                           0L,
  default =                                                                  NA_integer_)]

sofa_parts <- c("sofa_resp", "sofa_coag", "sofa_liver", "sofa_cardio", "sofa_cns", "sofa_renal") #sofa categories
epoch_table[, sofa_n_missing := as.integer(rowSums(is.na(.SD))), .SDcols = sofa_parts] #count number of missing sofa 
epoch_table[, sofa_total := as.integer(rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE)), .SDcols = sofa_parts]   # missing component = 0

#)5 NAT score per epoch
class_cols <- function(cl) intersect(paste0("abx_", nat_class[nat_class == cl, med_category]), names(epoch_table)) #function to return class of antibiotic defined above
any_active <- function(cols) if (length(cols)) as.integer(rowSums(epoch_table[, ..cols]) > 0) else rep(0L, nrow(epoch_table)) #function to determine active antibiotics
  # for every epoch is their any of the following abx coverage?
has_mrsa   <- any_active(class_cols("anti_mrsa"))
has_pseudo <- any_active(class_cols("antipseudomonal"))
has_std    <- any_active(class_cols("standard"))
has_narrow <- any_active(class_cols("narrow"))
any_abx    <- pmax(has_mrsa, has_pseudo, has_std, has_narrow)
  # calculate NAT score
epoch_table[, nat_score := fifelse(any_abx == 0L, nat_pts[["no_abx"]],
                                   fifelse(has_std | has_mrsa | has_pseudo, nat_pts[["standard"]], nat_pts[["narrow"]]) +
                                   has_mrsa   * nat_pts[["anti_mrsa"]] +
                                   has_pseudo * nat_pts[["antipseudomonal"]])]

#)6 Number of vasopressors running
vaso_cols <- intersect(paste0(vaso_drugs, "_rate"), names(epoch_table)) #vasopressor columns defined above
epoch_table[, n_vasopressors := as.integer(rowSums(.SD > 0, na.rm = TRUE)), .SDcols = vaso_cols] #count # running

#6b. Pulmonary vasodilators running (inhaled = rescue for hypoxemia; IV = mostly chronic PH) ----
pv_inhaled_cols <- intersect(c("epoprostenol_inhaled_rate", "nitric_oxide_inhaled_rate"), names(epoch_table))
pv_iv_cols      <- intersect(c("epoprostenol_iv_rate", "treprostinil_iv_rate", "alprostadil_iv_rate"), names(epoch_table))
epoch_table[, pulm_vasodilator_inhaled := if (length(pv_inhaled_cols)) as.integer(rowSums(.SD > 0) > 0) else 0L, .SDcols = pv_inhaled_cols] #flag if on inhaled pulmonary vasodilator during epoch
epoch_table[, pulm_vasodilator_iv      := if (length(pv_iv_cols))      as.integer(rowSums(.SD > 0) > 0) else 0L, .SDcols = pv_iv_cols] #flag if on IV pulmonary vasodilator during epoch

#)7a. Create Simplified language category
epoch_table[, lang_cat_simplified := fcase(
  language_category == "english",                                                            "english",
  language_category == "spanish",                                                            "spanish",
  is.na(language_category) | language_category %in% c("", "unknown", "unknown or na",
                                                        "declined", "not reported"),         NA_character_,
  default =                                                                                  "other_non_english")]
print(epoch_table[epoch == 0, .N, by = .(language_category, lang_cat_simplified)][order(-N)][1:15])   # check the mapping

#)7b Driving pressure: plateau minus observed PEEP (falls back to set PEEP)
dp_set_peep_fallback <- TRUE #allows use of set peep for calculating if observed not present
epoch_table[, `:=`(driving_pressure = pplat - peep_measured, driving_pressure_src = "measured_peep")] #record source
epoch_table[is.na(driving_pressure), driving_pressure_src := NA_character_] #if no driving presure calculated then NA
if (dp_set_peep_fallback) { #use fall back
  epoch_table[is.na(driving_pressure) & !is.na(pplat) & !is.na(peep),
              `:=`(driving_pressure = pplat - peep, driving_pressure_src = "set_peep")] #record source
}
epoch_table[driving_pressure < 0 | driving_pressure > 50, `:=`(driving_pressure = NA_real_, driving_pressure_src = NA_character_)] #if outside of reasonable values so set them to NA and change the source to NA

#)7c Low tidal volume ventilation (<= 8 mL/kg predicted body weight)
low_vt_threshold <- 8
epoch_table[, low_tidal_volume := fifelse(is.na(vt_ml_per_kg_ibw), NA_integer_,
                                          as.integer(vt_ml_per_kg_ibw <= low_vt_threshold))] #flag - 1 if 8 cc/kg or less

#)8 Audits
dpost <- epoch_table[epoch >= 0] #only count epochs from 0 and up
derived_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(c("ibw_kg", "vt_ml_per_kg_ibw", "pf_ratio", "sf_ratio",
                                      "driving_pressure", "sofa_total", "nat_score"),
  function(cc) data.table(feature = cc,
                          pct_nonmissing = round(100 * mean(!is.na(dpost[[cc]])), 1),
                          t(round(quantile(dpost[[cc]], c(.01, .25, .5, .75, .99), na.rm = TRUE), 2)))))
print(derived_summary)

print(dpost[, .N, by = sofa_n_missing][order(sofa_n_missing)])       # how many SOFA components were missing
print(dpost[, .N, by = nat_score][order(nat_score)])                 # how many NAT scores missing
print(dpost[, .N, by = n_vasopressors][order(n_vasopressors)])       # number of vasopressors

# New features
print(dpost[, .N, by = driving_pressure_src][order(-N)]) # measured vs set PEEP used
print(dpost[, .(pct_low_tidal_volume = round(100 * mean(low_tidal_volume == 1L, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
          pct_pv_inhaled       = round(100 * mean(pulm_vasodilator_inhaled), 2),
          pct_pv_iv            = round(100 * mean(pulm_vasodilator_iv), 2))])
print(dpost[epoch == 0, .N, by = .(language_category, lang_cat_simplified)][order(-N)][1:15])   # language mapping
 #save audit
fwrite(derived_summary, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("derived_features_summary_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))


#) 9 Column inventory
print(names(epoch_table))

# One row per column: type, how often it's filled in during IMV hours, and a few example values
col_inventory <- rbindlist(lapply(names(epoch_table), function(cc) {
  x <- epoch_table[epoch >= 0][[cc]]
  data.table(column         = cc,
             type           = class(x)[1],
             pct_nonmissing = round(100 * mean(!is.na(x)), 1),
             n_unique       = uniqueN(x),
             examples       = paste(head(unique(na.omit(x)), 3), collapse = ", "))
}))
print(col_inventory, nrows = Inf)

fwrite(col_inventory, file.path(audit_dir, paste0("epoch_table_columns_", stamp, institution, ".csv")))

# ---- Save the epoch table cache (Parts 5-8 output) -------------------------------------------------
if (!use_epoch_cache) {
  arrow::write_parquet(epoch_table, epoch_cache)
  saveRDS(list(saved_at = Sys.time(), params = epoch_params,
               n_rows = nrow(epoch_table), n_runs = uniqueN(epoch_table$imv_run_id)), epoch_meta)
  message("Saved epoch_table cache: ", epoch_cache)
}
}
```

#PART NINE: Vent Liberation Steps
```{r}
if (use_epoch_cache) {
  baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs <- restore_tz(as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(baseline_cache)))
  stopifnot(nrow(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs) == readRDS(baseline_meta)$n_rows)
  epoch_table <- restore_tz(as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(epoch_cache)))
  stopifnot(nrow(epoch_table) == readRDS(epoch_meta)$n_rows)
  setorder(epoch_table, imv_run_id, epoch)
}
################################################################################
# LIBERATION PROCESS: THREE TIME-TO-EVENT STEPS BY LANGUAGE PREFERENCE
#   Step 1:  intubation              -> first documented SBT screen
#   Step 2:  first meeting readiness -> first SBT delivered
#   Step 3:  first passed SBT        -> extubation
# Primary analysis: cause-specific Cox, patient-clustered robust SEs, stratified by hospital x ICU type.
# Death, tracheostomy, and (steps 1-2) extubation before the step's event are competing events.
# Every model is wrapped so one failure does not stop the site run; failures are logged.
# Shareable results (aggregate only, small cells masked) are written to project_data_dir.
################################################################################

#)0 Define Parameters
fio2_max <- 0.50; peep_max <- 8; nee_max <- 0.10    # SBT readiness rule
ready_hours    <- 2                                 # consecutive hours the rule must hold
start_year     <- 2018                              # for site consistency start in 2018
death_grace_h  <- 24                                # death within this long after end of IMV = death (account for palliative extubation)
horizon_h      <- 48                                # restricted mean time horizon - how many hours within the next 48 was patient waiting?
ci_at_h        <- 24                                # cumulative incidence reported at this hour
end_col        <- "end_obs"                         # how we determine end of IMV
pandemic_start <- as.POSIXct("2020-03-01", tz = time_zone) # pandemic start time
pandemic_end   <- as.POSIXct("2022-01-01", tz = time_zone) # pandemic end time
hosp_col       <- "epoch_hospital_id"               # for building the hospital_icu type
icu_type_col   <- "epoch_location"                  # for building the hospital_icu type
min_unit_runs  <- 50                                # sparse hospital x ICU-type strata pooled into "other"
min_cell       <- 11                                # counts below this are masked in shared output
analysis_version <- "liberation_v1.0"

# Build columns here so the script runs on any epoch_table
col0 <- function(cc) if (cc %in% names(epoch_table)) epoch_table[[cc]] else 0 #function to check if columns exist
inf_cols <- intersect(c("cisatracurium_rate", "vecuronium_rate", "rocuronium_rate"), names(epoch_table)) #determine which paralytic columns are present
if (!length(inf_cols)) stop("No paralytic infusion rate columns in epoch_table") #if none then this will break it
epoch_table[, para_infusion_on := as.integer(rowSums(.SD > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0), .SDcols = inf_cols] #create paralytic infusion feature per epoch
epoch_table[, nee := col0("norepinephrine_rate") + col0("epinephrine_rate") + col0("phenylephrine_rate") / 10 +
                     col0("dopamine_rate") / 100 + col0("vasopressin_rate") * 2.5] #create nee calculation per epoch
stopifnot(all(c(hosp_col, icu_type_col) %in% names(epoch_table))) #stop if the hospital or ICU column are missing
epoch_table[, unit_id := fifelse(is.na(get(hosp_col)) | is.na(get(icu_type_col)), "missing",
                                 paste(get(hosp_col), tolower(get(icu_type_col)), sep = "|"))] #build the unit_id

# Oxygenation: P/F when a blood gas is available (carried <= 12 h), otherwise S/F converted to a
# P/F equivalent (Rice: S/F = 64 + 0.84 * P/F). One variable, plus its source.
epoch_table[, oxy_src := fcase(!is.na(pf_ratio), "abg", !is.na(sf_ratio), "spo2", default = "none")] #where did values come from?
epoch_table[, oxy_pf  := fcase(!is.na(pf_ratio), pf_ratio, !is.na(sf_ratio), (sf_ratio - 64) / 0.84,
                               default = NA_real_)] #use pf_ratio first then calculation of sf_ratio

#)1 One row per IMV run
flow <- list() #create an empty list
add_flow <- function(stage, d, step = "cohort") { #helper function we use later to track runs removed 
  flow[[length(flow) + 1L]] <<- data.table(step = step, stage = stage, runs = nrow(d),
                                           patients = uniqueN(d$patient_id))
}
  # basic information on the runs
runs <- baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs[, .(imv_run_id, hospitalization_id = as.character(hospitalization_id),
                                            t_int = begin_obs, t_end = get(end_col),
                                            end_src = end_imv_source,
                                            trach = as.integer(trached %in% c(1, TRUE)), death_dttm)]
  # Classify the reason why the run ended
if ("discharge_category" %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs) &&
    "discharge_dttm" %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)) {
  runs[baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs, on = "imv_run_id",
       `:=`(dc_cat = tolower(i.discharge_category), dc_dttm = i.discharge_dttm)]
} else runs[, `:=`(dc_cat = NA_character_, dc_dttm = as.POSIXct(NA))]

  # Death or hospice discharge shortly after a charted end of ventilation = palliative extubation -> death
runs[, died_soon := (!is.na(death_dttm) & death_dttm <= t_end + death_grace_h * 3600) |
                    (dc_cat %in% "hospice" & !is.na(dc_dttm) & dc_dttm <= t_end + death_grace_h * 3600)]

runs[, end_reason := fcase(
  end_src == "trach",                       "tracheostomy",
  end_src == "death/hospice",               "death",
  end_src == "discharge",                   "censored",      # still on IMV at discharge / transfer
  end_src == "resp" & died_soon,            "death",         # palliative extubation
  end_src == "resp",                        "extubation",
  # no source recorded: fall back to the earlier rules
  died_soon,                                "death",
  default =                                 "extubation")]
print(runs[, .N, by = .(end_src, end_reason)][order(-N)])   # check the mapping, discharge -> censored should be low

  # If patient_id is missing then add it in here
if ("patient_id" %in% names(baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs)) {
  runs[baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs, on = "imv_run_id", patient_id := as.character(i.patient_id)]
} else {
  pid <- unique(hospitalization[, .(hospitalization_id = as.character(hospitalization_id),
                                    patient_id = as.character(patient_id))])
  runs[pid, on = "hospitalization_id", patient_id := i.patient_id]
}
stopifnot(!anyNA(runs$patient_id)) #stop if no patient_id present

# Race / ethnicity: NOT in the primary model; used for a sensitivity model and Table 1 only
runs[baseline_data_eligible_imv_runs, on = "imv_run_id",
     `:=`(race_raw = tolower(i.race_category), eth_raw = tolower(i.ethnicity_category))] #pull in race and ethnicity values
runs[, race4 := fcase(race_raw == "white",                                                         "white",
                      race_raw %in% c("black or african american", "black_or_african_american"),   "black",
                      race_raw == "asian",                                                         "asian",
                      is.na(race_raw) | race_raw == "unknown",                                     "unknown",
                      default =                                                                    "other")]
runs[, eth3 := fcase(eth_raw == "hispanic",                           "hispanic",
                     eth_raw %in% c("non-hispanic", "non_hispanic"),  "non_hispanic",
                     default =                                        "unknown")]
print(runs[, .N, by = .(race_raw, race4)][order(-N)]) #verify mapping worked
print(runs[, .N, by = .(eth_raw, eth3)][order(-N)]) #verify mapping worked

r0 <- epoch_table[epoch == 0L, .(imv_run_id, lang_cat_simplified)] #pull in lang_cat_simplified from epoch table
runs[r0, on = "imv_run_id", lgrp := i.lang_cat_simplified] #merge language onto runs
runs[, lang2 := fcase(lgrp == "english", "english", lgrp %in% c("spanish", "other_non_english"), "non_english",
                      default = NA_character_)] #create 2 level language feature
runs[, period3 := fcase(t_int < pandemic_start, "1_pre_pandemic", t_int < pandemic_end, "2_pandemic",
                        default = "3_post_pandemic")] #create the 3 pandemic periods feature
runs[, year := as.integer(format(t_int, "%Y"))] #create the year feature

add_flow("eligible IMV runs", runs) #record the starting count
runs <- runs[!is.na(t_end) & t_end > t_int];  add_flow("valid start and end times", runs) #remove implausible runs - doesn't remove any at Penn but keep in for safety
runs <- runs[year >= start_year];             add_flow(paste0("intubated ", start_year, " or later"), runs) #remove runs before 2017
n_lang_missing <- runs[is.na(lang2), .N] #number of runs dropped for missing language
runs <- runs[!is.na(lang2)];                  add_flow("known language preference", runs) #remove runs with missing language

#2) Determine Event times
pa <- patient_assessments[assessment_category %in% c("sbt_screen_pass_fail", "sbt_delivery_pass_fail") &
                          !is.na(recorded_dttm) & !is.na(binary_value),
                          .(hospitalization_id = as.character(hospitalization_id), t = recorded_dttm,
                            cat = assessment_category, pass = binary_value == 1L)] #pull in sbt data from patient_assessments
pa <- pa[runs[, .(imv_run_id, hospitalization_id, t_int, t_end)],
         on = .(hospitalization_id, t >= t_int, t <= t_end), nomatch = 0L,
         .(imv_run_id, t = x.t, cat, pass)] #non-equi join assigns each SBT record to the IMV run it happened during

first_screen <- pa[cat == "sbt_screen_pass_fail", .(t_screen = min(t)), by = imv_run_id] #time of first screen per run (step 1)
first_pass   <- pa[cat == "sbt_delivery_pass_fail" & pass == TRUE, .(t_pass = min(t)), by = imv_run_id] #time of first pass per run (step 3)
  # Determine physiologic readiness
et <- epoch_table[epoch >= 0L & imv_run_id %in% runs$imv_run_id,
                  .(imv_run_id, epoch, epoch_start_dttm, fio2, peep, nee, para_infusion_on)] #filter epoch table for needed physio columns
setorder(et, imv_run_id, epoch) #set it in order of epoch
et[, ok := fio2 <= fio2_max & peep <= peep_max & fcoalesce(as.numeric(nee), 0) <= nee_max &
           fcoalesce(as.integer(para_infusion_on), 0L) == 0L] #ok = readiness rule
et[is.na(ok), ok := FALSE] #if peep or FiO2 are missing then ok automatically = NA
et[, streak := fifelse(ok, seq_len(.N), 0L), by = .(imv_run_id, rleid(ok))] #calculate streak of okay values in a row
first_ready <- et[et[streak == ready_hours, .I[1], by = imv_run_id]$V1,
                  .(imv_run_id, t_ready = epoch_start_dttm - (ready_hours - 1L) * 3600)] #determine first ready timestamp based on start of 2 hour readiness period (step 2)
rm(et) #drop et from the memory

sbt_after <- pa[cat == "sbt_delivery_pass_fail"][first_ready, on = .(imv_run_id, t >= t_ready), nomatch = 0L,
                                                 .(imv_run_id, t = x.t)][, .(t_sbt = min(t)), by = imv_run_id] #determine first SBT after physiologic readiness (step 2)

for (x in list(first_screen, first_pass, first_ready, sbt_after))
  runs[x, on = "imv_run_id", (setdiff(names(x), "imv_run_id")) := mget(paste0("i.", setdiff(names(x), "imv_run_id")))] #add all of the times for steps 1-3 onto the individual runs
runs[end_reason == "extubation", t_extub := t_end] #if t_extub=t_end give the end_reason as extubation

################################################################################
# VENTILATOR-MODE SBT DETECTION + FLOWSHEET SBT FIX  (module for liberation_steps_v2.R)
#
# WHERE: paste this whole block into liberation_steps_v2.R right AFTER Section 2
#        (after `runs[end_reason == "extubation", t_extub := t_end]`) and BEFORE Section 3.
# NEEDS: runs, first_ready, patient_assessments, data_dir, file_type, read_data,
#        project_data_dir, institution, min_cell, time_zone (all already defined upstream).
#
# What it does
#   A. Flowsheet SBT delivery, widened: sbt_delivery_pass_fail (any value) OR sbt_delivery_performed = yes.
#      (Fixes UMN, where SBTs are charted mainly as "performed".)
#   B. Ventilator-mode SBT ("FLIP", after ABT-RISE 04_sbt_both.py), in continuous time:
#        an SBT row = IMV with pressure support/CPAP mode, PS <= 8 and PEEP <= 8, OR a T-piece trial.
#        - delivered SBT (step 2): first SBT-level row after readiness whose settings persist >= flip_min
#        - completed SBT (step 3 proxy): first SBT episode lasting >= pass_min (time stamp = start + pass_min)
#   C. Chooses which SBT times feed steps 2 and 3 (sbt_source), keeping all versions on `runs`.
#   D. Writes aggregate, small-cell-masked audit files: concordance, documentation before extubation,
#      ventilator mode inventory and SBT episode durations.
################################################################################

# ---- V0. Parameters ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
sbt_source         <- "flowsheet"  # SBT times used for steps 2 and 3: "flowsheet", "ventilator", or "either" (earliest)
flip_ps_max        <- 8            # pressure support (cmH2O) at or below this counts as SBT-level support
flip_peep_max      <- 8            # PEEP at or below this
flip_min           <- 2            # minutes SBT settings must persist to count as delivered (ABT-RISE primary 2; secondary 5)
pass_min           <- 30           # minutes of uninterrupted SBT settings treated as a completed (passed) trial
require_transition <- FALSE        # TRUE: the SBT episode must START after readiness (a true flip from a control mode).
                                   # FALSE (ABT-RISE behaviour): any SBT-level row after readiness counts, so a patient
                                   # already resting on PS 5/5 when ready counts as delivered at the first row after it.
blowby_is_tpiece   <- TRUE         # mode_category "blow by" during an IMV run counted as a T-piece trial
settings_carry_h   <- 4            # mode, PS and PEEP carried forward (within run, and within the same mode) at most this long
doc_window_h       <- 24           # look-back before extubation for the documentation check
stopifnot(sbt_source %in% c("flowsheet", "ventilator", "either"))

# ---- V1. Flowsheet SBT delivery (widened) -------------------------------------------------------------
pd <- patient_assessments[assessment_category %in% c("sbt_delivery_pass_fail", "sbt_delivery_performed") &
                          !is.na(recorded_dttm) & !is.na(binary_value),
                          .(hospitalization_id = as.character(hospitalization_id), t = recorded_dttm,
                            cat = assessment_category, val = as.integer(binary_value))]
pd <- pd[cat == "sbt_delivery_pass_fail" | val == 1L]          # a pass/fail result implies a trial happened
pd <- pd[runs[, .(imv_run_id, hospitalization_id, t_int, t_end)],
         on = .(hospitalization_id, t >= t_int, t <= t_end), nomatch = 0L,
         .(imv_run_id, t = x.t, cat, pass = cat == "sbt_delivery_pass_fail" & val == 1L)]
sbt_doc <- pd[first_ready, on = .(imv_run_id, t >= t_ready), nomatch = 0L,
              .(imv_run_id, t = x.t)][, .(t_sbt_doc = min(t)), by = imv_run_id]

# ---- V2. Respiratory support rows inside each IMV run ----------------------------------------------------
# V2-V3 run inside tryCatch: if anything in the ventilator part fails, the flowsheet results still come out
# (ventilator columns are empty, the audit files say so, and steps 2-3 fall back to the flowsheet).
t0_empty  <- as.POSIXct(character(0), tz = time_zone)
id_empty  <- runs$imv_run_id[0]
sbt_vent  <- data.table(imv_run_id = id_empty, t_sbt_vent = t0_empty)
pass_vent <- data.table(imv_run_id = id_empty, t_pass_vent = t0_empty)
eps       <- data.table(imv_run_id = id_empty, t_start = t0_empty, dur_min = numeric(0))
rs        <- data.table(imv_run_id = id_empty, modec = character(0), ps = numeric(0), pe = numeric(0), mcode = integer(0))
chart_int <- data.table(level = character(0), value = numeric(0))
name_terms <- data.table(level = character(0), rows = integer(0), runs = integer(0))
vent_status <- "ok"
vent_ok <- tryCatch({
rs_cols <-c("hospitalization_id", "recorded_dttm", "device_category", "mode_category", "mode_name",
             "pressure_support_set", "peep_set")
if (exists("respiratory_support") && all(rs_cols[1:4] %in% names(respiratory_support))) {
  rs <- as.data.table(respiratory_support)[, intersect(rs_cols, names(respiratory_support)), with = FALSE]
} else {
  rs <- as.data.table(read_data(paste0(data_dir, "clif_respiratory_support", file_type), select = rs_cols))
}
for (cc in setdiff(rs_cols, names(rs))) set(rs, j = cc, value = NA)
rs[, hospitalization_id := as.character(hospitalization_id)]
rs <- rs[hospitalization_id %in% runs$hospitalization_id & !is.na(recorded_dttm),
         .(hospitalization_id, t = recorded_dttm,
           device = tolower(trimws(as.character(device_category))),
           modec  = tolower(trimws(as.character(mode_category))),
           moden  = tolower(trimws(as.character(mode_name))),
           ps     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pressure_support_set)),
           pe     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(peep_set)))]
rs <- rs[runs[, .(imv_run_id, hospitalization_id, t_int, t_end)],
         on = .(hospitalization_id, t >= t_int, t <= t_end), nomatch = 0L,
         .(imv_run_id, t = x.t, device, modec, moden, ps, pe)]
setorder(rs, imv_run_id, t)

# One row per run x time stamp (settings are often charted on separate rows at the same time)
first_nn <- function(x) { y <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (length(y)) y[1L] else x[1L] }
rs[, dup := .N > 1L, by = .(imv_run_id, t)]
if (any(rs$dup)) {
  one <- rs[dup == TRUE, lapply(.SD, first_nn), by = .(imv_run_id, t), .SDcols = c("device", "modec", "moden", "ps", "pe")]
  rs  <- rbind(rs[dup == FALSE], one, fill = TRUE)
  setorder(rs, imv_run_id, t)
}
rs[, dup := NULL]

# Charting audit: minutes between consecutive respiratory_support time stamps within a run
gaps <- rs[, as.numeric(diff(t), units = "mins"), by = imv_run_id]$V1
if (length(gaps)) {
  q <- quantile(gaps, c(.25, .5, .75, .9), names = FALSE)
  chart_int <- data.table(level = c("p25", "median", "p75", "p90", "pct_gaps_over_60min", "pct_gaps_over_240min"),
                          value = round(c(q, 100 * mean(gaps > 60), 100 * mean(gaps > 240)), 1))
}
rm(gaps)
# Where T-piece / spontaneous trials are recorded: rows whose mode_name contains standard terms (counts only)
term_pat <- c(t_piece = "t[-_ ]?piece", spont = "spont", cpap = "cpap", tube_compensation = "\\batc\\b|tube comp",
              blow_by = "blow[-_ ]?by", pressure_support = "pressure support|\\bps\\b", missing_mode_name = NA)
name_terms <- rbindlist(lapply(names(term_pat), function(k) {
  hit <- if (is.na(term_pat[[k]])) is.na(rs$moden) else grepl(term_pat[[k]], rs$moden)
  data.table(level = k, rows = sum(hit), runs = uniqueN(rs$imv_run_id[hit]))
}))

# Mode class: 1 control/other vent mode, 2 pressure support/CPAP, 3 T-piece, 4 off the ventilator, NA unknown
rs[, mcode := fcase(grepl("t[-_ ]?piece", moden) | (blowby_is_tpiece & grepl("blow[-_ ]?by", modec)), 3L,
                    grepl("pressure support|cpap", modec),                                    2L,
                    !is.na(modec) | !is.na(moden),                                            1L,
                    !is.na(device) & device != "imv",                                         4L,
                    default = NA_integer_)]

# Carry a numeric column forward within groups, for at most `hours`
carry <- function(d, col, by, hours) {
  d[, tt_ := as.numeric(t)]
  d[, last_ := fifelse(is.na(get(col)), NA_real_, tt_)]
  d[, c(col, "last_") := lapply(.SD, nafill, type = "locf"), by = by, .SDcols = c(col, "last_")]
  d[!is.na(last_) & tt_ - last_ > hours * 3600, (col) := NA]
  d[, c("tt_", "last_") := NULL]
  invisible(d)
}
carry(rs, "mcode", "imv_run_id", settings_carry_h)
rs[, seg := rleid(mcode), by = imv_run_id]                       # PS/PEEP only carried within the same mode
carry(rs, "ps", c("imv_run_id", "seg"), settings_carry_h)
carry(rs, "pe", c("imv_run_id", "seg"), settings_carry_h)

rs[, sbt_row := fcoalesce(mcode == 3L | (mcode == 2L & ps <= flip_ps_max & pe <= flip_peep_max), FALSE)]

# ---- V3. SBT episodes (uninterrupted runs of SBT-level rows) ---------------------------------------------
rs[, ep := rleid(sbt_row), by = imv_run_id]
eps <- rs[, .(sbt = sbt_row[1L], t_start = t[1L]), by = .(imv_run_id, ep)]
eps[, t_stop := shift(t_start, -1L), by = imv_run_id]            # ends at the next non-SBT row ...
eps[runs, on = "imv_run_id", t_stop := fcoalesce(t_stop, i.t_end)]   # ... or at the end of the run
eps <- eps[sbt == TRUE][, sbt := NULL]
eps[, dur_min := as.numeric(difftime(t_stop, t_start, units = "mins"))]

# Step 2 (ventilator): first SBT-level row after readiness with >= flip_min of SBT settings remaining
rr <- rs[sbt_row == TRUE, .(imv_run_id, t, ep)]
rr[eps, on = .(imv_run_id, ep), `:=`(t_ep = i.t_start, t_stop = i.t_stop)]
rr <- rr[as.numeric(difftime(t_stop, t, units = "mins")) >= flip_min]
rr[, t_key := if (require_transition) t_ep else t]
sbt_vent <- rr[first_ready, on = .(imv_run_id, t_key >= t_ready), nomatch = 0L,
               .(imv_run_id, t = x.t)][, .(t_sbt_vent = min(t)), by = imv_run_id]

# Step 3 (ventilator): first episode lasting >= pass_min; the pass is time-stamped at start + pass_min
pass_vent <- eps[dur_min >= pass_min, .(t_pass_vent = min(t_start) + pass_min * 60), by = imv_run_id]
TRUE
}, error = function(e) {
  vent_status <<- paste("error:", conditionMessage(e))
  message("Ventilator SBT detection failed; continuing with flowsheet only. ", vent_status)
  FALSE
})

  pass_vent <- data.table(imv_run_id = id_empty, t_pass_vent = t0_empty)

}

# ---- V5. Shareable audit files (aggregate counts only; cells 1-10 masked) --------------------------------
mask_pos <- function(x) fifelse(x > 0 & x < min_cell, NA_integer_, as.integer(x))
safe_pct <- function(k, n) {                       # no percentage if it could reveal a masked count
  bad <- (k > 0 & k < min_cell) | ((n - k) > 0 & (n - k) < min_cell) | n < min_cell
  fifelse(bad, NA_real_, round(100 * k / n, 1))
}
two_by_two <- function(d, label) {          # d has columns lang2, a (flowsheet), b (ventilator), dmin
  cells <- function(x) x[, .(both = sum(a & b), doc_only = sum(a & !b), vent_only = sum(!a & b), neither = sum(!a & !b),
                             med_min_vent_minus_doc = if (sum(a & b) >= min_cell) median(dmin[a & b]) else NA_real_)]
  out <- rbind(cbind(lang2 = "all", cells(d)), d[, cells(.SD), by = lang2])
  out[, `:=`(n = both + doc_only + vent_only + neither, comparison = label)]
  # agreement statistics only when no cell needs masking (they could otherwise reveal a masked cell)
  out[, ok := (both == 0 | both >= min_cell) & (doc_only == 0 | doc_only >= min_cell) &
              (vent_only == 0 | vent_only >= min_cell) & (neither == 0 | neither >= min_cell)]
  out[ok == TRUE, `:=`(sens_vs_doc = round(both / (both + doc_only), 3), spec_vs_doc = round(neither / (neither + vent_only), 3),
                       ppv_vs_doc = round(both / (both + vent_only), 3),
                       kappa = { po <- (both + neither) / n
                                 pe <- ((both + doc_only) * (both + vent_only) + (neither + vent_only) * (neither + doc_only)) / n^2
                                 round((po - pe) / (1 - pe), 3) })]
  for (cc in c("both", "doc_only", "vent_only", "neither", "n")) set(out, j = cc, value = mask_pos(out[[cc]]))
  out[, ok := NULL][]
}

#)3 Analysis frame for one step
cov_src <- intersect(c("age_at_admission", "sex_category", "bmi", "elixhauser_score", "intubation_site",
                       "sofa_total", "oxy_pf", "oxy_src", "fio2", "peep", "nee", "rass", "unit_id"), names(epoch_table)) #the covariates we want to keep from the epoch_table
cov_tab <- epoch_table[epoch >= 0L & imv_run_id %in% runs$imv_run_id,
                       c("imv_run_id", "epoch", "epoch_start_dttm", cov_src), with = FALSE] #trimmed copy of epoch_table
setkey(cov_tab, imv_run_id, epoch_start_dttm) #put in order of run and hour start time - needed for roll join below
impute_vars <- c("bmi", "elixhauser_score", "sofa_total", "oxy_pf", "nee", "rass", "fio2", "peep") #if missing, these are imputed

make_step <- function(origin, event, label) { #create function for survival analysis - one row per run, same function works for all 3 steps
  d <- runs[!is.na(get(origin)) & get(origin) < t_end] #did patient get to the point that they were eligible for the step
  add_flow("reached the step's starting point", d, label) #label if the patient made it
  d[, `:=`(t0 = get(origin), t_ev = get(event))] #t0 is the pass time, t_ev is the event time
  d[!is.na(t_ev) & t_ev < t0, t_ev := NA] #ignore events prior to the clock starting
  d[, status := fcase(!is.na(t_ev) & t_ev <= t_end, "event",
                      end_reason == "censored",      "censored",
                      default =                      "competing")] #how did follow up to the event end? event? censored? competing?
  d[, time := pmax(as.numeric(difftime(fifelse(status == "event", t_ev, t_end), t0, units = "hours")), 1 / 60)] #how long was patient followed for?
  d[, status := factor(status, levels = c("censored", "event", "competing"))] #put in factor for model
  d[, event01 := as.integer(status == "event")] #put in integer for model
  d <- cov_tab[d, on = .(imv_run_id, epoch_start_dttm = t0), roll = TRUE]          #pull the covariates from t0 for each event
  setnames(d, "epoch_start_dttm", "t0") #set the names
  d <- d[tolower(sex_category) %in% c("male", "female")] #drop unknown sex
  add_flow("analyzed (known sex)", d, label) #add the count of people dropped for unknown sex
  d[, hours_on_imv := as.numeric(difftime(t0, t_int, units = "hours"))] #calculate hours on IMV at t0
  for (v in intersect(impute_vars, names(d))) {
    set(d, j = paste0(v, "_na"), value = as.integer(is.na(d[[v]])))
    set(d, which(is.na(d[[v]])), v, median(d[[v]], na.rm = TRUE))
  } #set missing components to median of patients within that particular step
  d[is.na(oxy_src), oxy_src := "none"] #if missing call it none
  d[is.na(unit_id), unit_id := "missing"] #if missing call it missing
  d[unit_id %in% d[, .N, by = unit_id][N < min_unit_runs, unit_id], unit_id := "other"] #if unit_id has less than 50 call it other
  d[is.na(intubation_site), intubation_site := "unknown"] #if missing call it unknown
  d[, `:=`(lang2 = relevel(factor(lang2), "english"), lgrp = relevel(factor(lgrp), "english"), #clean up categories and prepare them for analysis
           period3 = factor(period3), year_f = factor(year), unit_id = factor(unit_id),
           oxy_src = factor(oxy_src), race4 = relevel(factor(race4), "white"),
           eth3 = relevel(factor(eth3), "non_hispanic"), step = label)]
  d[] #return the table
}
  # call the function once per step

  step2 = make_step("t_ready", "t_sbt",    "2. Readiness -> first SBT"),
  step3a = make_step("t_sbt",  "t_extub",  "3A. First SBT -> extubation"),
```
