```{r}
#)4 Model specifications
# nsx(): identical to splines::ns(x, df) whenever ns() works. When many tied values push the default
# quantile knots onto the boundary (e.g. most runs reach readiness at the same hour), it places the knots
# at quantiles of the values strictly inside the range instead, and falls back to a linear term if needed.
nsx <- function(x, df = 3) {
  p   <- seq_len(df - 1) / df
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  kn  <- quantile(x, p, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
  if (all(kn > rng[1] & kn < rng[2]) && !anyDuplicated(kn)) return(splines::ns(x, df = df))
  inner <- x[!is.na(x) & x > rng[1] & x < rng[2]]
  kn <- unique(quantile(inner, p, names = FALSE))
  if (!length(inner) || !length(kn)) return(matrix(x, ncol = 1, dimnames = list(NULL, "linear")))
  splines::ns(x, knots = kn, Boundary.knots = rng)
}
 # Primary covariates
adj_primary <- c("year_f", "nsx(age_at_admission, 3)", "sex_category",
                 "elixhauser_score", "elixhauser_score_na", "intubation_site",
                 "nsx(sofa_total, 3)", "sofa_total_na",
                 "nsx(oxy_pf, 3)", "oxy_src",
                 "fio2", "fio2_na", "peep", "peep_na", "nee", "nee_na", "rass", "rass_na",
                 "nsx(hours_on_imv, 3)") #primary covariates included, using smooth curve for age, SOFA, oxygenation, hours on IMV

var_of <- function(t) all.vars(as.formula(paste("~", t))) #function that returns the variables names
usable <- function(d, terms) Filter(function(t) all(var_of(t) %in% names(d)) && uniqueN(d[[var_of(t)[1]]]) > 1, terms) #keep only terms that can be estimated in the step's data
mask   <- function(x) fifelse(x < min_cell, NA_integer_, as.integer(x)) #mask function again
mask_pos <- function(x) fifelse(x > 0 & x < min_cell, NA_integer_, as.integer(x))   # keeps true zeros

# Fit one model; return the exposure coefficient(s) on the log scale with robust SE, or a logged failure
  # clustering at patient_id
fit_terms <- function(d, model, exposure, terms, fine_gray = FALSE) { #define inputs for the model
  warn <- character(0) #collect warnings
  out <- tryCatch(withCallingHandlers({
    if (!fine_gray) { #fit regular COX model if fine_gray = FALSE
      f <- coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(time, event01) ~", paste(c(exposure, terms), collapse = " + "))), 
                 data = d, cluster = patient_id) #basic coxph equation - exposure, terms, etc filled in at time of running the formula, the + is used in between the covariates
    } else { #For Fine-Gray Model=TRUE
      fv <- unique(c("patient_id", "time", "status", var_of(exposure), unlist(lapply(terms, var_of)))) #columns needed for Fine-Gray
      fg <- finegray(Surv(time, status) ~ ., data = as.data.frame(d[, ..fv]), etype = "event") #structure data for Fine-Gray
      f  <- coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~", paste(c(exposure, terms), collapse = " + "))),
                  data = fg, weights = fgwt, cluster = patient_id) #fit the Cox model on the re-structured data
    }
    b <- coef(f); v <- diag(vcov(f)); k <- grep(paste0("^(", paste(var_of(exposure), collapse = "|"), ")"), names(b)) #pull out the language specific estimates
    data.table(model = model, term = names(b)[k], log_hr = unname(b[k]), se_log_hr = unname(sqrt(v[k])),
               n_obs = f$n, n_events = f$nevent, status = "ok") #one row per exposure coefficient, log_hr = the coefficient, robust standard errors
  }, warning = function(w) { warn <<- c(warn, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") }), #silence warning
  error = function(e) data.table(model = model, term = NA_character_, log_hr = NA_real_, se_log_hr = NA_real_,
                                 n_obs = nrow(d), n_events = sum(d$event01), status = paste("error:", conditionMessage(e)))) #if fails fit it will return a row with NA
  out[, warnings := if (length(warn)) paste(unique(warn), collapse = " | ") else NA_character_]
  out[, covariates := paste(terms, collapse = " + ")]
  out[]
}

# Restricted mean time waiting (and cumulative incidence) by language, with the non-English minus English
# difference and a patient-level bootstrap SE, so the differences can be meta-analyzed across sites.
run_abs_boot <- TRUE     # bootstrap SEs for the absolute differences (needed for federation)

abs_measures <- function(d, horizon = horizon_h, at = ci_at_h, B = 100, seed = 20261027) { #d is one step's data, B = 100 bootstraps, set seed for bootstraps
  est <- function(dd) { #function inside of a function - run 201 times, once on real data then 200 resamples
    aj <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ lang2, data = dd) #Aalen-Johansen estimator, run separately by language group, needed for competing events
    tb <- summary(aj, rmean = horizon)$table    #calculate restricted mean time spent in each state up to 48 hours
    s0 <- tb[grepl("\\(s0\\)", rownames(tb)), "rmean"] #keep s0 - waiting for event to happen
    names(s0) <- sub("lang2=([a-z_]+).*", "\\1", names(s0)) #shorten names to english, non-english
    sm <- summary(aj, times = at, extend = TRUE) #state probabilities at exactly 24 hours 
    ci <- sm$pstate[, which(aj$states == "event")]; names(ci) <- sub("lang2=", "", sm$strata) #calculate CIs - matrix w one row per group one column per state, the which function finds which column is the event state, CI calculates the probability of having the event by 24 hours
    c(rmean_en = unname(s0["english"]), rmean_ne = unname(s0["non_english"]),
      ci_en = unname(ci["english"]), ci_ne = unname(ci["non_english"])) #return the numbers as a vector 
  }
  point <- est(d) #run it once on the actual data
  rows  <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), d$patient_id)                     # resample patients, keeping all their runs, bootstrap
  set.seed(seed) #set the seed
  bs <- t(replicate(B, tryCatch(est(d[unlist(rows[sample.int(length(rows), replace = TRUE)], use.names = FALSE)]),
                                error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, 4)))) #run the boot straps
  data.table( #assemble all results into a table
    rmean_waiting_english = point[["rmean_en"]], rmean_waiting_non_english = point[["rmean_ne"]], #mean number of hours waiting per group
    rmean_diff_h  = point[["rmean_ne"]] - point[["rmean_en"]], #difference in hours
    rmean_diff_se = sd(bs[, "rmean_ne"] - bs[, "rmean_en"], na.rm = TRUE), #standard errors
    cum_inc_english = point[["ci_en"]], cum_inc_non_english = point[["ci_ne"]], #cumulative incidence
    cum_inc_diff  = point[["ci_ne"]] - point[["ci_en"]], #cumulative incidence difference
    cum_inc_diff_se = sd(bs[, "ci_ne"] - bs[, "ci_en"], na.rm = TRUE), #cumulative incidence 
    horizon_h = horizon, cum_inc_at_h = at, n_boot = sum(complete.cases(bs))) #record which horizon_h we used
}

# Language-by-period indicators (one coefficient per period)
add_period_terms <- function(d) {
  for (p in levels(d$period3)) set(d, j = paste0("ne_", sub("^[0-9]_", "", p)),
                                   value = as.integer(d$lang2 == "non_english" & d$period3 == p))
  grep("^ne_", names(d), value = TRUE)
}

analyse_step <- function(d) {
  adj  <- usable(d, adj_primary)
  unit <- usable(d, unit_term)
  prim <- c(adj, unit)
  per  <- add_period_terms(d)
  per  <- per[sapply(per, function(p) sum(d[[p]]) > 0)]
  race_terms <- usable(d, c("race4", "eth3"))
  bmi_terms  <- usable(d, c("nsx(bmi, 3)", "bmi_na"))

  hr <- rbind(
    fit_terms(d, "unadjusted",                        "lang2", character(0)),
    fit_terms(d, "primary",                           "lang2", prim),
    fit_terms(d, "no hospital x ICU strata",          "lang2", adj),
    fit_terms(d, "period instead of year",            "lang2", sub("^year_f$", "period3", prim)),
    fit_terms(d, "without RASS",                      "lang2", setdiff(prim, c("rass", "rass_na"))),
    fit_terms(d, "+ BMI",                             "lang2", c(prim, bmi_terms)),
    fit_terms(d, "+ race and ethnicity",              "lang2", c(prim, race_terms)),
    fit_terms(d, "Spanish / other non-English",       "lgrp",  prim),
    fit_terms(d, "language x period", paste(per, collapse = " + "), prim),
    fit_terms(d, "Fine-Gray (primary covariates)",    "lang2", prim, fine_gray = TRUE),
    fill = TRUE)

  # PH test for language in the primary model
  hr[model == "primary", ph_p_language := tryCatch(
    cox.zph(coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(time, event01) ~", paste(c("lang2", adj, unit), collapse = " + "))),
                  data = d, cluster = patient_id))$table["lang2", "p"], error = function(e) NA_real_)]

  # Absolute measures by language: cumulative incidence at ci_at_h (with SE) and restricted mean time waiting
  aj <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ lang2, data = d)
  s  <- summary(aj, times = ci_at_h, extend = TRUE)
  ev <- which(aj$states == "event")
  absm <- data.table(lang2 = sub("lang2=", "", s$strata), cum_inc = s$pstate[, ev], cum_inc_se = s$std.err[, ev])
  rmt  <- tryCatch({
    tb <- as.data.table(summary(aj, rmean = horizon_h)$table, keep.rownames = "row")[grepl("\\(s0\\)", row)]
    data.table(lang2 = sub("lang2=([a-z_]+).*", "\\1", tb$row), rmean_waiting_h = tb$rmean,
               rmean_waiting_se = if ("se(rmean)" %in% names(tb)) tb[["se(rmean)"]] else NA_real_)
  }, error = function(e) data.table(lang2 = levels(d$lang2), rmean_waiting_h = NA_real_, rmean_waiting_se = NA_real_))
  absm <- merge(absm, rmt, by = "lang2", all = TRUE)

  cnt <- d[, .(n = .N, events = sum(event01), competing = sum(status == "competing"),
               censored = sum(status == "censored"), median_h_if_event = median(time[event01 == 1L])), by = lang2]
  desc <- merge(cnt, absm, by = "lang2", all = TRUE)
  desc[, `:=`(n_units = uniqueN(d$unit_id), pct_oxy_from_abg = round(100 * mean(d$oxy_src == "abg"), 1))]

  absd <- if (run_abs_boot) tryCatch(abs_measures(d), error = function(e) data.table(note = paste("error:", conditionMessage(e))))
          else data.table(note = "bootstrap not run (run_abs_boot = FALSE)")
  absd[, `:=`(n_english = sum(d$lang2 == "english"), n_non_english = sum(d$lang2 == "non_english"),
              events_non_english = sum(d$event01[d$lang2 == "non_english"]))]
  list(hr = cbind(step = d$step[1], hr), desc = cbind(step = d$step[1], desc), abs = cbind(step = d$step[1], absd))
}

res <- lapply(steps, analyse_step)
step_hr   <- rbindlist(lapply(res, `[[`, "hr"), fill = TRUE)
step_desc <- rbindlist(lapply(res, `[[`, "desc"), fill = TRUE)
step_abs  <- rbindlist(lapply(res, `[[`, "abs"),  fill = TRUE)

# ---- 4b. Secondary outcomes: other exits from IMV after each step's starting point ---------------------------
# Follow-up runs to the end of IMV (not to the step's event). Gives
#   - cause-specific HRs for tracheostomy and death (primary covariates), appended to the HR file
#   - probability of each state (still intubated / extubated / tracheostomy / death) at 7 and 14 days, by language
state_times_h <- c(168, 336)
exit_outcomes <- function(d) {
  d <- copy(d)
  d[, time := pmax(as.numeric(difftime(t_end, t0, units = "hours")), 1 / 60)]
  prim <- c(usable(d, adj_primary), usable(d, unit_term))
  hr <- rbindlist(lapply(c("tracheostomy", "death"), function(o) {
    d[, event01 := as.integer(end_reason == o)]
    fit_terms(d, paste0(o, " (cause-specific, to end of IMV)"), "lang2", prim)
  }), fill = TRUE)
  d[, st := factor(fifelse(end_reason %in% c("extubation", "tracheostomy", "death"), end_reason, "censored"),
                   levels = c("censored", "extubation", "tracheostomy", "death"))]
  states <- tryCatch({
    aj <- survfit(Surv(time, st) ~ lang2, data = d)
    s  <- summary(aj, times = state_times_h, extend = TRUE)
    nm <- sub("^\\(s0\\)$", "still_intubated", aj$states)
    out <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(nm), function(k)
      data.table(lang2 = sub("lang2=", "", s$strata), day = s$time / 24, state = nm[k],
                 prob = s$pstate[, k], se = s$std.err[, k])))
    cnt <- d[, .(n_lang = .N), by = lang2][d[, .(n_ended_in_state = .N), by = .(lang2, state = as.character(st))],
                                          on = "lang2"]
    out <- cnt[out, on = .(lang2, state)]
    out[state == "still_intubated", n_ended_in_state := NA_integer_]
    out[, n_lang := d[, .N, by = lang2][out, on = "lang2", N]]
    # non-English minus English difference (independent groups; patient clustering ignored, so SE is approximate)
    w <- dcast(out, day + state ~ lang2, value.var = c("prob", "se"))
    dif <- w[, .(lang2 = "difference_non_english_minus_english", day, state,
                 prob = prob_non_english - prob_english, se = sqrt(se_non_english^2 + se_english^2))]
    rbind(out, dif, fill = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) data.table(note = paste("error:", conditionMessage(e))))
  list(hr = cbind(step = d$step[1], hr), states = cbind(step = d$step[1], states))
}
exits <- lapply(steps, exit_outcomes)
step_hr     <- rbind(step_hr, rbindlist(lapply(exits, `[[`, "hr"), fill = TRUE), fill = TRUE)
step_states <- rbindlist(lapply(exits, `[[`, "states"), fill = TRUE)
print(step_states[day == 7 | is.na(day), .(step, lang2, day, state, prob = round(prob, 3))])

step_hr[, `:=`(hr = exp(log_hr), ci_low = exp(log_hr - 1.96 * se_log_hr), ci_high = exp(log_hr + 1.96 * se_log_hr))]

print(step_desc)
print(step_hr[, .(step, model, term, hr = round(hr, 3), ci_low = round(ci_low, 3), ci_high = round(ci_high, 3), status)])

#)5 Shareable outputs for federation (aggregate only)
stamp_meta <- data.table(site = institution, analysis_version = analysis_version, run_date = as.character(Sys.Date()),
                         start_year = start_year, fio2_max = fio2_max, peep_max = peep_max, nee_max = nee_max,
                         ready_hours = ready_hours, death_grace_h = death_grace_h, min_cell = min_cell)

src_tag <- if (sbt_source == "flowsheet") "" else paste0("_", sbt_source)
# then in each fwrite file name:  paste0("liberation_hr", src_tag, "_", institution, ".csv"), etc.
stamp_meta[, `:=`(sbt_source = sbt_source, flip_min = flip_min, pass_min = pass_min)]

hr_share <- copy(step_hr)[, site := institution]
hr_share[, `:=`(n_obs = mask(n_obs), n_events = mask(n_events))]          # estimates kept; counts masked
setcolorder(hr_share, c("site", "step", "model", "term", "log_hr", "se_log_hr", "hr", "ci_low", "ci_high"))

desc_share <- copy(step_desc)[, site := institution]
desc_share[, small_group := n < min_cell | events < min_cell]               # flag for the coordinating center
desc_share[, `:=`(n = mask(n), events = mask(events), competing = mask(competing), censored = mask(censored))]
desc_share[small_group == TRUE, c("median_h_if_event", "cum_inc", "cum_inc_se", "rmean_waiting_h", "rmean_waiting_se") := NA_real_]

flow_dt <- rbindlist(flow)
flow_lang <- rbindlist(lapply(names(steps), function(s)
  steps[[s]][, .(step = steps[[s]]$step[1], stage = "analyzed, by language", runs = .N,
                 patients = uniqueN(patient_id)), by = .(language = as.character(lgrp))]), fill = TRUE)
flow_share <- rbind(flow_dt[, language := "all"], flow_lang, fill = TRUE)[, site := institution]
flow_share[, `:=`(runs = mask(runs), patients = mask(patients))]
print(flow_share)

fwrite(hr_share,   file.path(project_data_dir, paste0("liberation_hr",          src_tag, "_", institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(desc_share, file.path(project_data_dir, paste0("liberation_descriptive", src_tag, "_", institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(flow_share, file.path(project_data_dir, paste0("liberation_flow",        src_tag, "_", institution, ".csv")))
abs_share <- copy(step_abs)[, site := institution]
abs_share[, small_group := n_non_english < min_cell | events_non_english < min_cell]
abs_share[, `:=`(n_english = mask(n_english), n_non_english = mask(n_non_english), events_non_english = mask(events_non_english))]
fwrite(abs_share,  file.path(project_data_dir, paste0("liberation_absolute",    src_tag, "_", institution, ".csv")))
fwrite(stamp_meta, file.path(project_data_dir, paste0("liberation_metadata",    src_tag, "_", institution, ".csv")))

# State probabilities: hide any group's estimates when that group, or the count ending in that state, is 1-10
states_share <- copy(step_states)[, site := institution]
if ("n_lang" %in% names(states_share)) {
  states_share[, small := (n_lang > 0 & n_lang < min_cell) | (n_ended_in_state > 0 & n_ended_in_state < min_cell)]
  states_share[, small := fcoalesce(small, FALSE)]
  hide <- states_share[small == TRUE, .(step, day, state)]       # also hide the difference row built from them
  states_share[hide, on = .(step, day, state), c("prob", "se") := NA_real_]
  states_share[, `:=`(n_lang = mask_pos(n_lang), n_ended_in_state = mask_pos(n_ended_in_state), small = NULL)]
}
fwrite(states_share, file.path(project_data_dir, paste0("liberation_states", src_tag, "_", institution, ".csv")))
```

#PART TEN: Table 1
```{r}
################################################################################
# FEDERATED TABLE 1
#   Site side:  table1_site()  -> long table of counts / summary statistics, masked, by group only
#   Center side: table1_pool() -> pooled Table 1 across sites + standardized mean differences
#
# Design choices that avoid chasing small cells:
#   * Levels are collapsed to a fixed, pre-specified set BEFORE counting (same levels at every site).
#   * Sites report BY GROUP ONLY (no overall column), so a masked cell cannot be recovered by
#     subtracting the other group from an overall total. "Overall" is computed at the center.
#   * Within a variable x group, if exactly one level is masked, the next smallest is masked too
#     (complementary suppression), because the group N is shared.
#   * Continuous variables share n, mean, SD (pool exactly) and median/IQR (pooled approximately).
#   * The center reports pooled counts as the sum of reported cells and says how many site-cells were
#     masked; optionally imputes masked cells at the midpoint of 1..(min_cell - 1).
################################################################################

# ---- Site side -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# dt:        one row per unit of analysis (e.g. IMV run or patient)
# by:        grouping column (e.g. "lgrp" or "lang2"); rows with NA in `by` are dropped
# cat_vars:  named list: column -> character vector of allowed levels; anything else becomes "other",
#            NA becomes "missing". Use NULL to keep observed levels (not recommended for federation).
# cont_vars: character vector of numeric columns
table1_site <- function(dt, by, cat_vars = list(), cont_vars = character(), site, cohort,
                        min_cell = 11) {
  dt <- as.data.table(dt)[!is.na(get(by))]
  dt[, .grp := as.character(get(by))]
  N_grp <- dt[, .(N = .N), by = .grp]
  out <- list()

  for (v in names(cat_vars)) {
    x <- tolower(trimws(as.character(dt[[v]])))
    levs <- cat_vars[[v]]
    if (!is.null(levs)) x <- fifelse(is.na(x), "missing", fifelse(x %in% levs, x, "other"))
    else x[is.na(x)] <- "missing"
    all_levs <- if (!is.null(levs)) unique(c(levs, "other", "missing")) else sort(unique(x))
    tab <- data.table(.grp = dt$.grp, level = x)[, .(n = .N), by = .(.grp, level)]
    grid <- CJ(.grp = N_grp$.grp, level = all_levs)                   # every level shown, zeros included
    tab <- tab[grid, on = .(.grp, level)][is.na(n), n := 0L]
    out[[v]] <- tab[, `:=`(variable = v, type = "categorical")]
  }
  cat_tab <- rbindlist(out, fill = TRUE)

  cont_tab <- rbindlist(lapply(cont_vars, function(v) dt[, {
    x <- as.numeric(get(v)); x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    .(variable = v, type = "continuous", n = length(x),
      mean = if (length(x)) mean(x) else NA_real_, sd = if (length(x) > 1) sd(x) else NA_real_,
      p25 = if (length(x)) quantile(x, .25, names = FALSE) else NA_real_,
      median = if (length(x)) median(x) else NA_real_,
      p75 = if (length(x)) quantile(x, .75, names = FALSE) else NA_real_,
      n_missing = sum(is.na(get(v))))
  }, by = .grp]), fill = TRUE)

  res <- rbindlist(list(cat_tab, cont_tab), fill = TRUE)
  res <- merge(res, N_grp, by = ".grp")
  setnames(res, ".grp", "group")
  res[, `:=`(site = site, cohort = cohort, by_var = by, masked = FALSE)]

  # Primary masking: small counts (zeros are not masked: a true zero reveals nothing about a person)
  res[type == "categorical" & n > 0 & n < min_cell, masked := TRUE]
  # Complementary: exactly one masked cell in a variable x group -> also mask the smallest other non-zero cell
  res[type == "categorical", n_masked := sum(masked), by = .(variable, group)]
  comp <- res[type == "categorical" & n_masked == 1L & !masked & n > 0, .SD[which.min(n)], by = .(variable, group)]
  if (nrow(comp)) res[comp, on = .(variable, group, level), masked := TRUE]
  res[, n_masked := NULL]
  res[masked == TRUE, n := NA_integer_]
  # Continuous: hide statistics when fewer than min_cell non-missing values; small groups hide N too
  res[type == "continuous" & n < min_cell, `:=`(mean = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_, p25 = NA_real_,
                                                median = NA_real_, p75 = NA_real_, masked = TRUE)]
  res[N < min_cell, `:=`(n = NA_integer_, N = NA_integer_, n_missing = NA_integer_, mean = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_,
                         p25 = NA_real_, median = NA_real_, p75 = NA_real_, masked = TRUE)]
  setcolorder(res, c("site", "cohort", "by_var", "group", "variable", "type", "level", "n", "N", "masked"))
  res[order(type, variable, group, level)]
}

# ---- Center side -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# site_tables: rbindlist() of the sites' table1_site() outputs (same cohort and by_var)
# impute_masked: NULL = report sums of reported cells only; a number (e.g. 5) = add it for each masked cell
table1_pool <- function(site_tables, impute_masked = NULL, ref_group = NULL, digits = 1) {
  st <- as.data.table(site_tables)
  Ns <- unique(st[, .(site, group, N)])[, .(N = sum(N, na.rm = TRUE), sites_N_masked = sum(is.na(N))), by = group]

  cat_p <- st[type == "categorical", .(n_reported = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE), cells_masked = sum(masked)),
              by = .(variable, level, group)]
  cat_p <- merge(cat_p, Ns, by = "group")
  cat_p[, n := n_reported + if (is.null(impute_masked)) 0 else impute_masked * cells_masked]
  cat_p[, pct := 100 * n / N]

  cont_p <- st[type == "continuous" & !is.na(mean), {
    M <- sum(n * mean) / sum(n)                                                   # exact pooled mean
    V <- (sum((n - 1) * sd^2) + sum(n * (mean - M)^2)) / (sum(n) - 1)             # exact pooled variance
    .(n = sum(n), mean = M, sd = sqrt(V),
      median = sum(n * median) / sum(n), p25 = sum(n * p25) / sum(n), p75 = sum(n * p75) / sum(n),  # approximate
      sites = .N)
  }, by = .(variable, group)]
  cont_p <- merge(cont_p, st[type == "continuous", .(sites_masked = sum(masked)), by = .(variable, group)],
                  by = c("variable", "group"), all = TRUE)

  # Overall column (computed here, never at the sites)
  cat_all  <- cat_p[, .(group = "overall", n = sum(n), N = sum(unique(N)), cells_masked = sum(cells_masked)),
                    by = .(variable, level)][, pct := 100 * n / N]
  cont_all <- cont_p[!is.na(mean), {
    M <- sum(n * mean) / sum(n); V <- (sum((n - 1) * sd^2) + sum(n * (mean - M)^2)) / (sum(n) - 1)
    .(group = "overall", n = sum(n), mean = M, sd = sqrt(V), median = sum(n * median) / sum(n),
      p25 = sum(n * p25) / sum(n), p75 = sum(n * p75) / sum(n))
  }, by = variable]

  # Standardized mean differences vs the reference group
  groups <- setdiff(unique(st$group), ref_group)
  smd <- NULL
  if (!is.null(ref_group)) {
    smd_cat <- rbindlist(lapply(groups, function(g) {
      a <- cat_p[group == ref_group, .(variable, level, p1 = pct / 100, k1 = cells_masked)]
      b <- cat_p[group == g,         .(variable, level, p2 = pct / 100, k2 = cells_masked)]
      m <- merge(a, b, by = c("variable", "level"))
      m <- m[p1 + p2 > 0 & (k1 + k2 == 0 | !is.null(impute_masked))]   # no SMD from lower-bound counts
      m[, .(variable, level, comparison = paste(g, "vs", ref_group),
            smd = (p2 - p1) / sqrt((p1 * (1 - p1) + p2 * (1 - p2)) / 2))]
    }))
    smd_cont <- rbindlist(lapply(groups, function(g) {
      a <- cont_p[group == ref_group, .(variable, m1 = mean, s1 = sd)]
      b <- cont_p[group == g,         .(variable, m2 = mean, s2 = sd)]
      m <- merge(a, b, by = "variable")
      m[, .(variable, level = NA_character_, comparison = paste(g, "vs", ref_group),
            smd = (m2 - m1) / sqrt((s1^2 + s2^2) / 2))]
    }))
    smd <- rbind(smd_cat, smd_cont)
  }

  # Display table: n (%) for categorical; mean (SD) and median [IQR] for continuous
  # Masked cells: without imputation the pooled count is a lower bound, shown as ">= n (>= pct%) [k masked]"
  fmt_n <- function(n, pct, k) fifelse(k > 0 & is.null(impute_masked),
    fifelse(n == 0, sprintf("masked [%d site-cell%s]", k, fifelse(k > 1, "s", "")),
            sprintf(">=%s (>=%.*f%%) [%d masked]", prettyNum(round(n), big.mark = ","), digits, pct, k)),
    sprintf("%s (%.*f%%)", prettyNum(round(n), big.mark = ","), digits, pct))
  fmt_cat <- rbind(cat_p[,   .(variable, level, group, value = fmt_n(n, pct, cells_masked), cells_masked)],
                   cat_all[, .(variable, level, group, value = fmt_n(n, pct, cells_masked), cells_masked)])
  fmt_cont <- rbind(cont_p[, .(variable, level = "mean (SD); median [IQR]", group,
                               value = sprintf("%.*f (%.*f); %.*f [%.*f, %.*f]", digits, mean, digits, sd, digits, median,
                                               digits, p25, digits, p75), cells_masked = sites_masked)],
                    cont_all[, .(variable, level = "mean (SD); median [IQR]", group,
                                 value = sprintf("%.*f (%.*f); %.*f [%.*f, %.*f]", digits, mean, digits, sd, digits, median,
                                                 digits, p25, digits, p75), cells_masked = NA_integer_)])
  empty <- cat_all[n == 0 & cells_masked == 0, .(variable, level)]                 # drop levels absent at every site
  fmt_cat <- fmt_cat[!empty, on = .(variable, level)]
  display <- dcast(rbind(fmt_cat, fmt_cont, fill = TRUE), variable + level ~ group, value.var = "value")
  setcolorder(display, c("variable", "level", setdiff(c(ref_group, sort(groups)), NA), "overall"))
  header  <- rbind(Ns[, .(group, N)], data.table(group = "overall", N = sum(Ns$N)))

  list(display = display, group_N = header, categorical = rbind(cat_p, cat_all, fill = TRUE),
       continuous = rbind(cont_p, cont_all, fill = TRUE), smd = smd,
       masked_cells = cat_p[cells_masked > 0, .(variable, level, group, cells_masked)])
}


################################################################################
# PROJECT USE: Table 1 for the liberation study (run after liberation_steps_v2.R at each site)
#   Unit = IMV run. Grouped by the 3-level language variable ONLY. English vs non-English is
#   derived at the center by adding Spanish + other non-English. (Sharing both groupings would let
#   a masked Spanish cell be recovered as non-English minus other.)
################################################################################
build_liberation_table1 <- function(steps, runs, epoch_table, site, out_dir, min_cell = 11) {
  base <- epoch_table[epoch == 0L, intersect(c("imv_run_id", "bmi", "admission_type_category", "transfer_in",
                                               "epoch_hospital_type", "nee", "fio2", "peep", "oxy_pf", "sofa_total"),
                                             names(epoch_table)), with = FALSE]
  setnames(base, c("nee", "fio2", "peep", "oxy_pf", "sofa_total"),
           c("nee_at_intubation", "fio2_at_intubation", "peep_at_intubation", "pf_equiv_at_intubation", "sofa_at_intubation"),
           skip_absent = TRUE)
  make_t1 <- function(ids) {
    d <- runs[imv_run_id %in% ids, .(imv_run_id, lgrp, race4, eth3, period3, end_reason,
                                     imv_hours = as.numeric(difftime(t_end, t_int, units = "hours")))]
    d <- merge(d, steps$step1[, .(imv_run_id, age_at_admission, sex_category, elixhauser_score, intubation_site)],
               by = "imv_run_id", all.x = TRUE)
    merge(d, base, by = "imv_run_id", all.x = TRUE)
  }
  cats <- list(sex_category = c("male", "female"),
               race4 = c("white", "black", "asian", "other", "unknown"),
               eth3 = c("hispanic", "non_hispanic", "unknown"),
               intubation_site = c("icu", "ed", "or", "procedural", "ward", "unknown"),
               period3 = c("1_pre_pandemic", "2_pandemic", "3_post_pandemic"),
               end_reason = c("extubation", "death", "tracheostomy", "censored"),
               transfer_in = c("0", "1"),
               epoch_hospital_type = NULL)                    # NULL = keep the site's own levels (hospital type is site-specific)
  conts <- c("age_at_admission", "bmi", "elixhauser_score", "sofa_at_intubation", "pf_equiv_at_intubation",
             "fio2_at_intubation", "peep_at_intubation", "nee_at_intubation", "imv_hours")
  res <- rbind(
    table1_site(make_t1(steps$step1$imv_run_id), "lgrp", cats[names(cats) %in% names(make_t1(integer()))],
                intersect(conts, names(make_t1(integer()))), site = site, cohort = "all_imv_runs", min_cell = min_cell),
    table1_site(make_t1(steps$step3a$imv_run_id), "lgrp", cats[names(cats) %in% names(make_t1(integer()))],
                intersect(conts, names(make_t1(integer()))), site = site, cohort = "first_sbt_runs", min_cell = min_cell),
    table1_site(make_t1(steps$step3b$imv_run_id), "lgrp", cats[names(cats) %in% names(make_t1(integer()))],
                intersect(conts, names(make_t1(integer()))), site = site, cohort = "passed_sbt_runs", min_cell = min_cell))
  fwrite(res, file.path(out_dir, paste0("liberation_table1_", site, ".csv")))
  invisible(res)
}
# At each site:   
t1 <- build_liberation_table1(steps, runs, epoch_table, institution, project_data_dir)
```
